4.22.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
ihāpi yogamāsādya bhartṛbaṃdhujanaiḥ saha ..
vada nārī naraśreṣṭha vrajedyena śivālayam .. 5 ..
4.22.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
इहापि योगमासाद्य भर्तृबंधुजनैः सह ॥
वद नारी नरश्रेष्ठ व्रजेद्येन शिवालयम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.22.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
O best of men, tell by what means a woman, having achieved union with her husband and relatives here,
may go to the abode of Śiva,

4.22.s:
vidhavā ca pare loke bhūyo'pi na viyujyate ..
sukhasaṃdohasaubhāgyayuktā bhavati bhāminī .. 2 ..
4.22.d:
विधवा च परे लोके भूयोऽपि न वियुज्यते ॥
सुखसंदोहसौभाग्ययुक्ता भवति भामिनी ॥ 2 ॥
4.22.m:
and, not being a widow in the next world, is not separated again,
[and] the woman becomes endowed with abundant happiness and good fortune.

4.22.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
ubhayācaritaṃ yatnādbhavavāglalitāmṛtam ..
labdhvā hi bhavato janma dakṣakopādviyuktayā .. 3 ..
4.22.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
उभयाचरितं यत्नाद्भववाग्ललितामृतम् ॥
लब्ध्वा हि भवतो जन्म दक्षकोपाद्वियुक्तया ॥ 3 ॥
4.22.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Carefully [observe] what was performed by both—the lovely nectar of Bhava's words.
For she who had been separated [from him] by the anger of Dakṣa, having obtained birth from you,

4.22.s:
mahāsaubhāgyasaṃdohaṃ dṛṣṭvā devyā mahātmanā ..
aruṃdhatyā vaśiṣṭhena pṛṣṭena kathitaṃ śṛṇu .. 4 ..
4.22.d:
महासौभाग्यसंदोहं दृष्ट्वा देव्या महात्मना ॥
अरुंधत्या वशिष्ठेन पृष्टेन कथितं शृणु ॥ 4 ॥
4.22.m:
seeing the vast mass of supreme good fortune of the goddess, was told by the high-souled
Vasiṣṭha when questioned by Arundhatī; listen to it.

4.22.s:
māsi mārgaśire prāpte caṃdravṛddhau śucismitā ..
dvitīyāyāṃ samāsādya naktaṃ bhuṃjīta pāyasam .. 5 ..
4.22.d:
मासि मार्गशिरे प्राप्ते चंद्रवृद्धौ शुचिस्मिता ॥
द्वितीयायां समासाद्य नक्तं भुंजीत पायसम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.22.m:
When the month of Mārgaśiras arrives, during the waxing of the moon, she of bright smiles,
having arrived at the second lunar day, should eat a nocturnal meal of milk rice.

4.22.s:
ācamya ca śucirbhūtvā daṃḍavacchaṃkaraṃ namet ..
mudānvitā namaskṛtya vijñāpya parameśvaram .. 6 ..
4.22.d:
आचम्य च शुचिर्भूत्वा दंडवच्छंकरं नमेत् ॥
मुदान्विता नमस्कृत्य विज्ञाप्य परमेश्वरम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.22.m:
And having sipped water and become pure, she should bow to Śaṅkara like a staff.
Filled with joy, having paid homage and petitioned Parameśvara,

4.22.s:
audumbaramṛjuṃ gṛhya bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam ..
uttarāśāgataṃ sāgraṃ satvacaṃ nirvraṇaṃ śubham .. 7 ..
4.22.d:
औदुम्बरमृजुं गृह्य भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम् ॥
उत्तराशागतं साग्रं सत्वचं निर्व्रणं शुभम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.22.m:
taking a straight udumbara tooth-cleansing stick, she should chew it—
one facing the northern direction, with its tip intact, with its bark, uninjured, and auspicious.

4.22.s:
dvitīyāyāṃ pare vāhni gaurīṃ śaṃbhuṃ ca pūjayet ..
śālipiṣṭamaye kṛtvā rūpe strīpuṃsayoḥ śubhe ..
pātre saṃsthāpya saṃpūjya jāgaraṃ niśi kalpayet .. 8 ..
4.22.d:
द्वितीयायां परे वाह्नि गौरीं शंभुं च पूजयेत् ॥
शालिपिष्टमये कृत्वा रूपे स्त्रीपुंसयोः शुभे ॥
पात्रे संस्थाप्य संपूज्य जागरं निशि कल्पयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.22.m:
On the next day, the tṛtīyā, one should worship Gaurī and Śambhu.
Having made two auspicious figures of a woman and a man out of rice flour,
placing them in a vessel and worshipping them, one should arrange a vigil at night.

4.22.s:
vidhivatpūjayitvā tu śaṃkaraṃ kīrtayatsvapet ..
prabhāte te gṛhītvā tu ācāryāya nivedayet .. 9..
4.22.d:
विधिवत्पूजयित्वा तु शंकरं कीर्तयत्स्वपेत् ॥
प्रभाते ते गृहीत्वा तु आचार्याय निवेदयेत् ॥ 9॥
4.22.m:
Having worshipped according to the rules, praising Śaṅkara, one should sleep.
In the morning, taking those two, one should offer them to the teacher.

4.22.s:
bhojayenmṛṣṭamannādyaṃ śivabhaktyā dvijottamān ..
dāṃpatyāni ca tatraiva śaktyā tānyapi bhojayet .. 4.22.10 ..
4.22.d:
भोजयेन्मृष्टमन्नाद्यं शिवभक्त्या द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
दांपत्यानि च तत्रैव शक्त्या तान्यपि भोजयेत् ॥ 4.22.10 ॥
4.22.m:
Out of devotion to Śiva, one should feed the best of the twice-born with delicious foods and the like;
and right there one should also feed married couples according to one's capacity.

4.22.s:
pratimāsaṃ prakurvīta vidhinā tena saṃyatā ..
kārtikāṃte tato māsi mārgaśīrṣe samudyamet .. 11 ..
4.22.d:
प्रतिमासं प्रकुर्वीत विधिना तेन संयता ॥
कार्तिकांते ततो मासि मार्गशीर्षे समुद्यमेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.22.m:
Restrained, she should perform this every month according to the rule.
Then, at the end of Kārttika, in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, she should conclude it.

4.22.s:
nāmāni ca pravakṣyāmi pratimāsaṃ kramācchaṇu ..
pūjājāpyanimittaṃ ca siddhyarthaṃ ceti tasya ca .. 12 ..
4.22.d:
नामानि च प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमासं क्रमाच्छणु ॥
पूजाजाप्यनिमित्तं च सिद्ध्यर्थं चेति तस्य च ॥ 12 ॥
4.22.m:
And I shall proclaim the names month by month in order; hear them,
for the purpose of worship, recitation of mantras, and the attainment of perfection of that [vrata].

4.22.s:
evaṃ pauṣe tu saṃprāpte giriśaṃ pārvatīṃ tathā ..
samabhyarcya caturthyāṃ tu paṃcagavyaṃ pibetsudhīḥ .. 13 ..
4.22.d:
एवं पौषे तु संप्राप्ते गिरिशं पार्वतीं तथा ॥
समभ्यर्च्य चतुर्थ्यां तु पंचगव्यं पिबेत्सुधीः ॥ 13 ॥
4.22.m:
Thus, when Pauṣa has arrived, having worshipped Giriśa and Pārvatī,
the wise one should drink the five products of the cow on the fourth lunar day.

4.22.s:
etatpāraṇamuddiṣṭaṃ mārgādau mārgagocaram ..
na cānyatpañcagavyādi pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam ..14..
4.22.d:
एतत्पारणमुद्दिष्टं मार्गादौ मार्गगोचरम् ॥
न चान्यत्पञ्चगव्यादि पावनं परमं स्मृतम् ॥14॥
4.22.m:
This is declared to be the breaking of the fast occurring in Mārgaśīrṣa and the others at the beginning;
and no other purifier besides the five products of the cow is considered supreme.

4.22.s:
bhavaṃ caiva bhavānīṃ ca māsi māghe prapūjayet ..
phālgune tu mahādevamumayā sahitaṃ matam .. 15 ..
4.22.d:
भवं चैव भवानीं च मासि माघे प्रपूजयेत् ॥
फाल्गुने तु महादेवमुमया सहितं मतम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.22.m:
In the month of Māgha, one should worship Bhava and Bhavānī;
and in Phālguna, Mahādeva together with Umā is prescribed.

4.22.s:
lalitāṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ caitre saṃpūjayettataḥ ..
sthāṇuṃ vaiśākhamāse tu lolanetrāyutaṃ yajet .. 16 ..
4.22.d:
ललितां शंकरं देवं चैत्रे संपूजयेत्ततः ॥
स्थाणुं वैशाखमासे तु लोलनेत्रायुतं यजेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.22.m:
Then in Caitra one should worship the goddess Lalitā and the god Śaṅkara;
in the month of Vaiśākha, one should sacrifice to Sthāṇu united with Lolanetrā.

4.22.s:
jyeṣṭhe vīreśvaraṃ devamekavīrāsamanvitam ..
āṣāḍhe paśunāthaṃ ca śaktyā sārddhaṃ trilocanam .. 17 ..
4.22.d:
ज्येष्ठे वीरेश्वरं देवमेकवीरासमन्वितम् ॥
आषाढे पशुनाथं च शक्त्या सार्द्धं त्रिलोचनम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.22.m:
In Jyeṣṭha, to the god Vīreśvara accompanied by Ekavīrā;
in Āṣāḍha, to Paśunātha, the three-eyed god, together with his Śakti.

4.22.s:
śrīkaṃṭhaṃ śrāvaṇe devaṃ sutānvitamathārcayet ..
bhīmaṃ bhādrapade māsi durgayā sahitaṃ yajet ..
īśānaṃ kārttike māsi śivādevīyutaṃ yajet .. 18 ..
4.22.d:
श्रीकंठं श्रावणे देवं सुतान्वितमथार्चयेत् ॥
भीमं भाद्रपदे मासि दुर्गया सहितं यजेत् ॥
ईशानं कार्त्तिके मासि शिवादेवीयुतं यजेत् ॥ 18 ॥

4.22.s:
japyadhyānārcanāyaiva nāmānyetāni suvrata ..
smṛtāni vidhinā rājanvratasiddhirbhaved dhuvam ..19..
4.22.d:
जप्यध्यानार्चनायैव नामान्येतानि सुव्रत ॥
स्मृतानि विधिना राजन्व्रतसिद्धिर्भवेद् धुवम् ॥19॥
4.22.m:
These names are remembered for recitation, meditation, and worship, O you of good vows;
according to rule, O king, the perfection of the vrata will certainly come to be.

4.22.s:
pratimāsaṃ tu puṣpāṇi yāni pūjāsu yojayet ..
tāni kramātpravakṣyāmi sadyaḥ prītikarāṇi vai .. 4.22.20 ..
4.22.d:
प्रतिमासं तु पुष्पाणि यानि पूजासु योजयेत् ॥
तानि क्रमात्प्रवक्ष्यामि सद्यः प्रीतिकराणि वै ॥ 4.22.20 ॥
4.22.m:
And the flowers that one should employ in the worships month by month,
those I shall proclaim in order, which truly bring immediate delight.

4.22.s:
ādau nīlotpalaṃ yojyaṃ tadabhāve'parāṇyapi ..
pavitrāṇi sugaṃdhīni yojayedbhaktito'rcane .. 21 ..
4.22.d:
आदौ नीलोत्पलं योज्यं तदभावेऽपराण्यपि ॥
पवित्राणि सुगंधीनि योजयेद्भक्तितोऽर्चने ॥ 21 ॥
4.22.m:
At first, the blue water lily should be employed; in its absence, others as well,
pure and fragrant, one should employ with devotion in the worship.

4.22.s:
karavīraṃ bilvapatraṃ kiṃśukaṃ kubjamallikā ..
pāṭalābjakadaṃbaṃ ca tagaraṃ droṇamālatī .. 22 ..
4.22.d:
करवीरं बिल्वपत्रं किंशुकं कुब्जमल्लिका ॥
पाटलाब्जकदंबं च तगरं द्रोणमालती ॥ 22 ॥
4.22.m:
Oleander, bilva leaf, kiṃśuka, kubjamallikā,
pāṭalā, lotus, kadamba, tagara, droṇa, and mālatī:

4.22.s:
etānyuktakrameṇaiva māseṣu dvādaśasvapi ..
bhaktyā yojyāni rājendra śivayostuṣṭihetave .. 23 ..
4.22.d:
एतान्युक्तक्रमेणैव मासेषु द्वादशस्वपि ॥
भक्त्या योज्यानि राजेन्द्र शिवयोस्तुष्टिहेतवे ॥ 23 ॥
4.22.m:
These very ones, in the stated order, across all twelve months,
should be offered with devotion, O lord of kings, for the satisfaction of the two Śivas.

4.22.s:
vatsarāṃte vitānaṃ ca dhūpotkṣepaṃ saghaṃṭikam ..
dhvajaṃ dīpaṃ vastrayugaṃ śaṅkarāya nivedayet..24..
4.22.d:
वत्सरांते वितानं च धूपोत्क्षेपं सघंटिकम् ॥
ध्वजं दीपं वस्त्रयुगं शङ्कराय निवेदयेत्॥24॥
4.22.m:
At the end of the year, one should offer a canopy, an incense-burner with a bell,
a banner, a lamp, and a pair of garments to Śaṅkara.

4.22.s:
snāpayitvā ca liptvā ca sauvarṇaṃ mūrdhni paṅkajam ..
pūpayugmaṃ ca purataḥ śālipiṣṭamayaṃ nyaset .. 25 ..
4.22.d:
स्नापयित्वा च लिप्त्वा च सौवर्णं मूर्ध्नि पङ्कजम् ॥
पूपयुग्मं च पुरतः शालिपिष्टमयं न्यसेत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.22.m:
Having bathed and anointed [the liṅga], one should place a golden lotus on its top,
and two cakes made of rice flour in front of it.

4.22.s:
naivedyaṃ śaktito datvā nattvā ca vidhivacchivam ..
kuryānnīrājanaṃ śambhostato gacchetsvakaṃ gṛham .. 26 ..
4.22.d:
नैवेद्यं शक्तितो दत्वा नत्त्वा च विधिवच्छिवम् ॥
कुर्यान्नीराजनं शम्भोस्ततो गच्छेत्स्वकं गृहम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.22.m:
Having offered food according to one's capacity and bowed down to Śiva according to rule,
one should perform the lustration of Śambhu; then one should go to one's own house.

4.22.s:
tatra gatvā trikoṇaśca caturasraṃ ca kārayet ..
trikoṇe brāhmaṇī bhojyā caturasre dvijottamāḥ .. 27 ..
4.22.d:
तत्र गत्वा त्रिकोणश्च चतुरस्रं च कारयेत् ॥
त्रिकोणे ब्राह्मणी भोज्या चतुरस्रे द्विजोत्तमाः ॥ 27 ॥
4.22.m:
Having gone there, one should make a triangle and a square;
in the triangle a brāhmaṇa woman is to be fed, and in the square the best of the twice-born.

4.22.s:
vratino bhojayetpaścādvādaśaiva dvijottamān ..
mithunāni ca tāvaṃti śaktyā bhaktyā ca pāṇḍava .. 28 ..
4.22.d:
व्रतिनो भोजयेत्पश्चाद्वादशैव द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
मिथुनानि च तावंति शक्त्या भक्त्या च पाण्डव ॥ 28 ॥
4.22.m:
Then the observer of the vrata should feed twelve of the best twice-born,
and as many married couples, according to ability and with devotion, O Pāṇḍava.

4.22.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ kārayitvā suśobhanam ..
mauktikāni catuḥṣaṣṭistāvato'pi pravālakāḥ ..
tāvaṃti puṣparāgāṇi tāmrapātropari nyaset .. 25..
4.22.d:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं कारयित्वा सुशोभनम् ॥
मौक्तिकानि चतुःषष्टिस्तावतोऽपि प्रवालकाः ॥
तावंति पुष्परागाणि ताम्रपात्रोपरि न्यसेत् ॥ 25॥
4.22.m:
Having had a very beautiful Umā and Maheśvara made of gold,
one should place sixty-four pearls, as many corals,
and as many topazes upon a copper vessel.

4.22.s:
vastreṇa veṣṭayitvā ca gandhairdhūpaistathārcayet ..
etatsaṃbhārasaṃyuktamācāryāya nivedayet .. 4.22.30 ..
4.22.d:
वस्त्रेण वेष्टयित्वा च गन्धैर्धूपैस्तथार्चयेत् ॥
एतत्संभारसंयुक्तमाचार्याय निवेदयेत् ॥ 4.22.30 ॥
4.22.m:
And having wrapped it with a cloth, one should worship it with perfumes and incenses;
endowed with these provisions, one should present it to the teacher.

4.22.s:
vratināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca dampatīnāṃ ca bhārata ..
dattvā hiraṇyavāsāṃsi kṣamayetpraṇipatya ca .. 31 ..
4.22.d:
व्रतिनां ब्राह्मणानां च दम्पतीनां च भारत ॥
दत्त्वा हिरण्यवासांसि क्षमयेत्प्रणिपत्य च ॥ 31 ॥
4.22.m:
Having given gold and garments to the observers of the vrata, to the brāhmaṇas,
and to the married couples, O Bhārata, one should bow down and ask for their forbearance.

4.22.s:
catvāriṃśattathāṣṭau ca kumbhāṃcchatramupānahau ..
sahiraṇyākṣatānsarvāndadyātpuṣpodakānvitān .. .. 32 ..
4.22.d:
चत्वारिंशत्तथाष्टौ च कुम्भांच्छत्रमुपानहौ ॥
सहिरण्याक्षतान्सर्वान्दद्यात्पुष्पोदकान्वितान् ॥ ॥ 32 ॥
4.22.m: And forty-eight jars, an umbrella, and a pair of shoes, / all accompanied by gold, unbroken rice, flowers, and water, he should give.

4.22.s:
dīnāndhaduḥkhitānāṃ ca taddine vā nivāritam ..
kalpayedannadānaṃ cālocayañchaktimātmanaḥ .. 33 ..
4.22.d:
दीनान्धदुःखितानां च तद्दिने वा निवारितम् ॥
कल्पयेदन्नदानं चालोचयञ्छक्तिमात्मनः ॥ 33 ॥
4.22.m: And on that day, considering his own capacity, / he should arrange an unhindered gift of food for the poor, the blind, and the afflicted.

4.22.s:
nyūnādhikaṃ ca kartavyaṃ svavittapari māṇataḥ ..
saṃpūrayetkalpanayā vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kārayet ..34..
4.22.d:
न्यूनाधिकं च कर्तव्यं स्ववित्तपरि माणतः ॥
संपूरयेत्कल्पनया वित्तशाठ्यं न कारयेत् ॥34॥
4.22.m: It should be done with more or less according to the measure of one's own wealth; / he should fulfil it with intention, and not practice deceit with wealth.

4.22.s:
aviyogakaraṃ caitadrūpasaubhāgyavittadam ..
āyuḥputrapradaṃ svargyaṃ śivalokapradāyakam .. ... 35 ..
4.22.d:
अवियोगकरं चैतद्रूपसौभाग्यवित्तदम् ॥
आयुःपुत्रप्रदं स्वर्ग्यं शिवलोकप्रदायकम् ॥ ॥। 35 ॥
4.22.m: And this brings non-separation, bestows beauty, good fortune, and wealth, / grants longevity and sons, leads to heaven, and bestows the world of Śiva.

4.22.s:
samyakpurāṇapatitaṃ vratacaryametattattvaṃ carācaragurorhṛdayaṃgamāyāḥ..
pūjāṃ vidhāya vidhivanna viyogameti sādhvīsvabhartṛsutabandhujanairdhanaiśca..36..
umāmaheśvaravratavarṇanam
4.22.d:
सम्यक्पुराणपतितं व्रतचर्यमेतत्तत्त्वं चराचरगुरोर्हृदयंगमायाः॥
पूजां विधाय विधिवन्न वियोगमेति साध्वीस्वभर्तृसुतबन्धुजनैर्धनैश्च॥36॥
उमामहेश्वरव्रतवर्णनम्
4.22.m:
Having duly performed the worship of this real practice of the votive observance found in the Purāṇas, which is dear to the heart of the teacher of the moving and unmoving, / a virtuous woman never meets separation from her husband, sons, kinsmen, or riches.
Description of the Umāmaheśvara Votive Observance

4.23.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kena dharmeṇa nārīṇāṃ vratena niyamena ca ..
saubhāgyaṃ jāyate'tīva putrāśca bahavaḥ śubhāḥ .. 1 ..
4.23.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
केन धर्मेण नारीणां व्रतेन नियमेन च ॥
सौभाग्यं जायतेऽतीव पुत्राश्च बहवः शुभाः ॥ 1 ॥
4.23.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By what virtue, by what votive observance and restriction, / do women obtain great good fortune and many auspicious sons,

4.23.s:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca vastrāṇi vividhāni ca ..
aviyogaṃ ca satataṃ labhate putrapautrayoḥ .. 2 ..
4.23.d:
धनं धान्यं सुवर्णं च वस्त्राणि विविधानि च ॥
अवियोगं च सततं लभते पुत्रपौत्रयोः ॥ 2 ॥
4.23.m: wealth, grain, gold, various garments, / and constant non-separation from sons and grandsons?

4.23.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu pārtha pravakṣyāmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
yatkṛtvā subhagā nārī bahvapatyā ca jāyate .. 3 ..
4.23.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शृणु पार्थ प्रवक्ष्यामि व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥
यत्कृत्वा सुभगा नारी बह्वपत्या च जायते ॥ 3 ॥
4.23.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear, O Pārtha, I will declare the best votive observance among votive observances, / having performed which a woman becomes fortunate and possessed of many children.

4.23.s:
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dāsīdāsādikaṃ vahu ..
utpadyate gṛhe yena tadvata kathayāmi te .. 4 ..
4.23.d:
धनं धान्यं हिरण्यं च दासीदासादिकं वहु ॥
उत्पद्यते गृहे येन तद्वत कथयामि ते ॥ 4 ॥
4.23.m: I will tell you of that votive observance by which wealth, grain, gold, / and numerous female and male servants are generated in the home.

4.23.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ nāma apsarobhiḥ purā kṛtam ..
vidyādharaiḥ kinnaraiśca ṛṣikanyābhireva ca ..5..
4.23.d:
उमामहेश्वरं नाम अप्सरोभिः पुरा कृतम् ॥
विद्याधरैः किन्नरैश्च ऋषिकन्याभिरेव च ॥5॥
4.23.m: Named Umāmaheśvara, it was performed in ancient times by apsarases, / by vidyādharas, kinnaras, and daughters of sages,

4.23.s:
rūpiṇyā raṃbhayā caiva sītayā'halyayā tathā..
rohiṇyā damayaṃtyā ca taptayā cānasūyayā .. ..6..
4.23.d:
रूपिण्या रंभया चैव सीतयाऽहल्यया तथा॥
रोहिण्या दमयंत्या च तप्तया चानसूयया ॥ ॥6॥
4.23.m: and by the beautiful Rambhā, by Sītā, Ahalyā, / Rohiṇī, Damayantī, and the ascetic Anasūyā.

4.23.s:
etābhiścaritaṃ pārtha vrataṃ sarvavratottamam ..
saubhāgyārogyaphaladaṃ dāridryavyādhināśanam .. 7 ..
4.23.d:
एताभिश्चरितं पार्थ व्रतं सर्वव्रतोत्तमम् ॥
सौभाग्यारोग्यफलदं दारिद्र्यव्याधिनाशनम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.23.m: By these, O Pārtha, this votive observance, the best of all votive observances, was performed; / it bears the fruit of good fortune and health, and destroys poverty and disease.

4.23.s:
martyaloke striyo yāśca durbhagārūpavarjitāḥ ..
aputrā nirdhanāścaiva sarvabhogavivarjitāḥ .. 8 ..
4.23.d:
मर्त्यलोके स्त्रियो याश्च दुर्भगारूपवर्जिताः ॥
अपुत्रा निर्धनाश्चैव सर्वभोगविवर्जिताः ॥ 8 ॥
4.23.m: And whatever women in the mortal world are unfortunate, bereft of beauty, / childless, penniless, and devoid of all enjoyments,

4.23.s:
tāsāṃ hitārthaṃ pārvatyā umāmaheśvaraṃ vratam ..
avatāritaṃ purā pārtha na jānaṃtyadhamāḥ striyaḥ ..9..
4.23.d:
तासां हितार्थं पार्वत्या उमामहेश्वरं व्रतम् ॥
अवतारितं पुरा पार्थ न जानंत्यधमाः स्त्रियः ॥9॥
4.23.m: for their benefit the Umāmaheśvara votive observance was brought down in ancient times by Pārvatī, / [yet] base women do not know it, O Pārtha.

4.23.s:
pūrvaṃ mārgaśire māsi nārī dharmaparāyaṇā ..
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā .. 4.23.10 ..
4.23.d:
पूर्वं मार्गशिरे मासि नारी धर्मपरायणा ॥
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायां सोपवासा जितेन्द्रिया ॥ 4.23.10 ॥
4.23.m: First, in the month of Mārgaśira, a woman devoted to righteousness, / fasting and with controlled senses, on the third [lunar day] of the bright fortnight,

4.23.s:
snātvā saṃpūjya lalitāṃ harakāyārdhavāsinīm ..
punaḥ prabhātasamaye snānaṃ cākṛtrime jale ..
kṛtvā devīstarpayitvā idaṃ vākyamudīrayet .. 11 ..
4.23.d:
स्नात्वा संपूज्य ललितां हरकायार्धवासिनीम् ॥
पुनः प्रभातसमये स्नानं चाकृत्रिमे जले ॥
कृत्वा देवीस्तर्पयित्वा इदं वाक्यमुदीरयेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.23.m: having bathed and worshipped Lalitā who dwells in half of Hara's body, / having bathed again at dawn in natural water / and gratified the goddesses, should utter these words:

4.23.s:
namo namaste deveśa umādehārddhadhāraka ..
mahādevi namaste'stu harakāyārddhavāsini .. 12 ..
4.23.d:
नमो नमस्ते देवेश उमादेहार्द्धधारक ॥
महादेवि नमस्तेऽस्तु हरकायार्द्धवासिनि ॥ 12 ॥
4.23.m: “Homage, homage to you, O Lord of gods, who bear half the body of Umā! / O Great Goddess, homage be to you who dwell in half of Hara's body!”

4.23.s:
hṛdi kṛtvā śivaṃ devīṃ japedyāvadgṛhaṃ gatā ..
pūjayeddevamīśānaṃ puṣpaiḥ kālodbhavaistataḥ .. 13 ..
4.23.d:
हृदि कृत्वा शिवं देवीं जपेद्यावद्गृहं गता ॥
पूजयेद्देवमीशानं पुष्पैः कालोद्भवैस्ततः ॥ 13 ॥
4.23.m: Holding Śiva and the Goddess in her heart, she should recite [prayers] until she has reached home; / then she should worship the god Īśāna with seasonal flowers:

4.23.s:
vāmapārśve umāṃ devīṃ dakṣiṇe tu maheśvaram ..
dhūpaṃ vā gugguluṃ vāpi dahetpaścātsubhāvitā ..
naivedyaṃ tu yathāśakti ghṛtapakvaṃ nivedayet .. 14 ..
4.23.d:
वामपार्श्वे उमां देवीं दक्षिणे तु महेश्वरम् ॥
धूपं वा गुग्गुलुं वापि दहेत्पश्चात्सुभाविता ॥
नैवेद्यं तु यथाशक्ति घृतपक्वं निवेदयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.23.m: the Goddess Umā on the left side, and Maheśvara on the right. / Filled with devotion, she should then burn incense or bdellium, / and offer an offering of food cooked with ghee according to her capacity.

4.23.s:
kārayedvaiśvadevaṃ tu tilājyena susaṃskṛtam ..
pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ prāśya ātmakāyaviśodhanam .. 15 ..
4.23.d:
कारयेद्वैश्वदेवं तु तिलाज्येन सुसंस्कृतम् ॥
पञ्चगव्यं ततः प्राश्य आत्मकायविशोधनम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.23.m: She should have the Vaiśvadeva rite performed, well consecrated with sesame and clarified butter, / and then drink the five cow-products to purify her own body.

4.23.s:
evaṃ dvādaśamāsāṃstu pūjayitvā maheśvaram ..
udyāpanaṃ tataḥ kuryātprahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā .. 16 ..
4.23.d:
एवं द्वादशमासांस्तु पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् ॥
उद्यापनं ततः कुर्यात्प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना ॥ 16 ॥
4.23.m: Having thus worshipped Maheśvara for twelve months, / she should then perform the concluding rite with a joyful heart.

4.23.s:
śivaṃ rūpyamayaṃ kṛtvā umāṃ haimamayīṃ tathā ..
ārūḍhau vṛṣabhe raupye sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitau .. 17 ..
4.23.d:
शिवं रूप्यमयं कृत्वा उमां हैममयीं तथा ॥
आरूढौ वृषभे रौप्ये सर्वालंकारभूषितौ ॥ 17 ॥
4.23.m: Having made Śiva out of silver and Umā out of gold, / mounted upon a silver bull, adorned with all ornaments,

4.23.s:
candanena śivaṃ carcya kuṃkumena ca pārvatīm ..
arcayetkusumaiḥ paścātsugandhaiḥ sumanoharaiḥ .. 18 ..
4.23.d:
चन्दनेन शिवं चर्च्य कुंकुमेन च पार्वतीम् ॥
अर्चयेत्कुसुमैः पश्चात्सुगन्धैः सुमनोहरैः ॥ 18 ॥
4.23.m: anointing Śiva with sandalwood and Pārvatī with kumkuma, / she should then worship them with fragrant, delightful flowers.

4.23.s:
veṣṭayecchuklavastreṇa śivaṃ raktena pārvatīm ..
paścāddhūpaṃ dahennārī bhaktibhāvena bhāvitā .. 19 ..
4.23.d:
वेष्टयेच्छुक्लवस्त्रेण शिवं रक्तेन पार्वतीम् ॥
पश्चाद्धूपं दहेन्नारी भक्तिभावेन भाविता ॥ 19 ॥
4.23.m: She should clothe Śiva in a white garment and Pārvatī in a red one; / filled with the feeling of devotion, the woman should then burn incense.

4.23.s:
bhojayecchivabhaktāṃśca brāhmaṇānvedapāragān ..
bhaktebhyo dakṣiṇā deyā bhaktyā śāṭhyavivarjitā .. 4.23.20 ..
4.23.d:
भोजयेच्छिवभक्तांश्च ब्राह्मणान्वेदपारगान् ॥
भक्तेभ्यो दक्षिणा देया भक्त्या शाठ्यविवर्जिता ॥ 4.23.20 ॥
4.23.m: She should feed devotees of Śiva and brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas; / a priestly fee should be given with devotion to the devotees, free of deceit.

4.23.s:
tataḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya idamuccārayedbudhaḥ ..
umāmaheśvarau devau sarvalokapitāmahau ..
vratenānena suprītau bhavetāṃ mama sarvadā .. 21 ..
4.23.d:
ततः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य इदमुच्चारयेद्बुधः ॥
उमामहेश्वरौ देवौ सर्वलोकपितामहौ ॥
व्रतेनानेन सुप्रीतौ भवेतां मम सर्वदा ॥ 21 ॥
4.23.m: Then, having circumambulated, the wise person should recite this: / “May the two deities, Umā and Maheśvara, the grandparents of all worlds, / be ever well pleased with me through this votive observance.”

4.23.s:
evamuktvā jitakrodhe brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
vrataṃ nivedayedbhaktyā vācake vā guṇānvite .. 22 ..
4.23.d:
एवमुक्त्वा जितक्रोधे ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ॥
व्रतं निवेदयेद्भक्त्या वाचके वा गुणान्विते ॥ 22 ॥
4.23.m: Having spoken thus, she should present the votive observance with devotion / to a brāhmaṇa who has subdued his anger and mastered the Vedas, or to a virtuous reciter.

4.23.s:
idaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ nārī maheśārpitamānasā ..
prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 23 ..
4.23.d:
इदं कृत्वा व्रतं नारी महेशार्पितमानसा ॥
प्रयाति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ॥ 23 ॥
4.23.m: Having performed this votive observance, a woman with mind fixed on Maheśa / goes to the supreme abode where the god Maheśvara resides.

4.23.s:
śivaloke vasettāvadyāvadindrāścaturddaśa ..
apsarobhiḥ parivṛtā kinnarībhistathaiva ca .. 24 ..
4.23.d:
शिवलोके वसेत्तावद्यावदिन्द्राश्चतुर्द्दश ॥
अप्सरोभिः परिवृता किन्नरीभिस्तथैव च ॥ 24 ॥
4.23.m: She dwells in the world of Śiva as long as fourteen Indras endure, / surrounded by apsarases and likewise by kinnarīs.

4.23.s:
yadā mānuṣyamāyāti jāyate vimale kule ..
rūpayauvanasaṃpannā bahuputrā pativratā .. 25 ..
4.23.d:
यदा मानुष्यमायाति जायते विमले कुले ॥
रूपयौवनसंपन्ना बहुपुत्रा पतिव्रता ॥ 25 ॥
4.23.m: When she returns to human birth, she is born in a pure family, / endowed with beauty and youth, possessed of many sons, and faithful to her husband.

4.23.s:
dhanadhānyasamāyukte suvarṇamaṇimaṃḍite ..
yāvajjīvaṃ gṛhe ramye tiṣṭhatyavyāhatendriyā .. 26 ..
4.23.d:
धनधान्यसमायुक्ते सुवर्णमणिमंडिते ॥
यावज्जीवं गृहे रम्ये तिष्ठत्यव्याहतेन्द्रिया ॥ 26 ॥
4.23.m: Endowed with wealth and grain, adorned with gold and jewels, / she remains for all her life in a delightful home, with unimpaired senses.

4.23.s:
viyogaṃ naiva sā paśyedbhartṛmitrasutādikaiḥ ..
mṛtā śivapuraṃ yāti śivagaurīprasādataḥ .. 27 ..
4.23.d:
वियोगं नैव सा पश्येद्भर्तृमित्रसुतादिकैः ॥
मृता शिवपुरं याति शिवगौरीप्रसादतः ॥ 27 ॥
4.23.m: She never witnesses separation from husband, friends, sons, and the like; / when dead, she goes to the city of Śiva by the grace of Śiva and Gaurī.

4.23.s:
haimīmumāṃ rajatapiṇḍamayaṃ maheśaṃ raupye surūpavṛṣabhe ca samāsthitau tau ..
sampūjya raktasitavastrayugāvagūḍhau nārī bhavatyavidhavā sutasaukhyayuktā .. 28 ..
rambhātṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.23.d:
हैमीमुमां रजतपिण्डमयं महेशं रौप्ये सुरूपवृषभे च समास्थितौ तौ ॥
सम्पूज्य रक्तसितवस्त्रयुगावगूढौ नारी भवत्यविधवा सुतसौख्ययुक्ता ॥ 28 ॥
रम्भातृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.23.m:
Having worshipped the golden Umā and Maheśa made of solid silver, seated upon a handsome silver bull / and clad in a pair of red and white garments, a woman does not become a widow, and is endowed with the happiness of sons.
Description of the Rambhātṛtīyā Votive Observance

4.24.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
raṃbhātṛtīyāṃ vakṣyāmi sarvapāpapraṇāśinīm ..
putrasaubhāgyaphaladāṃ sarvāmayanivāriṇīm .. 1 ..
4.24.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
रंभातृतीयां वक्ष्यामि सर्वपापप्रणाशिनीम् ॥
पुत्रसौभाग्यफलदां सर्वामयनिवारिणीम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.24.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / I will declare the Rambhātṛtīyā, which destroys all sins, / yields the fruit of sons and good fortune, and removes all diseases;

4.24.s:
sarvaduṣṭaharāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvasaukhyapradāṃ tathā ..
sapatnīdarpadalanāṃ tathaiśvaryaṃ karīṃ śivām .. 2 ..
4.24.d:
सर्वदुष्टहरां पुण्यां सर्वसौख्यप्रदां तथा ॥
सपत्नीदर्पदलनां तथैश्वर्यं करीं शिवाम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.24.m: which removes all evils, is holy, grants all happiness, / crushes the pride of co-wives, brings sovereign power, and is auspicious.

4.24.s:
śaṃkareṇa purā proktā pārvatyāḥ priyakāmyayā ..
tāmimāṃ śṛṇu bhūpāla sarvabhūtahitāya vai .. 3 ..
4.24.d:
शंकरेण पुरा प्रोक्ता पार्वत्याः प्रियकाम्यया ॥
तामिमां शृणु भूपाल सर्वभूतहिताय वै ॥ 3 ॥
4.24.m: It was declared in ancient times by Śaṅkara out of a desire to please Pārvatī; / hear this, O King, for the welfare of all beings.

4.24.s:
mārgaśīrṣe śubhe māsi tṛtī yāyāṃ narādhipa ..
śuklāyāṃ prātarutthāya daṃtadhāvanapūrvakam ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhaktibhāvitā .. 4 ..
4.24.d:
मार्गशीर्षे शुभे मासि तृती यायां नराधिप ॥
शुक्लायां प्रातरुत्थाय दंतधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
उपवासस्य नियमं गृह्णीयाद्भक्तिभाविता ॥ 4 ॥
4.24.m: In the auspicious month of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the third [lunar day] of the bright [fortnight], O ruler of men, / having risen in the morning and cleaned the teeth, / filled with devotion, she should undertake the rule of fasting:

4.24.s:
devi saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattṛtīyāyāmupo ṣitā ..
pratimāsaṃ kariṣyāmi pāraṇaṃ cāpare'hani ..
tadavighnena me yātu prasādāttava pārvati .. 5 ..
4.24.d:
देवि संवत्सरं यावत्तृतीयायामुपो षिता ॥
प्रतिमासं करिष्यामि पारणं चापरेऽहनि ॥
तदविघ्नेन मे यातु प्रसादात्तव पार्वति ॥ 5 ॥
4.24.m: “O Goddess, having fasted on the third [lunar day] every month for a year, / I will break my fast on the following day; / by your grace, O Pārvatī, may it pass without obstacle for me.”

4.24.s:
evaṃ saṃkalpya vidhivatkauṃteya kṛtaniścayaḥ ..
bhaktyā naro vā nārī vā snānaṃ kuryādataṃdritaḥ ..6..
4.24.d:
एवं संकल्प्य विधिवत्कौंतेय कृतनिश्चयः ॥
भक्त्या नरो वा नारी वा स्नानं कुर्यादतंद्रितः ॥6॥
4.24.m: Having thus made the formal resolve according to rule, O son of Kuntī, firm of purpose, / a man or a woman should bathe with devotion, without sloth.

4.24.s:
nadyāṃ taḍāge vāpyāṃ vā gṛhe vā niyatātmavān ..
pūjayetpārvatīṃ nāma rātrau prāśya kuśodakam.. .. 7 ..
4.24.d:
नद्यां तडागे वाप्यां वा गृहे वा नियतात्मवान् ॥
पूजयेत्पार्वतीं नाम रात्रौ प्राश्य कुशोदकम्॥ ॥ 7 ॥
4.24.m: In a river, a pond, a step-well, or in the house, with self-restraint, / one should worship the goddess named Pārvatī, after sipping kuśa-grass water at night.

4.24.s:
prabhāte bhojayedvidvāñchivabhaktānviśeṣataḥ ..
hiraṇyaṃ lavaṇaṃ caiva teṣāṃ dadyāttu dakṣiṇām ..
gaurīśvaraṃ yathāśakti bhojayetprayatā satī .. 8 ..
4.24.d:
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विद्वाञ्छिवभक्तान्विशेषतः ॥
हिरण्यं लवणं चैव तेषां दद्यात्तु दक्षिणाम् ॥
गौरीश्वरं यथाशक्ति भोजयेत्प्रयता सती ॥ 8 ॥
4.24.m: At dawn, the wise person should feed especially devotees of Śiva; / he should bestow upon them gold and salt as the priestly fee. / The devoted chaste woman should feed the Lord of Gaurī according to her means.

4.24.s:
anena vidhinā rājanyaḥ kuryānmāsi pauṣake ..
gomūtraṃ prāśayedrātrau prabhāte bhojayeddvijān .. 9 ..
4.24.d:
अनेन विधिना राजन्यः कुर्यान्मासि पौषके ॥
गोमूत्रं प्राशयेद्रात्रौ प्रभाते भोजयेद्द्विजान् ॥ 9 ॥
4.24.m: Whoever performs this rite in the month of Pauṣa according to this rule, O king: / she should sip cow-urine at night, and at dawn feed the twice-born.

4.24.s:
hiraṇyaṃ jīrakaṃ caiva svaśaktyā dāpayettataḥ ..
kaḍuhuṃḍaṃ ca kanakaṃ tebhyo dattvā visarjayet .. 4.24.10 ..
4.24.d:
हिरण्यं जीरकं चैव स्वशक्त्या दापयेत्ततः ॥
कडुहुंडं च कनकं तेभ्यो दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥ 4.24.10 ॥
4.24.m: Then, according to her capacity, she should give gold and cumin seeds. / Bestowing on them a sweetmeat and gold, she should dismiss them.

4.24.s:
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ ..
śakraloke vasetkalpaṃ tataḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet .. 11 ..
4.24.d:
वाजपेयातिरात्राभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः ॥
शक्रलोके वसेत्कल्पं ततः शिवपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.24.m: Without doubt, she attains the fruit of both the Vājapeya and the Atirātra sacrifices. / She dwells in the realm of Śakra for a kalpa, and thence goes to the city of Śiva.

4.24.s:
māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ sudevīṃ nāma pūjayet ..
gomayaṃ prāśayedrātrau tataścaikākinī svapet .. 12 ..
4.24.d:
माघे मासि तृतीयायां सुदेवीं नाम पूजयेत् ॥
गोमयं प्राशयेद्रात्रौ ततश्चैकाकिनी स्वपेत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.24.m: In the month of Māgha, on the third lunar day, she should worship the goddess named Sudevī; / she should ingest cow-dung at night, and then sleep alone.

4.24.s:
prātaḥ kusuṃbhaṃ kanakaṃ dadyā cchaktyā dvijātiṣu ..
viṣṇuloke ciraṃ sthitvā prāpnoti śivasāmyatām .. 13 ..
4.24.d:
प्रातः कुसुंभं कनकं दद्या च्छक्त्या द्विजातिषु ॥
विष्णुलोके चिरं स्थित्वा प्राप्नोति शिवसाम्यताम् ॥ 13 ॥
4.24.m: In the morning, she should give safflower and gold according to her capacity to the twice-born. / Dwelling for a long time in the world of Viṣṇu, she attains equality with Śiva.

4.24.s:
gaurīti phālgune nāma gokṣīraṃ prāśayenniśi ..
prabhāte bhojayedvidvāñchivabhaktānsuvāsinīḥ .. 14 ..
4.24.d:
गौरीति फाल्गुने नाम गोक्षीरं प्राशयेन्निशि ॥
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विद्वाञ्छिवभक्तान्सुवासिनीः ॥ 14 ॥
4.24.m: In Phālguna, she should worship the name Gaurī, and sip cow's milk at night; / at dawn, the wise woman should feed devotees of Śiva and married women.

4.24.s:
kaḍuhuṃḍaṃ sakanakaṃ tebhyo dattvā visarjayet ..
vājapeyātirātrābhyāṃ phalaṃ prāpnotyasaṃśayaḥ ..15..
4.24.d:
कडुहुंडं सकनकं तेभ्यो दत्त्वा विसर्जयेत् ॥
वाजपेयातिरात्राभ्यां फलं प्राप्नोत्यसंशयः ॥15॥
4.24.m: Bestowing a sweetmeat together with gold upon them, she should dismiss them. / She attains without doubt the fruit of both the Vājapeya and the Atirātra sacrifices.

4.24.s:
caitre māsi viśālākṣīṃ pūjayedbhaktitatparā ..
dadhi prāśya svapetprātardadyāddhema sakuṃkumam ..
saubhāgyaṃ mahadāpnoti viśālākṣyāḥ prasādataḥ .. 16 ..
4.24.d:
चैत्रे मासि विशालाक्षीं पूजयेद्भक्तितत्परा ॥
दधि प्राश्य स्वपेत्प्रातर्दद्याद्धेम सकुंकुमम् ॥
सौभाग्यं महदाप्नोति विशालाक्ष्याः प्रसादतः ॥ 16 ॥
4.24.m: In the month of Caitra, intent on devotion, she should worship Viśālākṣī; / having tasted curds, she should sleep, and at dawn give gold with saffron. / She attains great fortune by the grace of Viśālākṣī.

4.24.s:
vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ śrīmukhīṃ nāma pūjayet ..
ghṛtaṃ ca prāśayedrātrau tataścaikākinī svapet .. 17 ..
4.24.d:
वैशाखस्य तृतीयायां श्रीमुखीं नाम पूजयेत् ॥
घृतं च प्राशयेद्रात्रौ ततश्चैकाकिनी स्वपेत् ॥ 17 ॥
4.24.m: On the third lunar day of Vaiśākha, she should worship the goddess named Śrīmukhī; / she should sip clarified butter at night, and then sleep alone.

4.24.s:
śivabhaktāndvijānprātarbhojayitvā yathepsitam ..
tāṃbūla lavaṇaṃ dattvā praṇipatya visarjayet ..
anena vidhinā dattvā putrānāpnoti śobhanān .. 18 ..
4.24.d:
शिवभक्तान्द्विजान्प्रातर्भोजयित्वा यथेप्सितम् ॥
तांबूल लवणं दत्त्वा प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा पुत्रानाप्नोति शोभनान् ॥ 18 ॥
4.24.m: In the morning, having fed the twice-born devotees of Śiva to their satisfaction, / and having given betel and salt, she should bow down and dismiss them. / Giving according to this rule, she obtains splendid sons.

4.24.s:
āṣāḍhe mādhavīṃ natvā prāśnīyācca tilodakam ..
prabhāte bhojayedviprāndakṣiṇāyāṃ guḍaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
sakāṃcanaḥ śubhāṃllokānprāpnoti hi na saṃśayaḥ .. 19 ..
4.24.d:
आषाढे माधवीं नत्वा प्राश्नीयाच्च तिलोदकम् ॥
प्रभाते भोजयेद्विप्रान्दक्षिणायां गुडः स्मृतः ॥
सकांचनः शुभांल्लोकान्प्राप्नोति हि न संशयः ॥ 19 ॥
4.24.m: In Āṣāḍha, having bowed to Mādhavī, she should drink sesame water. / At dawn she should feed the Brahmins; jaggery is prescribed for the priestly fee, / along with gold; she certainly attains auspicious worlds, there is no doubt.

4.24.s:
śrāvaṇe tu śriyaṃ pūjya pibedgośṛṃgajaṃ jalam ..
śivabhaktāṃśca saṃpūjya dayāddhemaphalaiḥ saha ..
sarvalokeśvaro bhūtvā sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt .. 4.24.20 ..
4.24.d:
श्रावणे तु श्रियं पूज्य पिबेद्गोशृंगजं जलम् ॥
शिवभक्तांश्च संपूज्य दयाद्धेमफलैः सह ॥
सर्वलोकेश्वरो भूत्वा सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 4.24.20 ॥
4.24.m: In Śrāvaṇa, having worshipped Śrī, she should drink water sprinkled from a cow’s horn. / And having worshipped the devotees of Śiva, she should give [gifts] along with gold and fruits; / becoming lord of all realms, she would obtain all desires.

4.24.s:
bhādre caiva tṛtīyāyāṃ haratālīti pūja yet ..
māhiṣaṃ ca pibeddugdhaṃ saubhāgyamatulaṃ labhet ..
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā cāṃte śivapuraṃ brajet .. 21 ..
4.24.d:
भाद्रे चैव तृतीयायां हरतालीति पूज येत् ॥
माहिषं च पिबेद्दुग्धं सौभाग्यमतुलं लभेत् ॥
इह लोके सुखं भुक्त्वा चांते शिवपुरं ब्रजेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.24.m: On the third lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada, she should worship Haratālī, / and drink buffalo milk; she obtains incomparable fortune. / Having enjoyed happiness in this world, at the end she goes to the city of Śiva.

4.24.s:
āśvine tu tṛtīyāyāṃ giriputrīti pūjayet ..
saṃprāśya taṇḍulajalaṃ prātarviprāṃśca pūjayet ..22..
4.24.d:
आश्विने तु तृतीयायां गिरिपुत्रीति पूजयेत् ॥
संप्राश्य तण्डुलजलं प्रातर्विप्रांश्च पूजयेत् ॥22॥
4.24.m: On the third lunar day in Āśvina, she should worship Giriputrī. / Having consumed rice-water, she should worship Brahmins at dawn.

4.24.s:
dakṣiṇā cāpi nirdiṣṭā kanakaṃ ca sacandanam ..
sarvayajñaphalaṃ prāpya gaurīloke mahī yate .. 23 ..
4.24.d:
दक्षिणा चापि निर्दिष्टा कनकं च सचन्दनम् ॥
सर्वयज्ञफलं प्राप्य गौरीलोके मही यते ॥ 23 ॥
4.24.m: Gold together with sandalwood is also prescribed as the priestly fee. / Having obtained the fruit of all sacrifices, she is honoured in the world of Gaurī.

4.24.s:
padmodbhavā kārtike ca pañcagavyaṃ pibettataḥ ..
rātrau prajāgaraṃ kuryātprabhāte bhojayeddvijān .. 24 ..
4.24.d:
पद्मोद्भवा कार्तिके च पञ्चगव्यं पिबेत्ततः ॥
रात्रौ प्रजागरं कुर्यात्प्रभाते भोजयेद्द्विजान् ॥ 24 ॥
4.24.m: In Kārtika, she should worship Padmodbhavā, and then drink the five products of the cow; / she should keep a night-vigil, and feed the twice-born at dawn.

4.24.s:
sapatnīkāñchubhācārānmālyavastra vibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
pūjayecchivabhaktāṃśca kumārīścaiva bhojayet .. 25 ..
4.24.d:
सपत्नीकाञ्छुभाचारान्माल्यवस्त्र विभूषणैः ॥
पूजयेच्छिवभक्तांश्च कुमारीश्चैव भोजयेत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.24.m: Accompanied by their wives, men of auspicious conduct, / she should worship the devotees of Śiva with garlands, garments, and ornaments, and feed young maidens.

4.24.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ samāpte kārayennṛpa ..
yathāvibhavasāreṇa vitānaṃ pañcavarṇakam .. .. 26 ..
4.24.d:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं समाप्ते कारयेन्नृप ॥
यथाविभवसारेण वितानं पञ्चवर्णकम् ॥ ॥ 26 ॥
4.24.m: At the conclusion, O king, she should have made an image of Umā and Maheśvara of gold / and, according to the measure of her wealth, a canopy of five colours.

4.24.s:
aśanaṃ ca śubhaṃ dadyācchvetacchatraṃ kamaṃḍalum ..
pādukopānahau divyairvastrayugmaiśca pāṃḍava .. 27 ..
4.24.d:
अशनं च शुभं दद्याच्छ्वेतच्छत्रं कमंडलुम् ॥
पादुकोपानहौ दिव्यैर्वस्त्रयुग्मैश्च पांडव ॥ 27 ॥
4.24.m: And she should present auspicious food, a white royal parasol, an ascetic's waterpot, / sandals and shoes, and pairs of celestial garments, O Pāṇḍava,

4.24.s:
pītayajñopavītaiśca dīpanetraiḥ samujjvalaiḥ ..
śaṃkhaśuktisamopetairddarpaṇaiśca suśobhitaiḥ ..28..
4.24.d:
पीतयज्ञोपवीतैश्च दीपनेत्रैः समुज्ज्वलैः ॥
शंखशुक्तिसमोपेतैर्द्दर्पणैश्च सुशोभितैः ॥28॥
4.24.m: and yellow sacred threads, radiant with eyes of lamps, / accompanied by conches and oyster shells, and adorned with mirrors.

4.24.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ sthāpya pūjayitvā yathāvidhi ..
nānāvidhaiḥ sugandhaiśca patraiḥ puṣpaiḥ phalaistathā .. 29 ..
4.24.d:
उमामहेश्वरं स्थाप्य पूजयित्वा यथाविधि ॥
नानाविधैः सुगन्धैश्च पत्रैः पुष्पैः फलैस्तथा ॥ 29 ॥
4.24.m: Having installed Umā and Maheśvara and worshipped [them] according to rule / with various fragrances, leaves, flowers, and fruits,

4.24.s:
ghṛtapakvaiśca naivedyairdīpamālābhireva ca ..
śarkarānālikeraiśca dāḍimairbījapūrakaiḥ .. 4.24.30 ..
4.24.d:
घृतपक्वैश्च नैवेद्यैर्दीपमालाभिरेव च ॥
शर्करानालिकेरैश्च दाडिमैर्बीजपूरकैः ॥ 4.24.30 ॥
4.24.m: and with food-offerings cooked in clarified butter, with rows of lamps, / with sugar and coconuts, pomegranates and citrons,

4.24.s:
jīrakairlavaṇaiścaiva kusumbhaiḥ kuṃkumaistathā ..
satāmrabhājanairdivyodakai rasasaṃyutaiḥ ..
pūjayeddevadeveśaṃ kṣamayettadanaṃtaram .. 31 ..
4.24.d:
जीरकैर्लवणैश्चैव कुसुम्भैः कुंकुमैस्तथा ॥
सताम्रभाजनैर्दिव्योदकै रससंयुतैः ॥
पूजयेद्देवदेवेशं क्षमयेत्तदनंतरम् ॥ 31 ॥
4.24.m: and with cumin, salts, safflowers, and saffron, / along with copper vessels containing divine water imbued with juices, / she should worship the Lord of the gods of gods, and thereafter ask for forgiveness,

4.24.s:
śaṃkhavāditranirghoṣairvedadhvanisamanvitaiḥ ..
evaṃ kṛte phalaṃ yatsyāttanna śakyaṃ mayoditum .. 32 ..
4.24.d:
शंखवादित्रनिर्घोषैर्वेदध्वनिसमन्वितैः ॥
एवं कृते फलं यत्स्यात्तन्न शक्यं मयोदितुम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.24.m: to the sounds of conches and musical instruments, accompanied by Vedic chanting. / The fruit that comes when this is performed cannot be told by me.

4.24.s:
pūrvoktaphalabhāgī syātsarvadevaiśca pūjyate ..
kalpakoṭiśataṃ yāvatsarvakāmānavāpnuyāt .. 33 ..
4.24.d:
पूर्वोक्तफलभागी स्यात्सर्वदेवैश्च पूज्यते ॥
कल्पकोटिशतं यावत्सर्वकामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 33 ॥
4.24.m: She shares in the fruit described before and is worshipped by all the gods; / she obtains all desires for a hundred crores of kalpas.

4.24.s:
tadaṃte śivasāyujyaṃ prāpnotīha na saṃśayaḥ ..
puraitadraṃbhayā cīrṇaṃ tena raṃbhāvrataṃ smṛtam .. 34 ..
4.24.d:
तदंते शिवसायुज्यं प्राप्नोतीह न संशयः ॥
पुरैतद्रंभया चीर्णं तेन रंभाव्रतं स्मृतम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.24.m: At the end of that, she attains intimate union with Śiva here, of this there is no doubt. / Formerly this was performed by Rambhā; therefore it is remembered as the Rambhā-vrata.

4.24.s:
yo'haṃ sā ca smṛtā gaurī yā gaurī sa maheśvaraḥ ..
iti matvā mahārāja śaraṇaṃ vraja pārvatīm .. 35..
4.24.d:
योऽहं सा च स्मृता गौरी या गौरी स महेश्वरः ॥
इति मत्वा महाराज शरणं व्रज पार्वतीम् ॥ 35॥
4.24.m: He who is I is known as Gaurī, and she who is Gaurī is Maheśvara. / Considering this, O great king, go for refuge to Pārvatī.

4.24.s:
eṣā himādriduhiturdayitā tṛtīyā raṃbhāvidhānamalabhadbhuvi tatkṛteti.. satprāśitairuditanāmayutāmupoṣya prāpnoti vāṃchitaphalānyabalā bahūni ..36..
saubhāgyāṣṭakavarṇanam
4.24.d:
एषा हिमाद्रिदुहितुर्दयिता तृतीया रंभाविधानमलभद्भुवि तत्कृतेति॥ सत्प्राशितैरुदितनामयुतामुपोष्य प्राप्नोति वांछितफलान्यबला बहूनि ॥36॥
सौभाग्याष्टकवर्णनम्
4.24.m:
This third lunar day, dear to the daughter of the snowy mountain, acquired on earth the name ‘the rite of Rambhā’ because it was performed by her. / Having fasted [on it], dedicated to the stated names, with the prescribed ingestions, a woman obtains many desired fruits.
Description of the Eightfold Fortune

4.25.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tathaivānyatpravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
saubhāgyaśayanaṃ nāma yatpurāṇavido viduḥ .. 1 ..
4.25.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तथैवान्यत्प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥
सौभाग्यशयनं नाम यत्पुराणविदो विदुः ॥ 1 ॥
4.25.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Just so, I shall describe another [rite] that grants the fruit of all desires, / named Saubhāgyaśayana, which the knowers of the Purāṇas know.

4.25.s:
purā dagdheṣu lokeṣu bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmahādiṣu ..
saubhāgyaṃ sarvalokānāmekasthamabhavattadā .. 2 ..
4.25.d:
पुरा दग्धेषु लोकेषु भूर्भुवःस्वर्महादिषु ॥
सौभाग्यं सर्वलोकानामेकस्थमभवत्तदा ॥ 2 ॥
4.25.m: Formerly, when the worlds—Bhūḥ, Bhuvaḥ, Svaḥ, Mahaḥ, and the rest—were burnt, / the fortune of all the worlds then became concentrated into one.

4.25.s:
tacca vaikuṇṭhamāsādya viṣṇorvakṣasthale sthitam ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā punaḥ sargavidhau nṛpa .. 3 ..
4.25.d:
तच्च वैकुण्ठमासाद्य विष्णोर्वक्षस्थले स्थितम् ॥
ततः कालेन महता पुनः सर्गविधौ नृप ॥ 3 ॥
4.25.m: Reaching Vaikuṇṭha, it resided upon the chest of Viṣṇu. / Then, after a great period of time, at the time of the creation once again, O king,

4.25.s:
ahaṃkārāvṛte loke pradhānapuruṣānvite ..
sparddhāyāṃ ca pravṛttāyāṃ kamalāsanakṛṣṇayoḥ .. 4 ..
4.25.d:
अहंकारावृते लोके प्रधानपुरुषान्विते ॥
स्पर्द्धायां च प्रवृत्तायां कमलासनकृष्णयोः ॥ 4 ॥
4.25.m: when the world was enveloped in egoity and endowed with the Primary Cause and the Cosmic Person, / and a rivalry arose between the lotus-seated Brahmā and Kṛṣṇa,

4.25.s:
piṃgākārā samudbhūtā jvālā vakṣasthalī tadā ..
tayābhitaptasya harervakṣasastadviniḥsṛtam .. 5 ..
4.25.d:
पिंगाकारा समुद्भूता ज्वाला वक्षस्थली तदा ॥
तयाभितप्तस्य हरेर्वक्षसस्तद्विनिःसृतम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.25.m: a tawny-coloured flame then arose on the chest. / Tormented by it, from the chest of Hari it came forth.

4.25.s:
yadvakṣasthalamāśritya viṣṇoḥ saubhāgyamāsthitam ..
rasarūpatayā tāvatprāpnoti vasudhātalam .. 6 ..
4.25.d:
यद्वक्षस्थलमाश्रित्य विष्णोः सौभाग्यमास्थितम् ॥
रसरूपतया तावत्प्राप्नोति वसुधातलम् ॥ 6 ॥
4.25.m: That fortune of Viṣṇu, which had rested upon his chest, / then reached the surface of the earth in the form of a liquid essence.

4.25.s:
utkṣiptamantarikṣasthaṃ brahmaputreṇa dhīmatā ..
dakṣeṇa pītamātraṃ tu rūpalāvaṇyakāraṇam .. 7 ..
4.25.d:
उत्क्षिप्तमन्तरिक्षस्थं ब्रह्मपुत्रेण धीमता ॥
दक्षेण पीतमात्रं तु रूपलावण्यकारणम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.25.m: Cast up into the middle region of the sky, by Dakṣa, the wise son of Brahmā, / it was only swallowed, becoming the source of beauty and charm;

4.25.s:
balaṃ tejo mahajjātaṃ dakṣasya parameṣṭhinaḥ ..
śeṣaṃ yadapatadbhūmāvaṣṭadhā tadajāyata .. 8 ..
4.25.d:
बलं तेजो महज्जातं दक्षस्य परमेष्ठिनः ॥
शेषं यदपतद्भूमावष्टधा तदजायत ॥ 8 ॥
4.25.m: great strength and splendour arose in Dakṣa, the creator. / What remained fell upon the earth, and became divided into eight parts.

4.25.s:
ikṣavastavarājaṃ ca niṣpāvājājidhānyakam ..
vikāravacca gokṣīraṃ kusumbhaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tathā ..
lavaṇaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ tatra saubhāgyāṣṭakamucyate .. 9 ..
4.25.d:
इक्षवस्तवराजं च निष्पावाजाजिधान्यकम् ॥
विकारवच्च गोक्षीरं कुसुम्भं कुंकुमं तथा ॥
लवणं चाष्टमं तत्र सौभाग्याष्टकमुच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
4.25.m: Sugarcanes, tavarāja sugar, niṣpāva beans, cumin, grain, / and curdled cow’s milk, safflower, and saffron, / and salt as the eighth among them—this is called the group of eight auspicious gifts.

4.25.s:
pītaṃ yadbrahmaputreṇa yogajñānavidā tathā ..
duhitāsyābhavattasmādyā satītyabhidhīyate ..
lokānatītya lālityāllalitā tena cocyate .. 4.25.10 ..
4.25.d:
पीतं यद्ब्रह्मपुत्रेण योगज्ञानविदा तथा ॥
दुहितास्याभवत्तस्माद्या सतीत्यभिधीयते ॥
लोकानतीत्य लालित्याल्ललिता तेन चोच्यते ॥ 4.25.10 ॥
4.25.m: That which was drunk by the son of Brahmā, knower of yoga and spiritual knowledge, / from that he had a daughter who is known as Satī; / surpassing all worlds in grace, she is therefore called Lalitā.

4.25.s:
trailokyasuṃdarīmenāmupayeme pinākadhṛk ..
triviśvasaubhāgyamayī bhukti muktiphalapradā .. 11 ..
4.25.d:
त्रैलोक्यसुंदरीमेनामुपयेमे पिनाकधृक् ॥
त्रिविश्वसौभाग्यमयी भुक्ति मुक्तिफलप्रदा ॥ 11 ॥
4.25.m: The bearer of the Pināka married this beauty of the three worlds; / she is full of auspicious fortune for the threefold world, bestowing the fruits of enjoyment and liberation.

4.25.s: ārādhya tāmumāṃ bhaktyā strī rājankinna vindati .. 12 ..
4.25.d: आराध्य तामुमां भक्त्या स्त्री राजन्किन्न विन्दति ॥ 12 ॥
4.25.m: By worshipping that Umā with devotion, O king, what does a woman not obtain?

4.25.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathamārādhanaṃ tasyā jagaddhātryā janārdana ..
yadvidhānaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ jagannātha vadasva me .. 13 ..
4.25.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कथमाराधनं तस्या जगद्धात्र्या जनार्दन ॥
यद्विधानं च तत्सर्वं जगन्नाथ वदस्व मे ॥ 13 ॥
4.25.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How should that supporter of the universe be worshipped, O Janārdana? / Tell me all of that procedure, O Jagannātha.

4.25.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vasaṃtamāsamāsādya tṛtīyāyāṃ yudhiṣṭhira ..
śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhne tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 14 ..
4.25.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
वसंतमासमासाद्य तृतीयायां युधिष्ठिर ॥
शुक्लपक्षस्य पूर्वाह्ने तिलैः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.25.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / When the spring month arrives, on the third lunar day / of the bright fortnight, in the forenoon, one should bathe with sesame seeds.

4.25.s:
tasminnahani sā devī kila viśvātmanā satī ..
pāṇigrahaṇakairmantrairudvāhyā varavarṇinī..15..
4.25.d:
तस्मिन्नहनि सा देवी किल विश्वात्मना सती ॥
पाणिग्रहणकैर्मन्त्रैरुद्वाह्या वरवर्णिनी॥15॥
4.25.m: On that very day, it is told, that goddess Satī, of excellent complexion, / was married by the Soul of the Universe with mantras of hand-taking.

4.25.s:
tathā sahaiva deveśaṃ tṛtīyāyāmathārcayet ..
phalairnānāvidhairdhūpadīpanaivedyasaṃyutaiḥ .. 16 ..
4.25.d:
तथा सहैव देवेशं तृतीयायामथार्चयेत् ॥
फलैर्नानाविधैर्धूपदीपनैवेद्यसंयुतैः ॥ 16 ॥
4.25.m: Therefore on the third lunar day one should worship the Lord of gods together with her, / with various kinds of fruits accompanied by incense, lamps, and food offerings.

4.25.s:
pañcagavyenānumāsaṃ tathā gaṃdhodakena ca ..
snapayitvā rcayedgaurīminduśekharasaṃyutām .. 17 ..
4.25.d:
पञ्चगव्येनानुमासं तथा गंधोदकेन च ॥
स्नपयित्वा र्चयेद्गौरीमिन्दुशेखरसंयुताम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.25.m: Bathing [her] month by month with the five bovine substances and perfumed water, / one should worship Gaurī joined with the Moon-crested Lord.

4.25.s:
pāṭalāṃ śaṃbhusahitāṃ pādayostu prapūjayet ..
triyugāṃ śivasaṃyuktāṃ gulphayorubhayorapi .. 18 ..
4.25.d:
पाटलां शंभुसहितां पादयोस्तु प्रपूजयेत् ॥
त्रियुगां शिवसंयुक्तां गुल्फयोरुभयोरपि ॥ 18 ॥
4.25.m: One should worship Pāṭalā together with Śambhu upon the feet, / and Triyugā accompanied by Śiva upon both ankles,

4.25.s:
bhadreśvareṇa sahitāṃ vijayāṃ jānunoryuge ..
īśānīṃ harikeśaṃ ca kaṭyāṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ .. 19 ..
4.25.d:
भद्रेश्वरेण सहितां विजयां जानुनोर्युगे ॥
ईशानीं हरिकेशं च कट्यां संपूजयेद्बुधः ॥ 19 ॥
4.25.m: Vijayā together with Bhadreśvara upon the pair of knees; / the wise one should worship Īśānī and Harikeśa upon the waist,

4.25.s:
koṭanīṃ śūlinaṃ kukṣau maṃgalāṃ śarvasaṃyutām ..
udare pūjayedrāja nnumāṃ rudraṃ kucadvaye .. 4.25.20 ..
4.25.d:
कोटनीं शूलिनं कुक्षौ मंगलां शर्वसंयुताम् ॥
उदरे पूजयेद्राज न्नुमां रुद्रं कुचद्वये ॥ 4.25.20 ॥
4.25.m: Koṭanī and the Trident-bearer upon the belly, Maṅgalā joined with Śarva / upon the abdomen, O king, and Umā and Rudra upon the pair of breasts,

4.25.s:
anaṃtāṃ tripuraghraṃ ca pūjayetkarasaṃpuṭe ..
kaṃṭhe bhavaṃ bhavānīṃ ca mukhe gaurīṃ haraṃ tathā .. 21 ..
4.25.d:
अनंतां त्रिपुरघ्रं च पूजयेत्करसंपुटे ॥
कंठे भवं भवानीं च मुखे गौरीं हरं तथा ॥ 21 ॥
4.25.m: Anantā and the Destroyer of Tripura upon the joined hands, / Bhava and Bhavānī upon the throat, and Gaurī and Hara upon the face,

4.25.s:
sarvātmanā ca sahitāṃ lalitāṃ mastakopari ..
oṃkārapūrvakairetairnnamaskārāṃtayojitaiḥ ..
pūjayedbhaktisahito gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 22 ..
4.25.d:
सर्वात्मना च सहितां ललितां मस्तकोपरि ॥
ओंकारपूर्वकैरेतैर्न्नमस्कारांतयोजितैः ॥
पूजयेद्भक्तिसहितो गन्धमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.25.m: and Lalitā together with the Universal Soul upon the head. / With these names preceded by ‘Oṃ’ and ending with ‘namaḥ’, / one should worship, endowed with devotion, using perfumes, garlands, and ointments.

4.25.s:
evamabhyarcya vidhivatsaubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ ..
sthāpayetsvinnaniṣpāvānkusuṃbhaṃ kṣīrajīrakam .. 23 ..
4.25.d:
एवमभ्यर्च्य विधिवत्सौभाग्याष्टकमग्रतः ॥
स्थापयेत्स्विन्ननिष्पावान्कुसुंभं क्षीरजीरकम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.25.m: Having thus worshipped according to rule, one should place the eight auspicious gifts in front: / boiled niṣpāva beans, safflower, milk, cumin,

4.25.s:
tavarājekṣulavaṇaṃ kuṃkumaṃ ca tathāṣṭamam ..
dattaṃ saubhāgyakaṃ yasmātsaubhāgyāṣṭa kamucyate .. 24 ..
4.25.d:
तवराजेक्षुलवणं कुंकुमं च तथाष्टमम् ॥
दत्तं सौभाग्यकं यस्मात्सौभाग्याष्ट कमुच्यते ॥ 24 ॥
4.25.m: tavarāja sugar, sugarcane, and salt, with saffron as the eighth. / Because it bestows good fortune, it is called the eight auspicious gifts.

4.25.s:
evaṃ nivedya tatsarvaṃ śivayoḥ prīyatāmiti ..
caitre śṛṃgodakaṃ prāśya svapyādbhūmāvariṃdama ..25 ..
4.25.d:
एवं निवेद्य तत्सर्वं शिवयोः प्रीयतामिति ॥
चैत्रे शृंगोदकं प्राश्य स्वप्याद्भूमावरिंदम ॥25 ॥
4.25.m: Having thus offered all that, [saying] ‘May the two Śivas be pleased,’ / and having drunk water from a horn in Caitra, one should sleep on the ground, O subduer of enemies.

4.25.s:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtaprāṇa jayaḥ śuciḥ ..
saṃpūjya dvijadāṃpatyaṃ mālyavastravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
saubhāgyāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ sauvarṇacaraṇadvayam .. 26 ..
4.25.d:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय कृतप्राण जयः शुचिः ॥
संपूज्य द्विजदांपत्यं माल्यवस्त्रविभूषणैः ॥
सौभाग्याष्टकसंयुक्तं सौवर्णचरणद्वयम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.25.m: Then, rising in the morning, having controlled one’s breath, purified, / having worshipped a brāhmaṇa couple with garlands, clothes, and ornaments, / [and offering] a golden pair of feet together with the eight auspicious gifts,

4.25.s:
prīyatāmatra lalitā brāhmaṇāya nive dayet..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattṛtīyāyāṃ sadā nṛpa .. 27 ..
4.25.d:
प्रीयतामत्र ललिता ब्राह्मणाय निवे दयेत्॥
एवं संवत्सरं यावत्तृतीयायां सदा नृप ॥ 27 ॥
4.25.m: he should present it to the brāhmaṇa, [saying] ‘May Lalitā be pleased here.’ / In this way, O king, on the third lunar day throughout a year,

4.25.s:
prāśane nāmamaṃtre ca viśeṣo'yaṃ nibodha me ..
gośṛṃgodakamādye syādvaiśākhe gomayaṃ punaḥ .. 28 ..
4.25.d:
प्राशने नाममंत्रे च विशेषोऽयं निबोध मे ॥
गोशृंगोदकमाद्ये स्याद्वैशाखे गोमयं पुनः ॥ 28 ॥
4.25.m: learn from me this particular rule regarding the sip and the name-mantra: / in the first [month] it should be water from a cow’s horn, and in Vaiśākha cow dung;

4.25.s:
jyeṣṭhe maṃdārapuṣpaṃ ca bilvapatraṃ śucau smṛṃtam ..
śrāvaṇe dadhi saṃprāśyaṃ nabhasye ca kuśodakam .. 29 ..
4.25.d:
ज्येष्ठे मंदारपुष्पं च बिल्वपत्रं शुचौ स्मृंतम् ॥
श्रावणे दधि संप्राश्यं नभस्ये च कुशोदकम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.25.m: in Jyeṣṭha a mandāra flower, and in Śuci a bilva leaf is prescribed; / in Śrāvaṇa curd is to be consumed, and in Nabhasya kuśa-water;

4.25.s:
kṣīramāśvayuje tadvatkārtike pṛṣa dājyakam ..
mṛgottamāṃge gomūtraṃ pauṣe saṃprāśayedghṛtam ..4.25.30..
4.25.d:
क्षीरमाश्वयुजे तद्वत्कार्तिके पृष दाज्यकम् ॥
मृगोत्तमांगे गोमूत्रं पौषे संप्राशयेद्घृतम् ॥4.25.30॥
4.25.m: likewise milk in Āśvayuja, and clotted ghee in Kārtika; / cow urine in Mṛgaśīrṣa, and in Pauṣa one should consume clarified butter;

4.25.s:
māghe kṛṣṇatilāṃstadvatpañcagavyaṃ ca phālgune ..
lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śritā ..31..
4.25.d:
माघे कृष्णतिलांस्तद्वत्पञ्चगव्यं च फाल्गुने ॥
ललिता विजया भद्रा भवानी कुमुदा श्रिता ॥31॥
4.25.m: likewise black sesame in Māgha, and the five bovine substances in Phālguna. / Lalitā, Vijayā, Bhadrā, Bhavānī, Kumudā, Śritā,

4.25.s:
vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī ..
umā ca dānakāle tu prīyatāmiti kīrtayet ..32..
4.25.d:
वासुदेवी तथा गौरी मङ्गला कमला सती ॥
उमा च दानकाले तु प्रीयतामिति कीर्तयेत् ॥32॥
4.25.m: Vāsudevī, and Gaurī, Maṅgalā, Kamalā, Satī, / and Umā—at the time of the gift one should proclaim, ‘May she be pleased.’

4.25.s:
mallikāśokakamalakadaṃbotpalamālati ..
kuḍmalaṃ karavīraṃ ca bāṇamamlānakuṃkumam ..
siṃduvāraṃ ca māseṣu sarveṣu kramaśaḥ smṛtam .. 33 ..
4.25.d:
मल्लिकाशोककमलकदंबोत्पलमालति ॥
कुड्मलं करवीरं च बाणमम्लानकुंकुमम् ॥
सिंदुवारं च मासेषु सर्वेषु क्रमशः स्मृतम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.25.m: Jasmine, aśoka, lotus, kadamba, blue lotus, mālatī jasmine / bud, oleander, bāṇa, amlāna, saffron, / and sinduvāra are prescribed respectively in all the months.

4.25.s:
japākusuṃbhakusumaṃ mālatī śatapatrikā ..
yathālābhaṃ pradeyāni karavīraṃ ca sarvadā .. 34 ..
4.25.d:
जपाकुसुंभकुसुमं मालती शतपत्रिका ॥
यथालाभं प्रदेयानि करवीरं च सर्वदा ॥ 34 ॥
4.25.m: Hibiscus, safflower blossoms, mālatī jasmine, and the hundred-petalled rose / should be given as available, and oleander always.

4.25.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvadupoṣya vidhivannaraḥ ..
strī nakte tu kumārī vā śivāmabhyarcya śaktitaḥ ..
vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyātsarvopaskarasaṃyutam .. 35 ..
4.25.d:
एवं संवत्सरं यावदुपोष्य विधिवन्नरः ॥
स्त्री नक्ते तु कुमारी वा शिवामभ्यर्च्य शक्तितः ॥
व्रतांते शयनं दद्यात्सर्वोपस्करसंयुतम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.25.m: Having thus fasted according to rule for a whole year, a man, / or a woman or an unmarried girl taking a nocturnal meal, having worshipped Śivā to the best of their ability, / at the end of the votive observance should give a bed furnished with all accessories.

4.25.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ ca gavā saha ..
sthāpayitvā tu śayane brāhmaṇāya nivedayet .. 36..
4.25.d:
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं वृषभं च गवा सह ॥
स्थापयित्वा तु शयने ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥ 36॥
4.25.m: Having placed a golden Umā and Maheśvara and a bull along with a cow / upon the bed, one should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.25.s:
anyānyapi yathāśakti midhunānyaṃbarādibhiḥ ..
dhānyālaṃkaraṇairdānairanyaiśca dhanasaṃcayaiḥ ..
vittaśāṭhyena rahitaḥ pūjayedgatavismayaḥ .. 37 ..
4.25.d:
अन्यान्यपि यथाशक्ति मिधुनान्यंबरादिभिः ॥
धान्यालंकरणैर्दानैरन्यैश्च धनसंचयैः ॥
वित्तशाठ्येन रहितः पूजयेद्गतविस्मयः ॥ 37 ॥
4.25.m: To other couples as well, according to one's ability, with garments and the like, / with grain, ornaments, gifts, and other stores of wealth, / free from financial stinginess and free from arrogance, one should make offerings.

4.25.s:
evaṃ karoti yaḥ samyaksaubhāmyaśayanavratam ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti padaṃ cānantyamaśnute .. 38 ..
4.25.d:
एवं करोति यः सम्यक्सौभाम्यशयनव्रतम् ॥
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति पदं चानन्त्यमश्नुते ॥ 38 ॥
4.25.m: Whoever properly performs the Saubhāgyaśayana votive observance in this manner / obtains all desires and attains the imperishable abode.

4.25.s:
saubhāgyārogyarūpāyurvastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
na viyukto bhavedrājanvarṣāyutaśatatrayam .. 39 ..
4.25.d:
सौभाग्यारोग्यरूपायुर्वस्त्रालंकारभूषणैः ॥
न वियुक्तो भवेद्राजन्वर्षायुतशतत्रयम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.25.m: He will not be deprived of good fortune, health, beauty, long life, / garments, and jewelry, O king, for three hundred times ten thousand years.

4.25.s:
yastu dvādaśa varṣāṇi saubhāgyaśayanaṃ vratam ..
karoti sapta cāṣṭau vā śrīkaṇṭhabhuvaneśvaraiḥ ..
pūjyamāno bhavetsamya gyāvatkalpāyutatrayam .. 4.25.40 ..
4.25.d:
यस्तु द्वादश वर्षाणि सौभाग्यशयनं व्रतम् ॥
करोति सप्त चाष्टौ वा श्रीकण्ठभुवनेश्वरैः ॥
पूज्यमानो भवेत्सम्य ग्यावत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् ॥ 4.25.40 ॥
4.25.m: And he who performs the Saubhāgyaśayana votive observance for twelve years, / or seven or eight, shall be suitably worshipped / by the lords of the realm of Śrīkaṇṭha for thirty thousand kalpas.

4.25.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vā nareśvara ..
sāpi tatphalamāpnoti devyanugrahalālitā .. 41 ..
4.25.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु कुमारी वा नरेश्वर ॥
सापि तत्फलमाप्नोति देव्यनुग्रहलालिता ॥ 41 ॥
4.25.m: Or whatever woman or unmarried girl performs it, O lord of men, / she also attains that fruit, cherished by the goddess’s grace.

4.25.s:
śṛṇuyādapi yaścaitatpradadyādatha vā matim ..
so'pi vidyādharo bhūtvā svargaloke ciraṃ vaset .. 42 ..
4.25.d:
शृणुयादपि यश्चैतत्प्रदद्यादथ वा मतिम् ॥
सोऽपि विद्याधरो भूत्वा स्वर्गलोके चिरं वसेत् ॥ 42 ॥
4.25.m: And whoever hears this, or provides encouragement, / he too, becoming a vidyādhara, shall dwell for a long time in the heavenly world.

4.25.s:
idamiha madanena pūrvamiṣṭaṃ caritamidaṃ śaśabiṃdunā vrataṃ vai ..
surapatidhanadeśavāyusomaiścaritadidaṃ karuṇena baṃdinā ca .. 43 ..
4.25.d:
इदमिह मदनेन पूर्वमिष्टं चरितमिदं शशबिंदुना व्रतं वै ॥
सुरपतिधनदेशवायुसोमैश्चरितदिदं करुणेन बंदिना च ॥ 43 ॥
4.25.m: This was formerly performed here by Madana; this votive observance was indeed observed by Śaśabindu; / it was observed by the Lord of the gods, the Lord of wealth, Vāyu, Soma, and by Karuṇa and the bard.

4.25.s:
yānīha dattāni purā nareṃdrairdānāni dharmārthayaśaskarāṇi ..
nirmālyavaṃti pratimāni tāni sa nāma sādhuḥ punarādadānaḥ .. 44 ..
rasakalyāṇinīvratavarṇanam
4.25.d:
यानीह दत्तानि पुरा नरेंद्रैर्दानानि धर्मार्थयशस्कराणि ॥
निर्माल्यवंति प्रतिमानि तानि स नाम साधुः पुनराददानः ॥ 44 ॥
रसकल्याणिनीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.25.m:
Whatever gifts bringing virtue, wealth, and renown were given here by kings of old, / taking back those offerings, which have become cast-off remnants—is such a man truly virtuous?
Description of the Rasakalyāṇinī Votive Observance

4.26.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
saubhāgyārogyaphaladaṃ vipakṣakṣayakārakam ..
bhuktimuktipradaṃ kiñcidvrataṃ brūhi janārdana .. 1 .. ..
4.26.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
सौभाग्यारोग्यफलदं विपक्षक्षयकारकम् ॥
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं किञ्चिद्व्रतं ब्रूहि जनार्दन ॥ 1 ॥ ॥
4.26.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Tell me, O Janārdana, some votive observance that yields good fortune and health, / destroys adversaries, and bestows enjoyment and liberation.

4.26.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
yadumāyai purā deva uvācāsurasūdanaḥ ..
kathāsu saṃpravṛttāsu lalitārādhanaṃ prati .. 2 ..
4.26.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
यदुमायै पुरा देव उवाचासुरसूदनः ॥
कथासु संप्रवृत्तासु ललिताराधनं प्रति ॥ 2 ॥
4.26.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / What the god, the slayer of the Asuras, told Umā in ancient times, / when conversations arose concerning the worship of Lalitā,

4.26.s:
tadidānīṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimukti phalapradam ..
narāṇāmatha nārīṇāmārādhanamanuttamam .. 3 ..
4.26.d:
तदिदानीं प्रवक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्ति फलप्रदम् ॥
नराणामथ नारीणामाराधनमनुत्तमम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.26.m: that peerless worship of men and women, which bestows / the fruits of enjoyment and liberation, I shall now declare.

4.26.s:
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
nabhasye vātha vaiśākhe punarmārgaśire'tha vā .. 4 ..
4.26.d:
शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
नभस्ये वाथ वैशाखे पुनर्मार्गशिरेऽथ वा ॥ 4 ॥
4.26.m: Listen attentively to what destroys all sins. / In Nabhasya, or Vaiśākha, or again in Mārgaśiras,

4.26.s:
śuklapakṣatṛtīyāyāṃ snātaḥ sadgaurasarṣapaiḥ ..
gorocanasugomūtramustāgośakṛtaṃ tathā ..
dadhicaṃdanasaṃmiśraṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ nyaset .. 5 ..
4.26.d:
शुक्लपक्षतृतीयायां स्नातः सद्गौरसर्षपैः ॥
गोरोचनसुगोमूत्रमुस्तागोशकृतं तथा ॥
दधिचंदनसंमिश्रं ललाटे तिलकं न्यसेत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.26.m: bathed on the third [lunar day] of the bright fortnight with white mustard seeds, / one should place a mark on the forehead mixed with curds and sandalwood, / [prepared with] gorocanā, fragrant cow's urine, mustā, and cow dung,

4.26.s:
saubhāgyārogyakṛdyatsyātsadā ca lalitāpriyam ..
pratipakṣaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ baddhvā vā pītavāsasī .. 6 ..
4.26.d:
सौभाग्यारोग्यकृद्यत्स्यात्सदा च ललिताप्रियम् ॥
प्रतिपक्षं तृतीयायां बद्ध्वा वा पीतवाससी ॥ 6 ॥
4.26.m: which brings good fortune and health, and is always dear to Lalitā. / On the third [lunar day] of each fortnight, having donned two yellow garments,

4.26.s:
dhārayedatha vā raktapītāni kusumāni ca ..
vidhavāpyanuraktāni kumārī śuklavāsasī .. 7 ..
4.26.d:
धारयेदथ वा रक्तपीतानि कुसुमानि च ॥
विधवाप्यनुरक्तानि कुमारी शुक्लवाससी ॥ 7 ॥
4.26.m: one should wear red or yellow flowers; / even a widow [may wear] red-tinted [flowers], and an unmarried girl two white garments.

4.26.s:
devyarcāṃ paṃcagavyena tataḥ kṣīreṇa kevalam ..
snapayenmadhunā tadvatpuṣpagandhodakena ca .. 8 ..
4.26.d:
देव्यर्चां पंचगव्येन ततः क्षीरेण केवलम् ॥
स्नपयेन्मधुना तद्वत्पुष्पगन्धोदकेन च ॥ 8 ॥
4.26.m: One should bathe the image of the goddess with the five products of the cow, then with pure milk, / likewise with honey, and with flower-scented water.

4.26.s:
pūjayecchuklapuṣpaiśca phalairnānāvidhairapi ..
dhānyakājājilavaṇaguḍakṣīraghṛtādibhiḥ .. 9 ..
4.26.d:
पूजयेच्छुक्लपुष्पैश्च फलैर्नानाविधैरपि ॥
धान्यकाजाजिलवणगुडक्षीरघृतादिभिः ॥ 9 ॥
4.26.m: And one should worship [her] with white flowers and various kinds of fruits, / with coriander, cumin, salt, jaggery, milk, clarified butter, and so forth.

4.26.s:
śuklākṣataistilairarcyāṃ lalitāṃ yaḥ sadārcayet ..
āpādādyarcanaṃ kuryādgauryāḥ samyaksamāsataḥ .. 4.26.10 ..
4.26.d:
शुक्लाक्षतैस्तिलैरर्च्यां ललितां यः सदार्चयेत् ॥
आपादाद्यर्चनं कुर्याद्गौर्याः सम्यक्समासतः ॥ 4.26.10 ॥
4.26.m: Whoever constantly worships the image of Lalitā with white unbroken grains and sesamum seeds / should perform the worship of Gaurī properly, from the feet upwards, in brief:

4.26.s:
varadāyai namaḥ pādau tathā gulphau śriye namaḥ ..
aśokāyai namo jaṃghe bhavānyai jānunī tathā .. 1 1..
4.26.d:
वरदायै नमः पादौ तथा गुल्फौ श्रिये नमः ॥
अशोकायै नमो जंघे भवान्यै जानुनी तथा ॥ 1 1॥
4.26.m: "Obeisance to the Giver of Boons," [worshipping] the feet; likewise, "Obeisance to Śrī," the ankles; / "Obeisance to Aśokā," the shanks; likewise, "To Bhavānī," the two knees;

4.26.s:
ūrū māṃgalyakāriṇyai kāmadevyai tathā kaṭim ..
padmodbhavāyai jaṭharamuraḥ kāmapriye namaḥ .. 12 ..
4.26.d:
ऊरू मांगल्यकारिण्यै कामदेव्यै तथा कटिम् ॥
पद्मोद्भवायै जठरमुरः कामप्रिये नमः ॥ 12 ॥
4.26.m: the thighs [with obeisance] to the Bringer of Auspiciousness; likewise the waist to Kāmadevī; / the belly to the Lotus-Born One; "Obeisance to Kāmapriyā," the chest;

4.26.s:
karau saubhāgyavāsinyai bāhū śaśimukhaśriyai ..
mukhaṃ kaṃdarpavāsinyai pārvatyai tu smitaṃ tathā .. 13 ..
4.26.d:
करौ सौभाग्यवासिन्यै बाहू शशिमुखश्रियै ॥
मुखं कंदर्पवासिन्यै पार्वत्यै तु स्मितं तथा ॥ 13 ॥
4.26.m: the two hands to the Abode of Fortune; the two arms to the Splendour with a Moon-like Face; / the face to the Abode of Love; and the smile to Pārvatī;

4.26.s:
gauryyai namastathā nāsāṃ sunetrāyai ca locane ..
tuṣṭyai lalāṭaphalakaṃ kātyāyanyai śirastathā .. .. 14 ..
4.26.d:
गौर्य्यै नमस्तथा नासां सुनेत्रायै च लोचने ॥
तुष्ट्यै ललाटफलकं कात्यायन्यै शिरस्तथा ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
4.26.m: likewise the nose with "Obeisance to Gaurī"; and the two eyes to Sunetrā; / the forehead to Tuṣṭi; and the head to Kātyāyanī.

4.26.s:
namo gauryai namaḥ sṛṣṭyai namaḥ kāṃtyai namaḥ śriyai ..
raṃbhāyai lalitāyai ca vāsudevyai namonamaḥ .. 15 ..
4.26.d:
नमो गौर्यै नमः सृष्ट्यै नमः कांत्यै नमः श्रियै ॥
रंभायै ललितायै च वासुदेव्यै नमोनमः ॥ 15 ॥
4.26.m: "Obeisance to Gaurī, obeisance to Sṛṣṭi, obeisance to Kānti, obeisance to Śrī, / to Rambhā, and to Lalitā, and to Vāsudevī, repeated obeisance!"

4.26.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadagrataḥ padma mālikhet ..
patrairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ kuṃkumena sakarṇikam .. 16 ..
4.26.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवदग्रतः पद्म मालिखेत् ॥
पत्रैर्द्वादशभिर्युक्तं कुंकुमेन सकर्णिकम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.26.m: Having worshipped thus according to rule, one should draw a lotus before [her] / furnished with twelve petals and a pericarp, using saffron.

4.26.s:
pūrveṇa vinyasedgaurīmaparṇāṃ ca tataḥ param ..
bhavānīṃ dakṣiṇe tadvadrudrāṇīṃ ca tataḥ param .. 17 ..
4.26.d:
पूर्वेण विन्यसेद्गौरीमपर्णां च ततः परम् ॥
भवानीं दक्षिणे तद्वद्रुद्राणीं च ततः परम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.26.m: One should place Gaurī in the east, and Aparṇā next to her; / Bhavānī likewise in the south, and Rudrāṇī next to her;

4.26.s:
vinyasetpaścime saumyāṃ tato madanavāsinīm..
vāyavyāṃ pāṭalāvāsāmuttareṇa tato hyumām.. 18..
4.26.d:
विन्यसेत्पश्चिमे सौम्यां ततो मदनवासिनीम्॥
वायव्यां पाटलावासामुत्तरेण ततो ह्युमाम्॥ 18॥
4.26.m: one should place Saumyā in the west, and next Madanavāsinī; / Pāṭalāvāsā in the north-west, and next Umā in the north.

4.26.s:
lakṣmīṃ svāhāṃ svadhāṃ tuṣṭiṃ maṃgalāṃ kumudāṃ satīm..
rudrāṇīṃ madhyataḥ sthāpya lalitāṃ karṇikopari..
kusumairakṣataiḥ śubhrairnamaskāreṇa vinyaset..19..
4.26.d:
लक्ष्मीं स्वाहां स्वधां तुष्टिं मंगलां कुमुदां सतीम्॥
रुद्राणीं मध्यतः स्थाप्य ललितां कर्णिकोपरि॥
कुसुमैरक्षतैः शुभ्रैर्नमस्कारेण विन्यसेत्॥19॥
4.26.m: Having placed Lakṣmī, Svāhā, Svadhā, Tuṣṭi, Maṅgalā, Kumudā, Satī, / and Rudrāṇī in the middle, and Lalitā upon the pericarp, / one should place [them] with white flowers, unbroken grains, and prostration.

4.26.s:
gītamaṃgalaghoṣaṃ ca kārayitvā suvāsinīḥ ..
pūjayedraktavāsobhī raktamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 4.26.20 ..
4.26.d:
गीतमंगलघोषं च कारयित्वा सुवासिनीः ॥
पूजयेद्रक्तवासोभी रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 4.26.20 ॥
4.26.m: And having caused songs and auspicious sounds to be performed, / one should worship married women whose husbands are living with red garments, red garlands, and ointments.

4.26.s:
siṃdūraṃ snānacūrṇaṃ ca tāsāṃ śirasi pātayet ..
siṃdūraṃ kuṃkumaṃ snānamiṣṭaṃ satyāḥ sadā yataḥ .. 21 ..
4.26.d:
सिंदूरं स्नानचूर्णं च तासां शिरसि पातयेत् ॥
सिंदूरं कुंकुमं स्नानमिष्टं सत्याः सदा यतः ॥ 21 ॥
4.26.m: One should apply vermilion and bathing powder upon their heads; / for vermilion, saffron, and bathing are ever dear to Satī.

4.26.s:
nabhasye pūjayedgaurīmutpalairasitaistathā ..
bandhujīvairāśvayuje kārtike śatapatrakaiḥ .. 22 ..
4.26.d:
नभस्ये पूजयेद्गौरीमुत्पलैरसितैस्तथा ॥
बन्धुजीवैराश्वयुजे कार्तिके शतपत्रकैः ॥ 22 ॥
4.26.m: In Nabhasya one should worship Gaurī with blue water lilies, / in Āśvayuja with bandhujīva flowers, in Kārtika with lotuses,

4.26.s:
kundapuṣpairmārgaśire pauṣe vai kuṃkumena ca ..
māghe tu pūjayeddevīṃ siṃduvāreṇa bhaktitaḥ .. 23 ..
4.26.d:
कुन्दपुष्पैर्मार्गशिरे पौषे वै कुंकुमेन च ॥
माघे तु पूजयेद्देवीं सिंदुवारेण भक्तितः ॥ 23 ॥
4.26.m: in Mārgaśiras with kunda blossoms, and in Pauṣa with saffron; / in Māgha one should worship the goddess with devotion using sinduvāra;

4.26.s:
jātyā tu phālgune pūjyā pārvatī pāṃḍunaṃdana ..
caitre ca mallikāśokairvaiśākhe gaṃdha pāṭalaiḥ .. 24 ..
4.26.d:
जात्या तु फाल्गुने पूज्या पार्वती पांडुनंदन ॥
चैत्रे च मल्लिकाशोकैर्वैशाखे गंध पाटलैः ॥ 24 ॥
4.26.m: in Phālguna, O son of Pāṇḍu, Pārvatī is to be worshipped with royal jasmine; / in Caitra with Arabian jasmine and aśoka, and in Vaiśākha with fragrant trumpet-flowers;

4.26.s:
jyeṣṭhe kamalamaṃdārairāṣāḍhe caṃpakāṃbujaiḥ ..
kadaṃbairatha mālatyā śrāvaṇe pūjayedumām .. 25 ..
4.26.d:
ज्येष्ठे कमलमंदारैराषाढे चंपकांबुजैः ॥
कदंबैरथ मालत्या श्रावणे पूजयेदुमाम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.26.m: in Jyeṣṭha with lotus and mandāra, in Āṣāḍha with campaka and lotuses; / in Śrāvaṇa one should worship Umā with kadambas and mālatī.

4.26.s:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśo dakam ..
bilvapatrārkapuṣpaṃ ca gavāṃ śṛṃgodaka tathā ..
paṃcagavyaṃ tathā bilvaṃ prāśayetkramaśaḥ sadā ..26..
4.26.d:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशो दकम् ॥
बिल्वपत्रार्कपुष्पं च गवां शृंगोदक तथा ॥
पंचगव्यं तथा बिल्वं प्राशयेत्क्रमशः सदा ॥26॥
4.26.m: Cow's urine, cow dung, milk, curds, clarified butter, water with kuśa grass, / bilva leaves and arka flowers, and water poured from cows' horns, / the five products of the cow, and bilva—one should always consume these in succession.

4.26.s:
etadbhādrapadādyaṃ tu prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam ..
pratipakṣaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ mayā proktaṃ varānane .. 27 ..
4.26.d:
एतद्भाद्रपदाद्यं तु प्राशनं समुदाहृतम् ॥
प्रतिपक्षं द्वितीयायां मया प्रोक्तं वरानने ॥ 27 ॥
4.26.m: This consumption [of substances] beginning in Bhādrapada has been declared; / it has been spoken by me, O fair-faced woman, for the second [lunar day] of each fortnight.

4.26.s:
brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇīṃ caiva śivaṃ gaurīṃ prakalpya ca ..
bhojayitvārcayedbhaktyā vastramālyānulepanaiḥ ..
puṃse pītāṃbare dattvā striyai kausuṃbhavāsasī .. 28 ..
4.26.d:
ब्राह्मणं ब्राह्मणीं चैव शिवं गौरीं प्रकल्प्य च ॥
भोजयित्वार्चयेद्भक्त्या वस्त्रमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
पुंसे पीतांबरे दत्त्वा स्त्रियै कौसुंभवाससी ॥ 28 ॥
4.26.m: And having imagined a brāhmaṇa man and woman to be Śiva and Gaurī, / and having fed them, one should worship [them] with devotion with garments, garlands, and ointments, / giving two yellow garments to the man and two safflower-dyed garments to the woman.

4.26.s:
niṣpāvājājilavaṇamikṣudaṃḍaṃ guṇānvitam ..
striyai dadyātphalaṃ puṃse suvarṇotpalasaṃyutam .. .. 29 ..
4.26.d:
निष्पावाजाजिलवणमिक्षुदंडं गुणान्वितम् ॥
स्त्रियै दद्यात्फलं पुंसे सुवर्णोत्पलसंयुतम् ॥ ॥ 29 ॥
4.26.m: One should give to the woman broad beans, cumin, salt, and an excellent stalk of sugarcane; / to the man a fruit accompanied by a golden lotus.

4.26.s:
yathā na devadeveśastvāṃ parityajya gacchati ..
tathā māṃ saṃparityajya patirnānyatra gacchatu .. 4.26.30 ..
4.26.d:
यथा न देवदेवेशस्त्वां परित्यज्य गच्छति ॥
तथा मां संपरित्यज्य पतिर्नान्यत्र गच्छतु ॥ 4.26.30 ॥
4.26.m: "Just as the Lord of the gods does not depart leaving you, / so may my husband not go elsewhere leaving me!"

4.26.s:
kumudā vimalānaṃtā bhavānī vasudhā śivā ..
lalitā kamalā gaurī satī raṃbhātha pārvatī .. 31 ..
4.26.d:
कुमुदा विमलानंता भवानी वसुधा शिवा ॥
ललिता कमला गौरी सती रंभाथ पार्वती ॥ 31 ॥
4.26.m: "Kumudā, Vimalā, Anantā, Bhavānī, Vasudhā, Śivā, / Lalitā, Kamalā, Gaurī, Satī, Rambhā, and Pārvatī—

4.26.s:
nabhasyādiṣu māseṣu prīyatāmityudīrayet ..
vratāṃte śayanaṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ kamalānvitam .. 32 ..
4.26.d:
नभस्यादिषु मासेषु प्रीयतामित्युदीरयेत् ॥
व्रतांते शयनं दद्यात्सुवर्णं कमलान्वितम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.26.m: in the months beginning with Nabhasya, may she be pleased!" Thus one should recite. / At the end of the votive observance, one should give a bed accompanied by a golden lotus.

4.26.s:
mithunāni caturviṃśattadarddhaṃ sakṛdarccayet ..
aṣṭāvaṣṭāvatha punaścāturmāsye samarcayet .. 33 ..
4.26.d:
मिथुनानि चतुर्विंशत्तदर्द्धं सकृदर्च्चयेत् ॥
अष्टावष्टावथ पुनश्चातुर्मास्ये समर्चयेत् ॥ 33 ॥
4.26.m: One should worship twenty-four couples, or half that number, all at once; / or else one should worship eight in each [month] of the Cāturmāsya.

4.26.s:
tathopadeṣṭāramapi pūjayedyatnato gurum ..
na pūjyate gururyatra sarvāstatrāphalāḥ kriyāḥ .. 34 ..
4.26.d:
तथोपदेष्टारमपि पूजयेद्यत्नतो गुरुम् ॥
न पूज्यते गुरुर्यत्र सर्वास्तत्राफलाः क्रियाः ॥ 34 ॥
4.26.m: Likewise, one should diligently worship the preceptor who gave the instruction; / where the preceptor is not worshipped, all rites there are fruitless.

4.26.s:
uktānaṃtatṛtīyaiṣā sadānaṃtaphalapradā ..
sarvapāpaharā devī saubhāgyārogya vardhinī .. 35 ..
4.26.d:
उक्तानंततृतीयैषा सदानंतफलप्रदा ॥
सर्वपापहरा देवी सौभाग्यारोग्य वर्धिनी ॥ 35 ॥
4.26.m: This Anantatṛtīyā has been proclaimed, which always bestows infinite fruit; / it takes away all sins, [manifests] the goddess, and increases good fortune and health.

4.26.s:
na caināṃ vittaśāṭhyena kadācidapi laṃghayet ..
naro vā yadi vā nārī vittaśāṭhyātpatatyadhaḥ .. 36 ..
4.26.d:
न चैनां वित्तशाठ्येन कदाचिदपि लंघयेत् ॥
नरो वा यदि वा नारी वित्तशाठ्यात्पतत्यधः ॥ 36 ॥
4.26.m: And one should never omit it out of miserliness with wealth; / whether man or woman, one falls downward through miserliness with wealth.

4.26.s:
garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī cātha rogayuk ..
yadā śraddhā tadānyena kriyamāṇaṃ tu kārayet .. 37 ..
4.26.d:
गर्भिणी सूतिका नक्तं कुमारी चाथ रोगयुक् ॥
यदा श्रद्धा तदान्येन क्रियमाणं तु कारयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.26.m: A pregnant woman, a woman recently delivered, [one taking] a nocturnal meal, an unmarried girl, or one afflicted with illness— / when there is faith, she should have it performed by another.

4.26.s:
imāmanaṃtaphaladāṃ tṛtīyāṃ yaḥ samācaret ..
kalpakoṭi śataṃ sāgraṃ śivaloke sa pūjyate .. 38 ..
4.26.d:
इमामनंतफलदां तृतीयां यः समाचरेत् ॥
कल्पकोटि शतं साग्रं शिवलोके स पूज्यते ॥ 38 ॥
4.26.m: Whoever undertakes this third [lunar day observance], which bestows infinite fruit, / is honoured in the world of Śiva for a full hundred crores of kalpas.

4.26.s:
vittahīno'pi kurvīta varṣatrayamupoṣaṇaiḥ ..
puṣpapatravidhānena sopi tatphalamāpnuyāt .. 39 ..
4.26.d:
वित्तहीनोऽपि कुर्वीत वर्षत्रयमुपोषणैः ॥
पुष्पपत्रविधानेन सोपि तत्फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 39 ॥
4.26.m: Even one destitute of wealth should perform it for three years with fasts / according to the rule of flowers and leaves; he too obtains that fruit.

4.26.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vidhavā tathā ..
sā'pi tatphalamāpnoti gauryanugrahabhāvitā ..4.26.40..
4.26.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु कुमारी विधवा तथा ॥
साऽपि तत्फलमाप्नोति गौर्यनुग्रहभाविता ॥4.26.40॥
4.26.m: Whatever woman performs it, whether an unmarried girl or a widow, / she too obtains that fruit, blessed by the grace of Gaurī.

4.26.s:
iti paṭhati śṛṇoti vā ya itthaṃ giritanayāvratamiṃdulokasaṃsthaḥ ..
matimapi ca dadāti so'pi devairamaravadhūjanakiṃnaraiśca pūjyaḥ .. 41 .. ..
4.26.d:
इति पठति शृणोति वा य इत्थं गिरितनयाव्रतमिंदुलोकसंस्थः ॥
मतिमपि च ददाति सोऽपि देवैरमरवधूजनकिंनरैश्च पूज्यः ॥ 41 ॥ ॥
4.26.m: Whoever thus reads or hears this votive observance of the Mountain's Daughter, / or even turns their mind [to it], abides in the lunar world and is honoured by the gods, celestial nymphs, and kiṃnaras.

4.26.s:
( iti anaṃtatṛtīyāvratam)
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
anyāmapi pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāṃ pāpanāśinīm ..
rasakalyāṇinīṃ nāma purā kalpavido viduḥ ..42..
4.26.d:
( इति अनंततृतीयाव्रतम्)
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अन्यामपि प्रवक्ष्यामि तृतीयां पापनाशिनीम् ॥
रसकल्याणिनीं नाम पुरा कल्पविदो विदुः ॥42॥
4.26.m:
(Thus ends the Anantatṛtīyā votive observance.)
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
I shall proclaim another third [lunar day observance] that destroys sin, / named Rasakalyāṇinī, which those who know the kalpas knew of old.

4.26.s:
māghamāse tu saṃprāpya tṛtīyāṃ śuklapākṣikīm..
prātargavyena payasā tilaiḥ snānaṃ samācaret .. 43 ..
4.26.d:
माघमासे तु संप्राप्य तृतीयां शुक्लपाक्षिकीम्॥
प्रातर्गव्येन पयसा तिलैः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥ 43 ॥
4.26.m: Having reached the third [lunar day] of the bright fortnight in the month of Māgha, / one should perform a morning bath with milk from a cow and sesamum seeds.

4.26.s:
snāpayenmadhunā devīṃ tathaivekṣurasena ca ..
punaḥ pūjā prakartavyā jātyā vā kuṃkumena vā ..44..
4.26.d:
स्नापयेन्मधुना देवीं तथैवेक्षुरसेन च ॥
पुनः पूजा प्रकर्तव्या जात्या वा कुंकुमेन वा ॥44॥
4.26.m: One should bathe the goddess with honey, and likewise with sugarcane juice; / worship is to be performed again either with royal jasmine or with saffron.

4.26.s:
dakṣiṇāṃgāni saṃpūjya tato vāmāni pūjayet ..
lalitāyai namaḥ pādau gulphaṃ tadvadathārcayet .. 45 ..
4.26.d:
दक्षिणांगानि संपूज्य ततो वामानि पूजयेत् ॥
ललितायै नमः पादौ गुल्फं तद्वदथार्चयेत् ॥ 45 ॥
4.26.m: Having worshipped the limbs on the right, one should then worship those on the left: / "Obeisance to Lalitā," [worshipping] the feet; likewise one should then worship the ankle.

4.26.s:
jaṃghe jānū tathā satyai tathoraśca śriyai namaḥ ..
madanālasāyai tu kaṭiṃ madanāyai tathodaram ..46..
4.26.d:
जंघे जानू तथा सत्यै तथोरश्च श्रियै नमः ॥
मदनालसायै तु कटिं मदनायै तथोदरम् ॥46॥
4.26.m: The shanks and knees [saying] “Homage to Satī,” and the chest [saying] “Homage to Śrī”; / the waist to Madanālasā, and the belly likewise to Madanā;

4.26.s:
stanau madanavāsinyai kumudāyai ca kaṃdharam..
bhujānbhujāgraṃ mādhavyai kamalāyai hyupasthakam ..47..
4.26.d:
स्तनौ मदनवासिन्यै कुमुदायै च कंधरम्॥
भुजान्भुजाग्रं माधव्यै कमलायै ह्युपस्थकम् ॥47॥
4.26.m: the breasts to Madanavāsinī, and the neck to Kumudā; / the arms and forearms to Mādhavī, and the lap indeed to Kamalā;

4.26.s:
bhrūlalāṭe ca rudrāṇyai śaṃkarāyai tathālakān ..
mukuṭaṃ viśvavāsinyai punaḥ kāṃtyai tathālakān..48..
4.26.d:
भ्रूललाटे च रुद्राण्यै शंकरायै तथालकान् ॥
मुकुटं विश्ववासिन्यै पुनः कांत्यै तथालकान्॥48॥
4.26.m: the eyebrows and forehead to Rudrāṇī, and the curly locks likewise to Śaṅkarā; / the crown to Viśvavāsinī, and the forelocks again to Kānti;

4.26.s:
netraṃ cakrāvadhāriṇyai puṣṭyai ca vadanaṃ punaḥ ..
utkaṃṭhinyai namaḥ kaṃṭhamanaṃtāyai tu kaṃdharām .. 49 ..
4.26.d:
नेत्रं चक्रावधारिण्यै पुष्ट्यै च वदनं पुनः ॥
उत्कंठिन्यै नमः कंठमनंतायै तु कंधराम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.26.m: the eyes to Cakrāvadhāriṇī, and the face again to Puṣṭi; / [saying] “Homage to Utkaṇṭhinī,” the throat; and the nape indeed to Anantā;

4.26.s:
raṃbhāyai vāmabāhuṃ ca viśokāyai namaḥ param ..
hṛdayaṃ manmathādityai pāṭalāyai namonamaḥ .. 4.26.50 ..
4.26.d:
रंभायै वामबाहुं च विशोकायै नमः परम् ॥
हृदयं मन्मथादित्यै पाटलायै नमोनमः ॥ 4.26.50 ॥
4.26.m: to Rambhā the left arm, and “Homage to Viśokā” beyond that; / the heart to Manmathāditī; [and saying] “Homage, homage to Pāṭalā.”

4.26.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivaddvijadāṃpatyamarcayet ..
bhojayitvānnadānena madhureṇa vimatsaraḥ .. 51 ..
4.26.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवद्द्विजदांपत्यमर्चयेत् ॥
भोजयित्वान्नदानेन मधुरेण विमत्सरः ॥ 51 ॥
4.26.m: Having thus worshipped according to the rules, free from envy he should worship a brāhmaṇa couple, / having fed them with a gift of sweet food.

4.26.s:
salaḍḍukaṃ vārikuṃbhaṃ śuklāṃbarayugaṃ tatam ..
dattvā suvarṇakalaśaṃ gaṃdhamālyairathārcayet .. 52 ..
4.26.d:
सलड्डुकं वारिकुंभं शुक्लांबरयुगं ततम् ॥
दत्त्वा सुवर्णकलशं गंधमाल्यैरथार्चयेत् ॥ 52 ॥
4.26.m: Having given a water-jar with sweetmeats, a pair of broad white garments, / and a golden pitcher, he should then worship them with perfumes and garlands.

4.26.s:
prīyatāmatra kumudā gṛhṇīyāllavaṇavratam ..
anena vidhinā devīṃ māsimāsi samarcayet .. 53 ..
4.26.d:
प्रीयतामत्र कुमुदा गृह्णीयाल्लवणव्रतम् ॥
अनेन विधिना देवीं मासिमासि समर्चयेत् ॥ 53 ॥
4.26.m: [Saying,] “May Kumudā be pleased with this,” he should undertake the salt-observance. / By this rule he should worship the goddess month after month.

4.26.s:
lavaṇaṃ varjayenmāghe phālgune ca guḍaṃ punaḥ ..
tavarājaṃ tathā caitre varjyaṃ ca madhu mādhave .. 54 ..
4.26.d:
लवणं वर्जयेन्माघे फाल्गुने च गुडं पुनः ॥
तवराजं तथा चैत्रे वर्ज्यं च मधु माधवे ॥ 54 ॥
4.26.m: He should abstain from salt in Māgha, and again from jaggery in Phālguna; / likewise sugar-candy in Caitra, and honey is to be avoided in Mādhava;

4.26.s:
yārakaṃ jyeṣṭhamāse tu āṣāḍhe jīrakaṃ tathā ..
śrāvaṇe varjayetkṣīraṃ dadhi bhādrapade tathā .. 55 ..
4.26.d:
यारकं ज्येष्ठमासे तु आषाढे जीरकं तथा ॥
श्रावणे वर्जयेत्क्षीरं दधि भाद्रपदे तथा ॥ 55 ॥
4.26.m: barley-gruel in the month of Jyeṣṭha, and likewise cumin in Āṣāḍha; / in Śrāvaṇa he should abstain from milk, and likewise from curd in Bhādrapada;

4.26.s:
ghṛtamaśvayuje tadvadvarjayedyā ca majjikā ..
dhānyakaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu pauṣe varjyā tu śarkarā .. 56 ..
4.26.d:
घृतमश्वयुजे तद्वद्वर्जयेद्या च मज्जिका ॥
धान्यकं मार्गशीर्षे तु पौषे वर्ज्या तु शर्करा ॥ 56 ॥
4.26.m: ghee in Āśvina, and likewise whey is to be avoided; / coriander in Mārgaśīrṣa, and sugar is to be avoided in Pauṣa.

4.26.s:
vratāṃte karakā pūrṇā eteṣāṃ māsimāsi ca ..
dayādvikālavelāyāṃ bhakṣapātreṇa saṃyutān .. 57 ..
4.26.d:
व्रतांते करका पूर्णा एतेषां मासिमासि च ॥
दयाद्विकालवेलायां भक्षपात्रेण संयुतान् ॥ 57 ॥
4.26.m: At the end of the votive observance, jars filled with these month after month / he should give at eventide, along with a dish of food:

4.26.s:
taṃḍulāñchvetavarṇāṃśca saṃyāvamadhupūrikāḥ ..
ghārikā ghṛtapūrāṃśca maṃḍa kānkṣīraśākakam .. 58 ..
4.26.d:
तंडुलाञ्छ्वेतवर्णांश्च संयावमधुपूरिकाः ॥
घारिका घृतपूरांश्च मंड कान्क्षीरशाककम् ॥ 58 ॥
4.26.m: white rice-grains, saṃyāva cakes, filled honey-pastries, / ghārikā pastries, ghee-filled cakes, maṇḍaka breads, milk-vegetable,

4.26.s:
dadhyannaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ caiva bhiṃḍayaḥ śākavartikāḥ ..
māghādau kramaśo dadyādetāni karakopari .. 59 ..
4.26.d:
दध्यन्नं षड्विधं चैव भिंडयः शाकवर्तिकाः ॥
माघादौ क्रमशो दद्यादेतानि करकोपरि ॥ 59 ॥
4.26.m: and the six kinds of curd-rice, bhindi and vegetable-rolls; / starting with Māgha, he should give these in order upon the jar.

4.26.s:
kumudā mādhavī gaurī raṃbhā bhadrā jayā śivā ..
umā śacī satī tadvanmaṃgalā ratilālasā .. 4.26.60 ..
4.26.d:
कुमुदा माधवी गौरी रंभा भद्रा जया शिवा ॥
उमा शची सती तद्वन्मंगला रतिलालसा ॥ 4.26.60 ॥
4.26.m: Kumudā, Mādhavī, Gaurī, Rambhā, Bhadrā, Jayā, Śivā, / Umā, Śacī, likewise Satī, Maṅgalā, and Ratilālasā—

4.26.s:
kramānmāghādi sarvatra prīyatāmiti kīrtayet ..
carvaṃtaṃ paṃcagavyaṃ ca prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 61 ..
4.26.d:
क्रमान्माघादि सर्वत्र प्रीयतामिति कीर्तयेत् ॥
चर्वंतं पंचगव्यं च प्राशनं समुदाहृतम् ॥ 61 ॥
4.26.m: he should recite everywhere in order, starting with Māgha: “May she be pleased!” / Consuming the five products of the cow is declared as the sipping purification.

4.26.s:
upavāsī bhavennityamaśakto dakṣiṇe kare ..
punarmāghe tu saṃprāpya śarkarāṃ karakopari.. 62 ..
4.26.d:
उपवासी भवेन्नित्यमशक्तो दक्षिणे करे ॥
पुनर्माघे तु संप्राप्य शर्करां करकोपरि॥ 62 ॥
4.26.m: He should regularly fast; if unable, [he performs charity with] his right hand. / Then reaching Māgha again, placing sugar upon the jar,

4.26.s:
kṛtvā tu kāṃcanīṃ godhāṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitām ..
umāmaṃguṣṭhamātrāṃ ca sudhāsūtre kamaṃḍalum .. 63 ..
4.26.d:
कृत्वा तु कांचनीं गोधां पंचरत्नसमन्विताम् ॥
उमामंगुष्ठमात्रां च सुधासूत्रे कमंडलुम् ॥ 63 ॥
