4.26.m: and fashioning a golden monitor lizard endowed with the five jewels, / and a thumb-sized Umā, with a water-pot on a nectar-thread,

4.26.s:
tadvadgomithunaṃ sarvaṃ suvarṇāsyaṃ sitaṃ param ..
savastrabhājanaṃ dattvā bhavānī prīyatāmiti .. 64 ..
4.26.d:
तद्वद्गोमिथुनं सर्वं सुवर्णास्यं सितं परम् ॥
सवस्त्रभाजनं दत्त्वा भवानी प्रीयतामिति ॥ 64 ॥
4.26.m: likewise a pair of cows, completely pure white with gold on their faces, / having given them together with garments and vessels, saying: “May Bhavānī be pleased!”

4.26.s:
anena vidhinā yaśca rasakalyāṇinīvratam ..
kuryātsa sarvapāpebhyastatkṣaṇādeva mucyate .. 65 ..
4.26.d:
अनेन विधिना यश्च रसकल्याणिनीव्रतम् ॥
कुर्यात्स सर्वपापेभ्यस्तत्क्षणादेव मुच्यते ॥ 65 ॥
4.26.m: And whoever performs the Rasakalyāṇinī-vrata by this rule / is instantly freed from all sins.

4.26.s:
bhavārbudasahasraṃ tu na duḥkhī jāyate kvacit ..
agniṣṭomasahasreṇa yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt .. 66 ..
4.26.d:
भवार्बुदसहस्रं तु न दुःखी जायते क्वचित् ॥
अग्निष्टोमसहस्रेण यत्फलं तदवाप्नुयात् ॥ 66 ॥
4.26.m: For ten billion rebirths he is never born unhappy; / he obtains the fruit that is gained through a thousand Agniṣṭoma sacrifices.

4.26.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vā yudhiṣṭhira ..
vidhavā vā varākī vā sāpi tatphalabhāginī ..
saubhāgyārogyasaṃpannā gaurīloke mahīyate .. 67 ..
4.26.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु कुमारी वा युधिष्ठिर ॥
विधवा वा वराकी वा सापि तत्फलभागिनी ॥
सौभाग्यारोग्यसंपन्ना गौरीलोके महीयते ॥ 67 ॥
4.26.m: Or whatever woman performs it, whether an unmarried girl, O Yudhiṣṭhira, / a widow, or even a poor woman, she too shares in that fruit; / endowed with good fortune and health, she is honoured in Gaurī’s realm.

4.26.s:
iti paṭhati ya itthaṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti prasaṃgātsakalakaluṣamuktaḥ pārvatīlokameti .. matimapi ca narāṇāṃ yo dadāti priyārthaṃ vipulamatijanānāṃ nāyakaḥ syādamogham .. 68 ..
ārdrānandakarīvratavarṇanam
4.26.d:
इति पठति य इत्थं यः शृणोति प्रसंगात्सकलकलुषमुक्तः पार्वतीलोकमेति ॥ मतिमपि च नराणां यो ददाति प्रियार्थं विपुलमतिजनानां नायकः स्यादमोघम् ॥ 68 ॥
आर्द्रानन्दकरीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.26.m:
Whoever recites this thus, or hears it in context, is freed from all stain and goes to Pārvatī’s realm; / and he who imparts this understanding to men for the sake of what is pleasing unfailingly becomes a leader of men of great intelligence.
Description of the Ārdrānandakarī-vrata

4.27.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tathā cānyāṃ pravakṣyāmi tṛtīyāṃ pāpanāśinīm ..
lokeṣu nāmnā vikhyātāmārdrānaṃdakarīmimām .. 1 ..
4.27.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तथा चान्यां प्रवक्ष्यामि तृतीयां पापनाशिनीम् ॥
लोकेषु नाम्ना विख्यातामार्द्रानंदकरीमिमाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.27.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / And so I will declare another sin-destroying tṛtīyā, / renowned among the worlds by this name: Ārdrānandakarī.

4.27.s:
yadā śuklatṛtīyāyāmāṣāḍharkṣaṃ bhavetkvacit ..
brahmarkṣaṃ cātha mārgaṃ vā vrataṃ grāhyaṃ tadā śubham .. 2 ..
4.27.d:
यदा शुक्लतृतीयायामाषाढर्क्षं भवेत्क्वचित् ॥
ब्रह्मर्क्षं चाथ मार्गं वा व्रतं ग्राह्यं तदा शुभम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.27.m: When on the bright tṛtīyā there should occur the lunar asterism of Āṣāḍhā, / or the lunar asterism of Brahmā, or Mārgaśīrṣa, then this auspicious votive observance should be undertaken.

4.27.s:
darbhagaṃdhodakaiḥ snānaṃ tadā samyaksamācaret ..
śuklamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śuklagaṃdhānulepanaḥ .. 3 ..
4.27.d:
दर्भगंधोदकैः स्नानं तदा सम्यक्समाचरेत् ॥
शुक्लमाल्यांबरधरः शुक्लगंधानुलेपनः ॥ 3 ॥
4.27.m: He should then properly perform a bath with darbhā-grass and fragrant water, / wearing white garlands and garments, anointed with white fragrant unguent.

4.27.s:
bhavānīmarcayedbhaktyā śuklapuṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhibhiḥ ..
mahādevena sahitāmupaviṣṭāṃ varāsane ..4..
4.27.d:
भवानीमर्चयेद्भक्त्या शुक्लपुष्पैः सुगंधिभिः ॥
महादेवेन सहितामुपविष्टां वरासने ॥4॥
4.27.m: He should worship Bhavānī with devotion using fragrant white flowers, / seated upon an excellent seat together with Mahādeva.

4.27.s:
vāsudevyai namaḥ pādau śaṃkarāya namo hareḥ ..
jaṃghe śokavināśinyāyānandāya namaḥ prabho.. .. 5 ..
4.27.d:
वासुदेव्यै नमः पादौ शंकराय नमो हरेः ॥
जंघे शोकविनाशिन्यायानन्दाय नमः प्रभो॥ ॥ 5 ॥
4.27.m: [Saying] “Homage to Vāsudevī,” the feet; [and saying] “Homage to Śaṅkara,” of Hara; / the shanks to Śokavināśinī; and [saying] “Homage to Ānanda,” of the Lord;

4.27.s:
raṃbhāyai pūjayedūrū śivāya ca pinākinaḥ ..
ādityai ca kaṭiṃ pūjyā śūlinaḥ śūlapāṇaye .. 6 ..
4.27.d:
रंभायै पूजयेदूरू शिवाय च पिनाकिनः ॥
आदित्यै च कटिं पूज्या शूलिनः शूलपाणये ॥ 6 ॥
4.27.m: he should worship the thighs to Rambhā; and to Śiva, of the wielder of Pināka; / and the waist to Āditi, and to Śūlapāṇi, of the spear-holder;

4.27.s:
mādhavyai ca tathā nābhimatha śaṃbhorbhavāya vai ..
stanāvānaṃdakāriṇyai śaṃkarāyeṃdudhāriṇe .. 7 ..
4.27.d:
माधव्यै च तथा नाभिमथ शंभोर्भवाय वै ॥
स्तनावानंदकारिण्यै शंकरायेंदुधारिणे ॥ 7 ॥
4.27.m: and likewise the navel to Mādhavī; and then to Bhava, of Śambhu; / the breasts to Ānandakāriṇī; and to Śaṅkara, the moon-wearer;

4.27.s:
utkaṃṭhinyai namaḥ kaṃṭhaṃ nīlakaṃṭhāya vai hareḥ ..
karāvutpaladhāriṇyai rudrāya jagatīpateḥ ..8..
4.27.d:
उत्कंठिन्यै नमः कंठं नीलकंठाय वै हरेः ॥
करावुत्पलधारिण्यै रुद्राय जगतीपतेः ॥8॥
4.27.m: [saying] “Homage to Utkaṇṭhinī,” the throat; and to Nīlakaṇṭha indeed, of Hara; / the hands to Utpaladhāriṇī; and to Rudra, of the Lord of the world;

4.27.s: bāhuṃ ca pariraṃbhiṇyai nṛtyaśīlāya vai hareḥ .. 9 ..
4.27.d: बाहुं च परिरंभिण्यै नृत्यशीलाय वै हरेः ॥ 9 ॥
4.27.m: and the arms to Parirambhiṇī; and to him whose nature is dancing indeed, of Hara;

4.27.s:
devyā mukhaṃ vilāsinyai vṛṣeśāya punarvibhoḥ ..
smitaṃ sasmaraśīlāyai viśvavaktrāya vai vibhoḥ .. .. 4.27.10 ..
4.27.d:
देव्या मुखं विलासिन्यै वृषेशाय पुनर्विभोः ॥
स्मितं सस्मरशीलायै विश्ववक्त्राय वै विभोः ॥ ॥ 4.27.10 ॥
4.27.m: the face of the goddess to Vilāsinī; and again to Vṛṣeśa, of the omnipresent Lord; / the smile to Sasmaraśīlā; and to Viśvavaktra indeed, of the omnipresent Lord;

4.27.s:
netraṃ madanavāsinyai viśvadhāmne triśūline ..
bhruvau ratipriyāyai ca tāṃḍaveśāya vai vibhoḥ .. 11 ..
4.27.d:
नेत्रं मदनवासिन्यै विश्वधाम्ने त्रिशूलिने ॥
भ्रुवौ रतिप्रियायै च तांडवेशाय वै विभोः ॥ 11 ॥
4.27.m: the eyes to Madanavāsinī; and to the trident-bearing Viśvadhāman; / the eyebrows to Ratipriyā; and to Tāṇḍaveśa indeed, of the omnipresent Lord;

4.27.s:
devyai lalāṭamiṃdrāṇyai havyavāhāya vai vibhoḥ ..
svāhāyai mukuṭaṃ devyā vibhoḥ pañcaśarāya vai .. 12 ..
4.27.d:
देव्यै ललाटमिंद्राण्यै हव्यवाहाय वै विभोः ॥
स्वाहायै मुकुटं देव्या विभोः पञ्चशराय वै ॥ 12 ॥
4.27.m: the forehead of the goddess to Indrāṇī; and to Havyavāha indeed, of the omnipresent Lord; / the crown of the goddess to Svāhā; and indeed to Pañcaśara, of the omnipresent Lord.

4.27.s:
viśvakāyai viśvamukhyai viśvapādakarau śivau ..
prasannavadanau vaṃde pārvatīparameśvarau .. .. 13 ..
4.27.d:
विश्वकायै विश्वमुख्यै विश्वपादकरौ शिवौ ॥
प्रसन्नवदनौ वंदे पार्वतीपरमेश्वरौ ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
4.27.m: To Viśvakā and Viśvamukhī, the all-pervading feet and hands of the two Śivas; / I bow to the gracious-faced Pārvatī and Parameśvara.

4.27.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadagrataḥ śivayoḥ punaḥ ..
padmotpalāni ca tathā nānāvarṇāni kārayet .. 14 ..
4.27.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवदग्रतः शिवयोः पुनः ॥
पद्मोत्पलानि च तथा नानावर्णानि कारयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.27.m: Having thus worshipped according to the rules, in front of the two Śivas again / he should cause day-lotuses and night-lotuses of various colours to be fashioned,

4.27.s:
śaṅkhacakre sakaṭake svastikaṃ varddha mānakam ..
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam .. 15 ..
4.27.d:
शङ्खचक्रे सकटके स्वस्तिकं वर्द्ध मानकम् ॥
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.27.m: a conch and a discus with bracelets, a svastika, and a vardhamāna; / cow’s urine, cow dung, milk, curd, ghee, kuśa-water,

4.27.s:
śṛṃgodakaṃ bilvapatraṃ vāri kuṃbhānvitaṃ tathā ..
uśīranīraṃ tadvacca yavacūrṇodakaṃ tataḥ .. 16 ..
4.27.d:
शृंगोदकं बिल्वपत्रं वारि कुंभान्वितं तथा ॥
उशीरनीरं तद्वच्च यवचूर्णोदकं ततः ॥ 16 ॥
4.27.m: horn-water, bilva leaves, water with a pitcher likewise, / and likewise vetiver-water, and then barley-meal water,

4.27.s:
tilodakaṃ ca saṃprāpya svapyānmārgaśirādiṣu ..
pratipakṣadvitīyāyāṃ prāśanaṃ samudāhṛtam .. 17 ..
4.27.d:
तिलोदकं च संप्राप्य स्वप्यान्मार्गशिरादिषु ॥
प्रतिपक्षद्वितीयायां प्राशनं समुदाहृतम् ॥ 17 ॥
4.27.m: and having obtained sesame-water, he should sleep [chastely] in Mārgaśīrṣa and the other months; / sipping purification is prescribed on the second lunar day of each fortnight.

4.27.s:
sarvatra śuklapuṣpāṇi praśastāni śivārcane ..
dānakāleṣu sarveṣu maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 18 ..
4.27.d:
सर्वत्र शुक्लपुष्पाणि प्रशस्तानि शिवार्चने ॥
दानकालेषु सर्वेषु मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.27.m: Everywhere white flowers are commended in the worship of Śiva and Śivā; / at all times of giving gifts, he should utter this mantra:

4.27.s:
gaurī me prīyatāṃ nityamaghanāśāya maṃgalā ..
saubhāgyāyāstu lalitā bhavānī sarvasiddhaye .. 19 ..
4.27.d:
गौरी मे प्रीयतां नित्यमघनाशाय मंगला ॥
सौभाग्यायास्तु ललिता भवानी सर्वसिद्धये ॥ 19 ॥
4.27.m: “May Gaurī always be pleased with me; Maṅgalā for the destruction of sin; / may Lalitā be for good fortune, and Bhavānī for the attainment of all success.”

4.27.s:
saṃvatsarāṃte lavaṇaṃ guḍakuṃbhaṃ samarjitam ..
candanaṃ netrapaṭṭaṃ ca sitavastrayugānvitam ..
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ tadvadikṣuphalairyutam .. 4.27.20 ..
4.27.d:
संवत्सरांते लवणं गुडकुंभं समर्जितम् ॥
चन्दनं नेत्रपट्टं च सितवस्त्रयुगान्वितम् ॥
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं तद्वदिक्षुफलैर्युतम् ॥ 4.27.20 ॥
4.27.m: At the end of the year, salt, a pot of jaggery, well-earned [wealth], / sandalwood, silk cloth, together with a pair of white garments, / a golden image of Umā and Maheśvara, and likewise sugarcane and fruits, 4.27.20

4.27.s:
prastarāvaraṇaṃ śayyāṃ saviśrāmāṃ nivedayet ..
sapatnīkāya viprāya gaurī me prīyatāmiti .. 21 ..
4.27.d:
प्रस्तरावरणं शय्यां सविश्रामां निवेदयेत् ॥
सपत्नीकाय विप्राय गौरी मे प्रीयतामिति ॥ 21 ॥
4.27.m: a couch with coverlets and bedding, equipped for resting, should be offered / to a Brahmin accompanied by his wife, saying, "May Gaurī be pleased with me." 21

4.27.s:
ārdrānandakarī nāma tṛtīyaiṣā sanātanī ..
yāmupoṣya naro yāti śaṃbhostatparamaṃ padam .. 22 ..
4.27.d:
आर्द्रानन्दकरी नाम तृतीयैषा सनातनी ॥
यामुपोष्य नरो याति शंभोस्तत्परमं पदम् ॥ 22 ॥
4.27.m: This eternal third [lunar day] is named Ārdrānandakarī; / fasting on which, a man goes to Śambhu's supreme abode. 22

4.27.s:
iha loke yamānaṃdaṃ prāpnoti dhanasaṃcayāt ..
āyurārogyasaṃpanno na kiñcicchokamāpnuyāt .. 23 ..
4.27.d:
इह लोके यमानंदं प्राप्नोति धनसंचयात् ॥
आयुरारोग्यसंपन्नो न किञ्चिच्छोकमाप्नुयात् ॥ 23 ॥
4.27.m: Whatever joy he attains in this world from accumulation of wealth, / endowed with long life and good health, he suffers no grief whatsoever. 23

4.27.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu kumārī vidhavā tathā ..
sāpi tatphalamāpnoti devyanugrahalālitā .. 24 ..
4.27.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु कुमारी विधवा तथा ॥
सापि तत्फलमाप्नोति देव्यनुग्रहलालिता ॥ 24 ॥
4.27.m: Or whatever woman performs it—whether a maiden or a widow— / she too obtains that fruit, cherished by the goddess's grace. 24

4.27.s:
pratipakṣamupoṣyaivaṃ maṃtrārcanavidhānataḥ ..
rudrāṇīlokamāpnoti punarāvṛttivarjitam .. 25 ..
4.27.d:
प्रतिपक्षमुपोष्यैवं मंत्रार्चनविधानतः ॥
रुद्राणीलोकमाप्नोति पुनरावृत्तिवर्जितम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.27.m: Having thus fasted fortnight after fortnight according to the rite of worship with mantras, / she attains the world of Rudrāṇī, from which there is no return. 25

4.27.s:
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ śrāvayedvāpi mānavaḥ ..
śakraloke sagaṃdharvaiḥ pūjyate'bdaśatatrayam .. 26 ..
4.27.d:
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं श्रावयेद्वापि मानवः ॥
शक्रलोके सगंधर्वैः पूज्यतेऽब्दशतत्रयम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.27.m: Whatever human being constantly hears this or recites it [to others], / is honored in Śakra's world along with the Gandharvas for three hundred years. 26

4.27.s:
ānaṃdadāṃ sakaladuḥkhaharāṃ tṛtīyāṃ yā strī karoti vidhivatsadhavādhavā ca ..
sā sve gṛhe sukhaśatānyanubhūya bhūyo gaurīpuraṃ sadayitā muditā prayāti .. 27 ..
caitrabhādrapadamāghavarṇanam
4.27.d:
आनंददां सकलदुःखहरां तृतीयां या स्त्री करोति विधिवत्सधवाधवा च ॥
सा स्वे गृहे सुखशतान्यनुभूय भूयो गौरीपुरं सदयिता मुदिता प्रयाति ॥ 27 ॥
चैत्रभाद्रपदमाघवर्णनम्
4.27.m:
The woman who properly observes this third [lunar day], which grants bliss and removes all sorrow, whether her husband is alive or deceased, / after enjoying hundreds of pleasures in her own home, joyfully departs with her beloved to the city of Gaurī. 27
Description of [the Third Lunar Days of] Caitra, Bhādrapada, and Māgha

4.28.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
caitre bhādrapade māghe rūpasaubhāgya putradam ..
tṛtīyātrayametanme kṛṣṇa kasmānna kīrtitam .. 1 ..
4.28.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
चैत्रे भाद्रपदे माघे रूपसौभाग्य पुत्रदम् ॥
तृतीयात्रयमेतन्मे कृष्ण कस्मान्न कीर्तितम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.28.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Why has this triad of third [lunar days] in Caitra, Bhādrapada, and Māgha, / which bestows beauty, good fortune, and sons, not been told to me, O Kṛṣṇa? 1

4.28.s:
kimahaṃ bhaktirahitastrayīmārgātigo naraḥ ..
suprasiddhaṃ jagatyetadgopitaṃ kena hetunā .. 2 ..
4.28.d:
किमहं भक्तिरहितस्त्रयीमार्गातिगो नरः ॥
सुप्रसिद्धं जगत्येतद्गोपितं केन हेतुना ॥ 2 ॥
4.28.m: Am I a man lacking devotion, one who has strayed from the path of the three Vedas? / For what reason was this rite, celebrated throughout the world, concealed? 2

4.28.s:
bhavānsarvārthānukūlaḥ sarvajña iti me matiḥ ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
vrataṃ caitajjagatkhyātaṃ nākhyātaṃ tena te mayā ..3..
4.28.d:
भवान्सर्वार्थानुकूलः सर्वज्ञ इति मे मतिः ॥
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
व्रतं चैतज्जगत्ख्यातं नाख्यातं तेन ते मया ॥3॥
4.28.m: My belief is that you are favorable to all aims and all-knowing. / Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Because this votive observance is famous throughout the world, it was not related to you by me. 3

4.28.s:
yadyasti śravaṇe buddhiḥ śrūyatāṃ pāṇḍunandana ..
ko'nyaḥ śrotā jagatyasminbhavatā sadṛśo bhuvi .. 4 ..
4.28.d:
यद्यस्ति श्रवणे बुद्धिः श्रूयतां पाण्डुनन्दन ॥
कोऽन्यः श्रोता जगत्यस्मिन्भवता सदृशो भुवि ॥ 4 ॥
4.28.m: If your mind is set on hearing, listen, O son of Pāṇḍu! / What other hearer in this world on earth is equal to you? 4

4.28.s:
jayā ca vijayā caiva umāyāḥ paricārike ..
āgatya munikanyābhiḥ pṛṣṭebhīṣṭaphalecchayā .. 5 ..
4.28.d:
जया च विजया चैव उमायाः परिचारिके ॥
आगत्य मुनिकन्याभिः पृष्टेभीष्टफलेच्छया ॥ 5 ॥
4.28.m: Jayā and Vijayā, the two attendants of Umā, / were approached and questioned by daughters of sages who desired the fruits of their wishes: 5

4.28.s:
bhavatyau sarvadā devyāścittavṛttividau kila ..
kena vratopacāreṇa kasminnahani pārvatī ..
pūjitā tuṣṭimabhyeti maṃtrai kaiśca varānane .. 6 ..
4.28.d:
भवत्यौ सर्वदा देव्याश्चित्तवृत्तिविदौ किल ॥
केन व्रतोपचारेण कस्मिन्नहनि पार्वती ॥
पूजिता तुष्टिमभ्येति मंत्रै कैश्च वरानने ॥ 6 ॥
4.28.m: "You two constantly know the inclinations of the goddess's heart. / By what ritual of votive observance, on which day, / and with what mantras is Pārvatī worshipped so that she becomes pleased, O fair-faced ladies?" 6

4.28.s:
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jayā provāca sādaram ..
śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
vratamutsavasaṃyuktaṃ naranārī manoramam .. 7 ..
4.28.d:
तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा जया प्रोवाच सादरम् ॥
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ॥
व्रतमुत्सवसंयुक्तं नरनारी मनोरमम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.28.m: Hearing their words, Jayā spoke with respect: / "Listen, I shall explain the votive observance, accompanied by festive celebration, / delightful to men and women, which grants the fruits of all desires. 7

4.28.s:
caitre sitatṛtīyāyāṃ dantadhāvanapūrvakam ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyādbhaktibhāvitam .. 8 ..
4.28.d:
चैत्रे सिततृतीयायां दन्तधावनपूर्वकम् ॥
उपवासस्य नियमं गृह्णीयाद्भक्तिभावितम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.28.m: On the bright third [lunar day] of Caitra, after cleaning the teeth, / one should undertake the discipline of fasting, filled with devotion. 8

4.28.s:
sakuṃkumaṃ satāṃbūlaṃ sindūraṃ raktavāsasī ..
vidhavā sopavāsāpyavaidhavyakaraṇaṃ param .. 9 ..
4.28.d:
सकुंकुमं सतांबूलं सिन्दूरं रक्तवाससी ॥
विधवा सोपवासाप्यवैधव्यकरणं परम् ॥ 9 ॥
4.28.m: With saffron, betel, red vermilion, and two red garments, / even a widow who fasts performs the supreme rite that prevents widowhood [in future lives]. 9

4.28.s:
vidhavā yāti mārgeṇa kumārī tu yadṛcchayā ..
kuryādabhyarcanavidhiṃ śrūyatāṃ maṃtravikramaḥ .. 4.28.10 ..
4.28.d:
विधवा याति मार्गेण कुमारी तु यदृच्छया ॥
कुर्यादभ्यर्चनविधिं श्रूयतां मंत्रविक्रमः ॥ 4.28.10 ॥
4.28.m: The widow follows this path, while a maiden does so at her pleasure. / She should perform the procedure of worship; listen to the power of the mantras. 4.28.10

4.28.s:
netrapaṭṭapaṭīvastrairvastramaṇḍapikāṃ śubhām ..
kārayetkusumāmodadivyābharaṇabhūṣitām .. 11 ..
4.28.d:
नेत्रपट्टपटीवस्त्रैर्वस्त्रमण्डपिकां शुभाम् ॥
कारयेत्कुसुमामोददिव्याभरणभूषिताम् ॥ 11 ॥
4.28.m: With silk cloths, fine garments, and woven textiles, she should erect an auspicious cloth pavilion, / adorned with fragrant flowers and heavenly ornaments, 11

4.28.s:
pravālalaṃbitavrātāmaṃtardivyavitānikām ..
vinyastapūrṇakalaśāṃ satpīṭhasthāpitadvijām .. 12 ..
4.28.d:
प्रवाललंबितव्रातामंतर्दिव्यवितानिकाम् ॥
विन्यस्तपूर्णकलशां सत्पीठस्थापितद्विजाम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.28.m: with clusters of coral hanging down, an inner celestial canopy, / full water-jars arranged, and Brahmins seated on excellent seats. 12

4.28.s:
purataḥ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ samekhalam ..
tataḥ snātānuliptāṃ ca paridhāya suvāsasī .. 13 ..
4.28.d:
पुरतः कारयेत्कुण्डं हस्तमात्रं समेखलम् ॥
ततः स्नातानुलिप्तां च परिधाय सुवाससी ॥ 13 ॥
4.28.m: In front, she should have a sacrificial pit made, measuring one cubit, with a stepped rim. / Then, having bathed, anointed herself, and put on two beautiful garments, 13

4.28.s:
devānpitṝnsamabhyarcya tato devīgṛhaṃ vrajet ..
nāmāṣṭakena saṃpūjyā gaurī gopativallabhā .. 14 ..
4.28.d:
देवान्पितॄन्समभ्यर्च्य ततो देवीगृहं व्रजेत् ॥
नामाष्टकेन संपूज्या गौरी गोपतिवल्लभा ॥ 14 ॥
4.28.m: having worshipped the gods and ancestors, she should then proceed to the temple of the goddess. / Gaurī, the beloved of Śiva, is to be worshipped with the eight names, 14

4.28.s:
tatkālaprabhavaiḥ puṣpairgandhāli bakulākulaiḥ ..
kuṃkumena samālabhya karpūrāgurucandanaiḥ .. 15 ..
4.28.d:
तत्कालप्रभवैः पुष्पैर्गन्धालि बकुलाकुलैः ॥
कुंकुमेन समालभ्य कर्पूरागुरुचन्दनैः ॥ 15 ॥
4.28.m: with flowers blooming in that season, filled with fragrant bees and bakula blossoms, / having anointed her with saffron, camphor, agallochum, and sandalwood. 15

4.28.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivatsaddhūpenādhivāsayet ..
pārvatī lalitā gaurī gāṃdhārī śāṅkarī śivā ..
umā satī samuddiṣṭaṃ nāmāṣṭakamidaṃ mayā .. 16 ..
4.28.d:
एवं संपूज्य विधिवत्सद्धूपेनाधिवासयेत् ॥
पार्वती ललिता गौरी गांधारी शाङ्करी शिवा ॥
उमा सती समुद्दिष्टं नामाष्टकमिदं मया ॥ 16 ॥
4.28.m: Having thus worshipped her properly, she should perfume her with excellent incense: / Pārvatī, Lalitā, Gaurī, Gāndhārī, Śāṅkarī, Śivā, / Umā, Satī—this is the group of eight names declared by me. 16

4.28.s:
laḍḍukaiḥ khaṇḍaveṣṭaiśca guḍakaiḥ siṃhakesaraiḥ ..
somālakaiḥ kokasaraiḥ khaṇḍakhādyakaraṃbakaiḥ .. 17 ..
4.28.d:
लड्डुकैः खण्डवेष्टैश्च गुडकैः सिंहकेसरैः ॥
सोमालकैः कोकसरैः खण्डखाद्यकरंबकैः ॥ 17 ॥
4.28.m: With laḍḍus, khaṇḍaveṣṭas, guḍakas, siṃhakesaras, / somālakas, kokasaras, and sugar-confection mixtures, 17

4.28.s:
ghṛtapakvairbahuvidhaiḥ supakvaphalakalpitaiḥ ..
dṛṣṭiprāṇaharairhṛdyairnnaivedyaiḥ prīṇayedumām .. 1. ..
kaṭukhaṃḍaṃ jīrakaṃ ca kuṃkumaṃ lavaṇārdrakam ..
ikṣudaṃḍānaikṣavaṃ ca haridrārdrānpuro nyaset .. 19 ..
4.28.d:
घृतपक्वैर्बहुविधैः सुपक्वफलकल्पितैः ॥
दृष्टिप्राणहरैर्हृद्यैर्न्नैवेद्यैः प्रीणयेदुमाम् ॥ 1॥।
कटुखंडं जीरकं च कुंकुमं लवणार्द्रकम् ॥
इक्षुदंडानैक्षवं च हरिद्रार्द्रान्पुरो न्यसेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.28.m: with many varieties cooked in ghee and prepared from ripe fruits, / pleasing offerings that delight the eyes and the breath of life, she should gratify Umā. / Pieces of pungent spices, cumin, saffron, salt, ginger, / stalks of sugarcane, sugar products, fresh turmeric—she should place these before [the goddess]. 18–19

4.28.s:
nārikelānāmalakānmātuluṃgānsadāḍimān ..
kūṣmāṇḍakarkaṭīvṛṃtanāraṅgapanasādikān .. 4.28.20 ..
4.28.d:
नारिकेलानामलकान्मातुलुंगान्सदाडिमान् ॥
कूष्माण्डकर्कटीवृंतनारङ्गपनसादिकान् ॥ 4.28.20 ॥
4.28.m: Coconuts, emblic myrobalans, citron fruits together with pomegranates, / ash gourds, cucumbers, stalk-vegetables, oranges, jackfruits, and the like, 4.28.20

4.28.s:
kālodbhavāni cānyāni phalāni vinivedayet ..
gṛhādyulūkhalaśilāśūrpānpraṇatibhiḥ saha .. 21 ..
4.28.d:
कालोद्भवानि चान्यानि फलानि विनिवेदयेत् ॥
गृहाद्युलूखलशिलाशूर्पान्प्रणतिभिः सह ॥ 21 ॥
4.28.m: and other fruits produced in that season she should offer, / along with bows, a mortar, a pestle, and winnowing baskets from the home. 21

4.28.s:
netrāṃjanaśalākāśca nakhare canakāni ca ..
darpaṇaṃ vaṃśapātrāṇi bhavānyai vinivedayet .. 22 ..
4.28.d:
नेत्रांजनशलाकाश्च नखरे चनकानि च ॥
दर्पणं वंशपात्राणि भवान्यै विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
4.28.m: Collyrium applicator rods for the eyes, nail-parings, chickpeas, / a mirror, and bamboo vessels she should present to Bhavānī. 22

4.28.s:
śaṃkhatūryaninādena gītamaṅgalanisvanaiḥ ..
bhaktyā saṃpūjayeddevīṃ svaśaktyā śivavallabhām .. 23 ..
4.28.d:
शंखतूर्यनिनादेन गीतमङ्गलनिस्वनैः ॥
भक्त्या संपूजयेद्देवीं स्वशक्त्या शिववल्लभाम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.28.m: With the sounding of conches and horns, and with songs and auspicious sounds, / she should worship the goddess, the beloved of Śiva, with devotion according to her capacity. 23

4.28.s:
tato'stasamaye bhānoḥ kumāryaḥ karakairnavaiḥ ..
snānaṃ kuryurmudā yuktāḥ saubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye .. 24 ..
4.28.d:
ततोऽस्तसमये भानोः कुमार्यः करकैर्नवैः ॥
स्नानं कुर्युर्मुदा युक्ताः सौभाग्यारोग्यवृद्धये ॥ 24 ॥
4.28.m: Then, at the time of sunset, the maidens, filled with joy, / should take a bath using new water-pots for the increase of good fortune and health. 24

4.28.s:
yāmeyāme gate snānaṃ devīpūjanameva ca ..
taireva nāmabhirhomastilājyena praśasyate .. 25 ..
4.28.d:
यामेयामे गते स्नानं देवीपूजनमेव च ॥
तैरेव नामभिर्होमस्तिलाज्येन प्रशस्यते ॥ 25 ॥
4.28.m: As each watch of the night passes, bathing and worship of the goddess [are performed]; / a fire-offering with sesame and ghee using those very same names is commended. 25

4.28.s:
padmāsanasthitā sādhvī tenaivārdreṇa vāsasā ..
gaurīmukhekṣaṇaparā tāṃ rātrimativāhayet .. 26 ..
4.28.d:
पद्मासनस्थिता साध्वी तेनैवार्द्रेण वाससा ॥
गौरीमुखेक्षणपरा तां रात्रिमतिवाहयेत् ॥ 26 ॥
4.28.m: Seated in the lotus posture, in those same wet garments, / intent on beholding the face of Gaurī, the virtuous woman should spend that night. 26

4.28.s:
kāścidvādyaṃti saṃhṛṣṭāḥ kāścinnṛtyaṃti harṣitāḥ ..
kathayaṃti kathāḥ kāściddevyāstatra mahotsave .. 27 ..
4.28.d:
काश्चिद्वाद्यंति संहृष्टाः काश्चिन्नृत्यंति हर्षिताः ॥
कथयंति कथाः काश्चिद्देव्यास्तत्र महोत्सवे ॥ 27 ॥
4.28.m: Some play musical instruments with delight, some dance joyfully, / and some recite stories there during that great festival of the goddess. 27

4.28.s:
gītatālānu saṃbaddhamanuddhatamanākulam ..
nṛtyaṃti sma pure devyāḥ kāścidullasitabhruvaḥ .. 28 ..
4.28.d:
गीततालानु संबद्धमनुद्धतमनाकुलम् ॥
नृत्यंति स्म पुरे देव्याः काश्चिदुल्लसितभ्रुवः ॥ 28 ॥
4.28.m: Attuned to song and rhythm, neither wild nor agitated, / some women with dancing brows danced before the goddess. 28

4.28.s:
nṛtyena hṛṣyati haro gaurī gītena tuṣyati ..
sadbhāvenātha vā sarve gacchaṃti paramāṃ mudam .. 29 ..
4.28.d:
नृत्येन हृष्यति हरो गौरी गीतेन तुष्यति ॥
सद्भावेनाथ वा सर्वे गच्छंति परमां मुदम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.28.m: Hara rejoices at dance, Gaurī is delighted by song; / or rather, all attain supreme joy through genuine devotion. 29

4.28.s:
suvāsinībhyastāṃbūlaṃ kuṃkumaṃ kusumāni ca ..
pradeyaṃ jāgaravatyā cānyeṣāmapi kiṃcana .. 4.28.30 ..
4.28.d:
सुवासिनीभ्यस्तांबूलं कुंकुमं कुसुमानि च ॥
प्रदेयं जागरवत्या चान्येषामपि किंचन ॥ 4.28.30 ॥
4.28.m: Betel, saffron, and flowers should be given to married women whose husbands are living / by the woman keeping the night vigil, and something to others as well. 4.28.30

4.28.s:
naṭairviṭairbhaṭaiścaiva tathā prekṣaṇakotsavaiḥ ..
sakhibhiḥ sahitā rātriṃ gāyanṛtyanhitāṃ nayet .. 31 ..
4.28.d:
नटैर्विटैर्भटैश्चैव तथा प्रेक्षणकोत्सवैः ॥
सखिभिः सहिता रात्रिं गायनृत्यन्हितां नयेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.28.m: With actors, rogues, soldiers, and dramatic spectacles, / accompanied by her female friends, singing and dancing, she should spend the beneficial night. 31

4.28.s:
evaṃ prabhātasamaye snātvā saṃpūjya pārvatīm ..
tato vai sā samārohedvastrālaṃkṛtatoraṇam .. 32 ..
4.28.d:
एवं प्रभातसमये स्नात्वा संपूज्य पार्वतीम् ॥
ततो वै सा समारोहेद्वस्त्रालंकृततोरणम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.28.m: In this manner, having bathed and worshipped Pārvatī at the time of dawn, / she should then mount an archway adorned with cloth. 32

4.28.s:
tolayetsā tathāsīnaṃ guḍena lavaṇena ca ..
kuṃkumenātha vā śaktyā karpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ .. 33 ..
4.28.d:
तोलयेत्सा तथासीनं गुडेन लवणेन च ॥
कुंकुमेनाथ वा शक्त्या कर्पूरागरुचंदनैः ॥ 33 ॥
4.28.m: Seated there, she should weigh [herself] against jaggery and salt, / or against saffron, or according to her means against camphor, agallochum, and sandalwood. 33

4.28.s:
parvatānāmapicchedaiḥ kecidicchaṃti sūrayaḥ ..
kuṃḍamaṃḍapasaṃbhārairmaṃtraistatraiva śobhayet .. 34 ..
4.28.d:
पर्वतानामपिच्छेदैः केचिदिच्छंति सूरयः ॥
कुंडमंडपसंभारैर्मंत्रैस्तत्रैव शोभयेत् ॥ 34 ॥
4.28.m: Some learned men also prescribe heaps of grains: / she should adorn [the site] right there with the accoutrements of the sacrificial pit and pavilion, and with mantras.

4.28.s:
lavaṇena sahātmā hi tolyate ca guḍena vā ..
kayāpi bhaktiparayā saubhāgyamatulīkṛtam .. 35 ..
4.28.d:
लवणेन सहात्मा हि तोल्यते च गुडेन वा ॥
कयापि भक्तिपरया सौभाग्यमतुलीकृतम् ॥ 35 ॥
4.28.m: When she weighs herself along with salt or molasses, / peerless good fortune is won by that devoted woman.

4.28.s:
evaṃ devīṃ praṇamyāryāṃ kṣamāpya gṛhamāviśet ..
āmaṃtrya śāstrakuśalānācāravidhipāragān .. .. 36 ..
4.28.d:
एवं देवीं प्रणम्यार्यां क्षमाप्य गृहमाविशेत् ॥
आमंत्र्य शास्त्रकुशलानाचारविधिपारगान् ॥ ॥ 36 ॥
4.28.m: Having thus bowed down before noble Goddess, asked forgiveness, and entered her home, / she should invite those skilled in scripture and versed in traditional rites and rules.

4.28.s:
annaṃ ca madhuraprāyaṃ bhojayitvā suvāsinīḥ ..
svayaṃ bhuṃjīta sahasā jñātījanabudhaiḥ svakaiḥ .. 37 ..
4.28.d:
अन्नं च मधुरप्रायं भोजयित्वा सुवासिनीः ॥
स्वयं भुंजीत सहसा ज्ञातीजनबुधैः स्वकैः ॥ 37 ॥
4.28.m: And after feeding sweet food to married women, / she should herself eat at once with her own kinsmen and wise companions.

4.28.s:
yacca devyāḥ puro dattaṃ naive dyādi tadicchayā ..
gṛhaṃ pratinayetsarvaṃ vibhajyābhrāṃtimānasā .. 38 ..
4.28.d:
यच्च देव्याः पुरो दत्तं नैवे द्यादि तदिच्छया ॥
गृहं प्रतिनयेत्सर्वं विभज्याभ्रांतिमानसा ॥ 38 ॥
4.28.m: And whatever food offering and the like was presented before the Goddess, she may according to her wish / take all of it home and distribute it with an unclouded mind.

4.28.s:
tato dadyādgṛhasthebhyaḥ kṛtakṛtyā bhavettadā ..
vidhirbhādrapade'pyeṣa susaundaryapradāyakaḥ .. 39 ..
4.28.d:
ततो दद्याद्गृहस्थेभ्यः कृतकृत्या भवेत्तदा ॥
विधिर्भाद्रपदेऽप्येष सुसौन्दर्यप्रदायकः ॥ 39 ॥
4.28.m: Then she should give [gifts] to householders; then she becomes one who has achieved her goal. / This rite, when done also in Bhādrapada, bestows great beauty.

4.28.s:
saptadhānyasvarūpāṃ ca śūrpe saṃpūjayedumām ..
gomūtraprāśanaṃ hyatra tena gomūtrasaṃjñitā .. 4.28.40 ..
4.28.d:
सप्तधान्यस्वरूपां च शूर्पे संपूजयेदुमाम् ॥
गोमूत्रप्राशनं ह्यत्र तेन गोमूत्रसंज्ञिता ॥ 4.28.40 ॥
4.28.m: And she should worship Umā in the form of seven kinds of grain in a winnowing basket. / Drinking cow's urine is prescribed here; therefore it is named 'Gomūtrā'.

4.28.s:
māghamāsatṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣaḥ śrūyatāmiti ..
pūrvoktaṃ sakalaṃ kṛtvā prabhāte yavasaṃstaram ..
tolayitvā kuṃdapuṣpaiḥ pūjayettatsutāmiti .. 41 ..
4.28.d:
माघमासतृतीयायां विशेषः श्रूयतामिति ॥
पूर्वोक्तं सकलं कृत्वा प्रभाते यवसंस्तरम् ॥
तोलयित्वा कुंदपुष्पैः पूजयेत्तत्सुतामिति ॥ 41 ॥
4.28.m: Hear the special rule for the third [lunar day] of the month of Māgha: / Having done all that was mentioned before, in the morning she should weigh a bed of barley, / and she should worship her daughter with jasmine flowers.

4.28.s:
etena kāraṇenoktā caturthī kundasaṃjñayā ..
tṛtīyākhyaṃ mayaitatte kathitaṃ sarvakāraṇam ..
jayayā munikanyānāṃ yatpurā samudāhṛtam .. 42 ..
4.28.d:
एतेन कारणेनोक्ता चतुर्थी कुन्दसंज्ञया ॥
तृतीयाख्यं मयैतत्ते कथितं सर्वकारणम् ॥
जयया मुनिकन्यानां यत्पुरा समुदाहृतम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.28.m: For this reason the fourth [lunar day] is called 'Kundacaturthī'. / I have told you this entire procedure called the Tṛtīyā [votive observance], / which was declared of old by Jayā to the daughters of sages.

4.28.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
āsīdvidarbhanagare veśyā sarvāṃgasuṃdarī ..
tayā brāhmaṇavākyena sarvametatkṛtaṃ purā .. 43 ..
4.28.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
आसीद्विदर्भनगरे वेश्या सर्वांगसुंदरी ॥
तया ब्राह्मणवाक्येन सर्वमेतत्कृतं पुरा ॥ 43 ॥
4.28.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / In the city of Vidarbha, there was a courtesan beautiful in all her limbs. / By the word of a brahmin, she performed all this of old.

4.28.s: bhuktvā bhogānmahīpṛṣṭhe dattvā dānaṃ yathepsayā .. 44 ..
4.28.d: भुक्त्वा भोगान्महीपृष्ठे दत्त्वा दानं यथेप्सया ॥ 44 ॥
4.28.m: Having enjoyed pleasures on the earth's surface, and given gifts as she desired,

4.28.s:
kālena samanuprāptā maraṇaṃ manujeśvara ..
acintyā rājaduhitā sā babhūvātiśobhanā ..
avaṃtisundarī nāma devānāmapi sundarī .. 45 ..
4.28.d:
कालेन समनुप्राप्ता मरणं मनुजेश्वर ॥
अचिन्त्या राजदुहिता सा बभूवातिशोभना ॥
अवंतिसुन्दरी नाम देवानामपि सुन्दरी ॥ 45 ॥
4.28.m: in time she met her death, O lord of men. / Inconceivable, she became an exceedingly beautiful king's daughter / named Avantisundarī, beautiful even to the gods.

4.28.s:
yadi vaktrasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ syātkathaṃcana ..
tathāpi nirvarṇayitumaśakyā sā sulocanā .. 46 ..
4.28.d:
यदि वक्त्रसहस्राणां सहस्रं स्यात्कथंचन ॥
तथापि निर्वर्णयितुमशक्या सा सुलोचना ॥ 46 ॥
4.28.m: Even if there were somehow a thousand thousand mouths, / still that fair-eyed maiden could not be fully described.

4.28.s:
caitratṛtīyāmāhātmyātsā babhūva prabhāvatī ..
mātāpitroratipreṣṭhā śiṣṭā nyajanavallabhā .. 47 ..
4.28.d:
चैत्रतृतीयामाहात्म्यात्सा बभूव प्रभावती ॥
मातापित्रोरतिप्रेष्ठा शिष्टा न्यजनवल्लभा ॥ 47 ॥
4.28.m: By the majesty of the third [lunar day] of Caitra, she became radiant, / exceedingly dear to her mother and father, and beloved by cultivated and other people.

4.28.s:
labdhābdhisaṃbhavā yadvatkṛṣṇenākliṣṭakarmaṇā ..
tataḥ sā bubhuje bhogānbhartrā sārddhaṃ mudā satī .. 48 ..
4.28.d:
लब्धाब्धिसंभवा यद्वत्कृष्णेनाक्लिष्टकर्मणा ॥
ततः सा बुभुजे भोगान्भर्त्रा सार्द्धं मुदा सती ॥ 48 ॥
4.28.m: Just as the ocean-born [Lakṣmī] was obtained by Kṛṣṇa of untiring deeds, / so that virtuous wife joyfully enjoyed pleasures with her husband.

4.28.s:
yadadādbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ sā bhūṣaṇaṃ kaṭakādikam ..
tatprabhāveṇa sā lebhe saubhāgyaṃ kiṃ tataḥ param .. 49 ..
4.28.d:
यददाद्ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सा भूषणं कटकादिकम् ॥
तत्प्रभावेण सा लेभे सौभाग्यं किं ततः परम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.28.m: Because she gave ornaments such as bracelets to brahmins, / by that power she obtained good fortune; what could be higher than that?

4.28.s:
putrāṃśca janayāmāsa viṣṇuśakraparākramān ..
sarvāstraśastrakuśalā nvedoktavidhipāragān .. 4.28.50 ..
4.28.d:
पुत्रांश्च जनयामास विष्णुशक्रपराक्रमान् ॥
सर्वास्त्रशस्त्रकुशला न्वेदोक्तविधिपारगान् ॥ 4.28.50 ॥
4.28.m: And she gave birth to sons equal in prowess to Viṣṇu and Śakra, / skilled in all missiles and weapons, and versed in the rites taught in the Vedas.

4.28.s:
evaṃ rūpaṃ mahatprāpya saubhāgyaṃ putrasaṃpadam ..
bhartrā sahaiva maraṇamaṃte prāpya pativratā .. 51 ..
4.28.d:
एवं रूपं महत्प्राप्य सौभाग्यं पुत्रसंपदम् ॥
भर्त्रा सहैव मरणमंते प्राप्य पतिव्रता ॥ 51 ॥
4.28.m: Having thus attained great beauty, good fortune, and abundant sons, / that devoted wife, dying in the end together with her husband,

4.28.s:
śakrādilokapā lānāṃ bhavaneṣu yathākramam ..
ākramya brahmalokaṃ ca jagāma śivasātmatām .. 52 ..
4.28.d:
शक्रादिलोकपा लानां भवनेषु यथाक्रमम् ॥
आक्रम्य ब्रह्मलोकं च जगाम शिवसात्मताम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.28.m: went in due succession to the mansions of the world protectors, Śakra and others, / and passing beyond the realm of Brahmā, attained oneness with Śiva.

4.28.s:
evaṃ yānyāpi kurute nārī vratamidaṃ śubham ..
sā rūpasaubhāgyasutānprāpya svarge mahīyate .. 53 ..
4.28.d:
एवं यान्यापि कुरुते नारी व्रतमिदं शुभम् ॥
सा रूपसौभाग्यसुतान्प्राप्य स्वर्गे महीयते ॥ 53 ॥
4.28.m: Whatever other woman also performs this auspicious votive observance / attains beauty, good fortune, and sons, and is glorified in heaven.

4.28.s:
na durbhagā kule tasyāḥ kācidbhavati kanyakā ..
na durvinītaśca suto na bhṛtyo'priyakṛdbhavet .. 54 ..
4.28.d:
न दुर्भगा कुले तस्याः काचिद्भवति कन्यका ॥
न दुर्विनीतश्च सुतो न भृत्योऽप्रियकृद्भवेत् ॥ 54 ॥
4.28.m: No maiden born in her family becomes unfortunate, / no son ill-mannered, and no servant brings displeasure.

4.28.s:
na dāridryaṃ gṛhe tasminna vyādhirupajāyate ..
yatra sā ramate sādhvī dhmātacāmīkaraprabhā .. 55
4.28.d:
न दारिद्र्यं गृहे तस्मिन्न व्याधिरुपजायते ॥
यत्र सा रमते साध्वी ध्मातचामीकरप्रभा ॥ 55
4.28.m: Neither poverty nor disease arises in that household / where that virtuous woman, radiant like molten gold, takes her delight.

4.28.s:
anyāśca yāścariṣyaṃti brāhmaṇānumate vratam ..
saṃpūjya vācakaṃ bhaktyā bhūṣaṇācchādanādibhiḥ .. 56 ..
4.28.d:
अन्याश्च याश्चरिष्यंति ब्राह्मणानुमते व्रतम् ॥
संपूज्य वाचकं भक्त्या भूषणाच्छादनादिभिः ॥ 56 ॥
4.28.m: And whatever other women will practice the votive observance with the approval of brahmins, / having devoutly worshipped the reciter with ornaments, clothing, and the like,

4.28.s:
tāḥ sarvasukhasaṃpannā avipannamanorathāḥ ..
bhaviṣyaṃti kuruśreṣṭha tasyai devi namostu te .. 57 ..
4.28.d:
ताः सर्वसुखसंपन्ना अविपन्नमनोरथाः ॥
भविष्यंति कुरुश्रेष्ठ तस्यै देवि नमोस्तु ते ॥ 57 ॥
4.28.m: they will be endowed with all happiness, their wishes unfailing, / O best of the Kurus. Homage be to that Goddess!

4.28.s:
māghe mahārghyamaṇimaṃḍitapādapīṭhāṃ caitre vicitrakusumotkaracarcitāṃgīm ..
śūrpaprarūḍhanavasasyamayīṃ nabhasye saṃpūjya śaṃbhudayitāṃ prabhavaṃti nāryaḥ .. .. 58 ..
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇa uttaraparvaṇi śrīkṛṣṇayudhiṣṭhirasaṃvāde caitrabhādrapadamāghatṛtīyāvratavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 28 .. ..
anantaratṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.28.d:
माघे महार्घ्यमणिमंडितपादपीठां चैत्रे विचित्रकुसुमोत्करचर्चितांगीम् ॥
शूर्पप्ररूढनवसस्यमयीं नभस्ये संपूज्य शंभुदयितां प्रभवंति नार्यः ॥ ॥ 58 ॥
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे चैत्रभाद्रपदमाघतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनं नामाष्टविंशतितमोऽध्यायः ॥ 28 ॥ ॥
अनन्तरतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.28.m:
Women prevail who worship Śambhu's beloved [consort], / whose footstool is adorned with costly gems in Māgha, whose limbs are smeared with an abundance of various flowers in Caitra, / and who consists of fresh grain sprouted in a winnowing basket in Nabhasya.
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Votive Observance of the Third Lunar Day in Caitra, Bhādrapada, and Māgha', in the dialogue between Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Yudhiṣṭhira, in the Uttaraparvan of the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Votive Observance of Successive Third Lunar Days

4.29.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śuklapakṣatṛtīyāstu bahavaḥ samudāhṛtāḥ ..
ānantaryavrataṃ brūhi tṛtīyobhayasaṃyutam .. 1 ..
4.29.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
शुक्लपक्षतृतीयास्तु बहवः समुदाहृताः ॥
आनन्तर्यव्रतं ब्रूहि तृतीयोभयसंयुतम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.29.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Many third lunar days of the bright fortnight have been proclaimed. / Tell me of the uninterrupted votive observance that encompasses both third lunar days [of each month],

4.29.s:
hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ lalanānāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
nāma prāśananaivedyairmāsimāsi pṛthakpṛthaka .. 2 ..
4.29.d:
हिताय सर्वभूतानां ललनानां विशेषतः ॥
नाम प्राशननैवेद्यैर्मासिमासि पृथक्पृथक ॥ 2 ॥
4.29.m: for the benefit of all living beings, and especially of women, / month by month, each with its name, food to be tasted, and offerings.

4.29.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmaviṣṇumaheśādyairyathoktaṃ surasattamaiḥ ..
apūrvaṃ sarvamaṃtrāṇāmānaṃtaryavrataṃ śṛṇu .. 3 ..
4.29.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुमहेशाद्यैर्यथोक्तं सुरसत्तमैः ॥
अपूर्वं सर्वमंत्राणामानंतर्यव्रतं शृणु ॥ 3 ॥
4.29.m: The Blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / Hear this incomparable votive observance of uninterrupted succession among all mantras, / as spoken by the foremost among gods, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Maheśa, and the others.

4.29.s:
ādau mārgaśire māsi vratametatsamācaret ..
naktaṃ kuryāddvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitā .. 4 ..
4.29.d:
आदौ मार्गशिरे मासि व्रतमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥
नक्तं कुर्याद्द्वितीयायां तृतीयायामुपोषिता ॥ 4 ॥
4.29.m: First, one should undertake this votive observance in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa: / she should eat a nocturnal meal on the second lunar day, and fast on the third.

4.29.s:
umāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya puṣpagaṃdhādibhiḥ kramāt ..
śarkarāputrikāṃ śaktyā praṇipatya nivedayet .. 5 ..
4.29.d:
उमां देवीं समभ्यर्च्य पुष्पगंधादिभिः क्रमात् ॥
शर्करापुत्रिकां शक्त्या प्रणिपत्य निवेदयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.29.m: Having duly worshipped the goddess Umā with flowers, fragrances, and the like, / she should bow down and offer, according to her means, a doll made of sugar.

4.29.s:
saṃprāśya dadhi rātrau ca svapyādvigatamatsarā ..
prabhāte vidhivadbhaktyā mithunaṃ bhojayetsudhīḥ ..6..
4.29.d:
संप्राश्य दधि रात्रौ च स्वप्याद्विगतमत्सरा ॥
प्रभाते विधिवद्भक्त्या मिथुनं भोजयेत्सुधीः ॥6॥
4.29.m: Having tasted curds at night, free from malice she should sleep. / In the morning, the wise woman should devoutly feed a married couple according to rule.

4.29.s:
aśvamedhamavāpnoti samagraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā .. 7 ..
4.29.d:
अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति समग्रं नात्र संशयः ॥
तथा कृष्णतृतीयायां सोपवासा जितेन्द्रिया ॥ 7 ॥
4.29.m: She obtains the entire [fruit of an] horse sacrifice; there is no doubt of this. / Likewise on the third lunar day of the dark fortnight, fasting and with senses conquered,

4.29.s:
japetkātyāyanīṃ nāma nāli keraṃ nivedayet ..
svapyātprāśya payo rātrau kāmakrodhavivarjitā ..
dāṃpatyaṃ subhagaṃ bhojyaṃ gomedhaphalamāpnuyāt .. 8 ..
4.29.d:
जपेत्कात्यायनीं नाम नालि केरं निवेदयेत् ॥
स्वप्यात्प्राश्य पयो रात्रौ कामक्रोधविवर्जिता ॥
दांपत्यं सुभगं भोज्यं गोमेधफलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 8 ॥
4.29.m: she should recite the name 'Kātyāyanī' and offer a coconut. / Having tasted milk at night, free from lust and anger, she should sleep. / A handsome married couple should be fed; she attains the fruit of a cow sacrifice.

4.29.s:
pauṣasyāditṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā jitendriyā ..
gaurīṃ nāma tu saṃpūjya laḍḍukānvinivedayet .. 9 ..
4.29.d:
पौषस्यादितृतीयायां सोपवासा जितेन्द्रिया ॥
गौरीं नाम तु संपूज्य लड्डुकान्विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 9 ॥
4.29.m: On the first third lunar day of Pauṣa, fasting and with senses conquered, / worshipping with the name 'Gaurī', she should offer sweetmeat balls.

4.29.s:
svapyātprāśya ghṛtaṃ rātrau tyaktvā kāmaṃ tadagrataḥ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ naramedhaphalaṃ bhavet .. 4.29.10 ..
4.29.d:
स्वप्यात्प्राश्य घृतं रात्रौ त्यक्त्वा कामं तदग्रतः॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यं नरमेधफलं भवेत् ॥ 4.29.10 ॥
4.29.m: She should taste clarified butter at night, sleep after casting off desire in front of her [image]. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; the fruit of a human sacrifice is attained.

4.29.s:
evaṃ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ pārvatīmiti pūjayet ..
nivedayānnaṃ śaṣkulyo gomayaṃ prāśayenniśi ..
dāṃpatyaṃ vividhaṃ bhojyama śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 11 ..
4.29.d:
एवं कृष्णतृतीयायां पार्वतीमिति पूजयेत् ॥
निवेदयान्नं शष्कुल्यो गोमयं प्राशयेन्निशि ॥
दांपत्यं विविधं भोज्यम श्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.29.m: Likewise on the third lunar day of the dark fortnight, she should worship [the Goddess] as 'Pārvatī'. / She should offer food and pastries, and taste cow dung at night. / A married couple should be fed with various foods; she obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice.

4.29.s:
māghasya śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāmupoṣitaḥ ..
suranāyikāṃ ca saṃpūjya khaṇḍabilvaṃ nivedayet .. 12 ..
4.29.d:
माघस्य शुक्लपक्षे तु तृतीयायामुपोषितः ॥
सुरनायिकां च संपूज्य खण्डबिल्वं निवेदयेत् ॥ 12 ॥
4.29.m: And in the bright fortnight of Māgha, fasting on the third lunar day, / having worshipped the Queen of the Gods, she should offer pieces of bilva fruit.

4.29.s:
tataḥ kuśodakaṃ prāśya svapyādbhūmau jitendriyā ..
prabhāte madhurānnena mithunaṃ bhojya bhaktitaḥ ..
kṣamāpyāṃte namaskṛtya iti svarṇaphalaṃ labhet .. 13 ..
4.29.d:
ततः कुशोदकं प्राश्य स्वप्याद्भूमौ जितेन्द्रिया ॥
प्रभाते मधुरान्नेन मिथुनं भोज्य भक्तितः ॥
क्षमाप्यांते नमस्कृत्य इति स्वर्णफलं लभेत् ॥ 13 ॥
4.29.m: Then, having sipped kuśa water, with senses conquered, she should sleep on the ground. / In the morning, having fed a married couple devoutly with sweet food, / and having asked forgiveness and bowed down at the end, she obtains the fruit of gold.

4.29.s:
punaretattato māghe kṛṣṇapakṣe śucivratā ..
āryāṃ nāmnā prapūjyātha khādyakāni nivedayet .. 14 ..
4.29.d:
पुनरेतत्ततो माघे कृष्णपक्षे शुचिव्रता ॥
आर्यां नाम्ना प्रपूज्याथ खाद्यकानि निवेदयेत् ॥ 14 ॥
4.29.m: Then again in the dark fortnight in Māgha, pure in her observance, / having worshipped [the Goddess] by the name 'Āryā', she should offer delicacies to eat.

4.29.s:
madhu prāśya svapedrātrau kāmakrodhavivarjitā ..
mithunaṃ bhojayitvā tu vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet .. 15 ..
4.29.d:
मधु प्राश्य स्वपेद्रात्रौ कामक्रोधविवर्जिता ॥
मिथुनं भोजयित्वा तु वाजपेयफलं लभेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.29.m: Having partaken of honey, she should sleep at night, free from lust and anger. / Having fed a married couple, she obtains the reward of a Vājapeya sacrifice.

4.29.s:
evaṃ vai phālgune māsi sopavāsā śucivratā ..
bhadrīṃ nāma prapūjyātha kāsāraṃ vinivedayet .. 16 ..
4.29.d:
एवं वै फाल्गुने मासि सोपवासा शुचिव्रता ॥
भद्रीं नाम प्रपूज्याथ कासारं विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 16 ॥
4.29.m: Thus indeed, in the month of Phālguna, fasting, firm in pure observances, / having worshipped [the Goddess] by the name of Bhadrī, she should offer kāsāra halva.

4.29.s:
suprāśya śarkarāṃ cātha svapyādrātrau vimatsarā ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ sautrāmaṇiphalaṃ labheta .. 17 ..
4.29.d:
सुप्राश्य शर्करां चाथ स्वप्याद्रात्रौ विमत्सरा ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यं सौत्रामणिफलं लभेत ॥ 17 ॥
4.29.m: And having partaken well of sugar, she should sleep at night free from malice. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of a Sautrāmaṇī sacrifice.

4.29.s:
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ phālgunasyaiva bhārata..
viśālākṣīṃ samabhyarcya pūrikā vinivedayet .. 18 ..
4.29.d:
पुनः कृष्णतृतीयायां फाल्गुनस्यैव भारत॥
विशालाक्षीं समभ्यर्च्य पूरिका विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 18 ॥
4.29.m: Again, on the dark third [tithi] of Phālguna, O descendant of Bharata, / having thoroughly worshipped Viśālākṣī, she should offer pūrikā cakes.

4.29.s:
sodakāṃstaṃḍulāndattvā svapyādbhūmau manasvinī ..
bhojayenmithunaṃ prātaragniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet .. 19 ..
4.29.d:
सोदकांस्तंडुलान्दत्त्वा स्वप्याद्भूमौ मनस्विनी ॥
भोजयेन्मिथुनं प्रातरग्निष्टोमफलं लभेत् ॥ 19 ॥
4.29.m: Having offered rice grains with water, the resolute woman should sleep on the ground. / She should feed a married couple in the morning; she obtains the reward of an Agniṣṭoma sacrifice.

4.29.s:
caitrasyāditṛtīyāyāṃ śucirbhūtā jitendriyā ..
śriyaṃ devīṃ yajedbhaktyā vaṭakānvinivedayet .. 4.29.20 ..
4.29.d:
चैत्रस्यादितृतीयायां शुचिर्भूता जितेन्द्रिया ॥
श्रियं देवीं यजेद्भक्त्या वटकान्विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 4.29.20 ॥
4.29.m: On the first third [tithi] of Caitra, purified, with senses controlled, / she should worship the goddess Śrī with devotion and offer vaṭaka cakes.

4.29.s:
bilvapatraṃ tataḥ prāśya svapyāddhyāna parāyaṇā ..
prātarutthāya madbhaktyā mithunaṃ pūjayetsudhīḥ ..
praṇipatya kṣamāpyaivaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet .. 21 ..
4.29.d:
बिल्वपत्रं ततः प्राश्य स्वप्याद्ध्यान परायणा ॥
प्रातरुत्थाय मद्भक्त्या मिथुनं पूजयेत्सुधीः ॥
प्रणिपत्य क्षमाप्यैवं राजसूयफलं लभेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.29.m: Then, having partaken of a bilva leaf, she should sleep, intent on meditation. / Having risen in the morning, the wise woman should worship a married couple with devotion to me; / having bowed down and asked for forgiveness, she thus obtains the reward of a Rājasūya sacrifice.

4.29.s:
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ caitre samyagupoṣitaḥ ..
kālīṃ nāma samabhyarcya piṣṭaṃ prāśya svapenniśi .. 22 ..
4.29.d:
पुनः कृष्णतृतीयायां चैत्रे सम्यगुपोषितः ॥
कालीं नाम समभ्यर्च्य पिष्टं प्राश्य स्वपेन्निशि ॥ 22 ॥
4.29.m: Again, on the dark third [tithi] in Caitra, fasting properly, / having worshipped [the Goddess] by the name of Kālī and partaken of flour, she should sleep at night.

4.29.s:
pūpakāni nivedyātha kuryādrātrau prajāgaram ..
mithunāni ca saṃbhojya atirātraphalaṃ bhavet .. 23 ..
4.29.d:
पूपकानि निवेद्याथ कुर्याद्रात्रौ प्रजागरम् ॥
मिथुनानि च संभोज्य अतिरात्रफलं भवेत् ॥ 23 ॥
4.29.m: Having offered sweet cakes, she should then keep vigil through the night. / And having fed married couples, there shall be the reward of an Atirātra sacrifice.

4.29.s:
evaṃ vaiśākhamāse tu sopavāsā jitendriyā ..
pūjayeccaṇḍikāṃ devīṃ madhukāni nivedayet .. 24 ..
4.29.d:
एवं वैशाखमासे तु सोपवासा जितेन्द्रिया ॥
पूजयेच्चण्डिकां देवीं मधुकानि निवेदयेत् ॥ 24 ॥
4.29.m: Thus in the month of Vaiśākha, fasting, with senses subdued, / she should worship the goddess Caṇḍikā and offer madhuka [flowers].

4.29.s:
śrīkhaṃḍaṃ caṃdanaṃ liptvā svapyāddevyagrato bhuvi ..
bhojayitvā ca dāṃpatyaṃ cāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet .. 25 ..
4.29.d:
श्रीखंडं चंदनं लिप्त्वा स्वप्याद्देव्यग्रतो भुवि ॥
भोजयित्वा च दांपत्यं चांद्रायणफलं लभेत् ॥ 25 ॥
4.29.m: Having smeared śrīkhaṇḍa sandalwood paste, she should sleep on the ground before the goddess. / And having fed a married couple, she obtains the reward of a Cāndrāyaṇa penance.

4.29.s:
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā vimatsarā ..
pūjayetkālarātriṃ tu gandhapuṣpaiḥ sadīpakaiḥ .. 26 ..
4.29.d:
तथा कृष्णतृतीयायां सोपवासा विमत्सरा ॥
पूजयेत्कालरात्रिं तु गन्धपुष्पैः सदीपकैः ॥ 26 ॥
4.29.m: Likewise, on the dark third [tithi], fasting, free from envy, / she should worship Kālarātri with perfumes, flowers, and lamps.

4.29.s:
surājyaṃ yāvakaṃ dattvā tilānbhuṃjansvapenniśi ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyama tikṛcchraphalaṃ labhet .. 27 ..
4.29.d:
सुराज्यं यावकं दत्त्वा तिलान्भुंजन्स्वपेन्निशि ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यम तिकृच्छ्रफलं लभेत् ॥ 27 ॥
4.29.m: Having offered barley porridge with good clarified butter and eating sesame seeds, she should sleep at night. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of an Atikṛcchra penance.

4.29.s:
jyeṣṭhe sitatṛtīyāyāṃ hyupavāsakṛtāṃ varā ..
śubhāṃ devīṃ samabhyarcya āmrāṇi vinivedayet ..
saṃprāśyāmalakaṃ rātrau gaurīṃ dhyātvā sukhaṃ svapet .. 28 ..
4.29.d:
ज्येष्ठे सिततृतीयायां ह्युपवासकृतां वरा ॥
शुभां देवीं समभ्यर्च्य आम्राणि विनिवेदयेत् ॥
संप्राश्यामलकं रात्रौ गौरीं ध्यात्वा सुखं स्वपेत् ॥ 28 ॥
4.29.m: In Jyeṣṭha, on the bright third [tithi], the best of those who observe fasts, / having worshipped the auspicious Goddess, should offer mangoes. / Having partaken of an āmalaka fruit at night and meditated on Gaurī, she should sleep happily.

4.29.s:
tataḥ prātaḥ samutthāya daṃpatī rūpaśālinau ..
bhojayitvā vidhānena tīrthayātrāphalaṃ labhet .. 29 ..
4.29.d:
ततः प्रातः समुत्थाय दंपती रूपशालिनौ ॥
भोजयित्वा विधानेन तीर्थयात्राफलं लभेत् ॥ 29 ॥
4.29.m: Then, having risen in the morning and fed a handsome married couple / according to the rules, she obtains the reward of a pilgrimage to sacred fords.

4.29.s:
punaḥ kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā suvāsinī ..
skandamāteti saṃpūjya iḍāyai vinivedayet .. 4.29.30 ..
4.29.d:
पुनः कृष्णतृतीयायां सोपवासा सुवासिनी ॥
स्कन्दमातेति संपूज्य इडायै विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 4.29.30 ॥
4.29.m: Again, on the dark third [tithi], fasting, a married woman / having worshipped [the Goddess] as Skandamātā, should make an offering to Iḍā.

4.29.s:
prāśayetpaṃcagavyañca svapyāddevyagratastataḥ ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ kanyādānaphalaṃ labhet .. 31 ..
4.29.d:
प्राशयेत्पंचगव्यञ्च स्वप्याद्देव्यग्रतस्ततः ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यं कन्यादानफलं लभेत् ॥ 31 ॥
4.29.m: She should partake of the five products of the cow and then sleep before the goddess. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of giving a maiden in marriage.

4.29.s:
āṣāḍhamāse saṃprāpte pūjayecca yaśodhanam ..
karaṃjakaṃ ca naivedyaṃ gośṛṃgāṃbhaḥ pibenniśi ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ kanyādānaphalaṃ labhet .. 32 ..
4.29.d:
आषाढमासे संप्राप्ते पूजयेच्च यशोधनम् ॥
करंजकं च नैवेद्यं गोशृंगांभः पिबेन्निशि ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यं कन्यादानफलं लभेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.29.m: When the month of Āṣāḍha arrives, she should worship Yaśodhanā; / karañjaka should be the food offering, and she should drink water from a cow's horn at night. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of giving a maiden in marriage.

4.29.s:
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ kūṣmāṃḍīṃ śaktito yajet ..
saktūnguḍājyasaṃmuktānpurato vinivedayet .. 33 ..
4.29.d:
तथा कृष्णतृतीयायां कूष्मांडीं शक्तितो यजेत् ॥
सक्तून्गुडाज्यसंमुक्तान्पुरतो विनिवेदयेत् ॥ 33 ॥
4.29.m: Likewise, on the dark third [tithi], she should worship Kūṣmāṇḍī according to her capacity. / She should offer roasted barley flour mixed with jaggery and clarified butter before [the Goddess].

4.29.s:
kuśodakaṃ ca saṃprāśya svapyādrātrau jitendriyā ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ gosahasraphalaṃ labhet .. 34 ..
4.29.d:
कुशोदकं च संप्राश्य स्वप्याद्रात्रौ जितेन्द्रिया ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यं गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् ॥ 34 ॥
4.29.m: And having partaken of kuśa-grass water, she should sleep at night, her senses controlled. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of a thousand cows.

4.29.s:
śrāvaṇe sopavāsā ca caṃḍāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ prapūjayet ..
kulmāṣāstatra naivedyaṃ pibetpuṣpodakaṃ punaḥ .. 35 ..
4.29.d:
श्रावणे सोपवासा च चंडां घण्टां प्रपूजयेत् ॥
कुल्माषास्तत्र नैवेद्यं पिबेत्पुष्पोदकं पुनः ॥ 35 ॥
4.29.m: In Śrāvaṇa, fasting, she should worship Caṇḍā Ghaṇṭā. / Half-boiled grains are the food offering there; further, she should drink water scented with flowers.

4.29.s:
prabhāte śaktito dadyādbhojanaṃ mithunasya tu ..
prāpnotyabhayadānasya phalaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ .. 36 ..
4.29.d:
प्रभाते शक्तितो दद्याद्भोजनं मिथुनस्य तु ॥
प्राप्नोत्यभयदानस्य फलं नैवात्र संशयः ॥ 36 ॥
4.29.m: In the morning, according to her capacity, she should indeed give food to a married couple. / She attains the reward of the gift of fearlessness; of this there is no doubt.

4.29.s:
tadvatkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ rudrāṇīṃ nāmabhiryajet ..
siddhapiṃḍāni divyāni naivedyaṃ dāpayettathā .. 37 ..
4.29.d:
तद्वत्कृष्णतृतीयायां रुद्राणीं नामभिर्यजेत् ॥
सिद्धपिंडानि दिव्यानि नैवेद्यं दापयेत्तथा ॥ 37 ॥
4.29.m: In the same manner, on the dark third [tithi], she should worship Rudrāṇī with [her] names, / and likewise should present an offering of splendid cooked flour-balls.

4.29.s:
piṇyākaṃ prāśa yitvā tu svapyādrātrau vimatsarā ..
saṃpūjya dvijadāṃpatyamiṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ labhet .. 38 ..
4.29.d:
पिण्याकं प्राश यित्वा तु स्वप्याद्रात्रौ विमत्सरा ॥
संपूज्य द्विजदांपत्यमिष्टापूर्तफलं लभेत् ॥ 38 ॥
4.29.m: Having partaken of oil-cake, she should sleep at night free from envy. / Having honoured a brāhmaṇa couple, she obtains the reward of performing sacrifices and charitable works.

4.29.s:
bhādre śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ pūjayeta himādrijām ..
godhūmānnaṃ nivedyaiva prāśayeccandanaṃ sitam .. 39 ..
4.29.d:
भाद्रे शुक्लतृतीयायां पूजयेत हिमाद्रिजाम् ॥
गोधूमान्नं निवेद्यैव प्राशयेच्चन्दनं सितम् ॥ 39 ॥
4.29.m: In Bhādrapada, on the bright third [tithi], she should worship the daughter of the Snow Mountain. / Having offered wheat food, she should partake of white sandalwood.

4.29.s:
gandhodakaṃ tataḥ prāśya sakhībhiḥ sahitā svapet ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ mārgapālīśataṃ labhet .. 4.29.40 ..
4.29.d:
गन्धोदकं ततः प्राश्य सखीभिः सहिता स्वपेत् ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यं मार्गपालीशतं लभेत् ॥ 4.29.40 ॥
4.29.m: Then, having drunk fragrant water, she should sleep together with her female companions. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains [the fruit of] a hundred Mārgapālī [festivals].

4.29.s:
tadvatkṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ durgāṃ daivīṃ samarcayet ..
dadyātpiṣṭaphalāndivyānguḍājyaparipūritān .. 41 ..
4.29.d:
तद्वत्कृष्णतृतीयायां दुर्गां दैवीं समर्चयेत् ॥
दद्यात्पिष्टफलान्दिव्यान्गुडाज्यपरिपूरितान् ॥ 41 ॥
4.29.m: In the same manner, on the dark third [tithi], she should worship the goddess Durgā. / She should give splendid flour-fruits filled with jaggery and clarified butter.

4.29.s:
prāśayitvā tu gomūtraṃ svapyācchāṃtena cetasā ..
prātastu mithunaṃ bhojyaṃ sadāsatraphalaṃ labhet ..42..
4.29.d:
प्राशयित्वा तु गोमूत्रं स्वप्याच्छांतेन चेतसा ॥
प्रातस्तु मिथुनं भोज्यं सदासत्रफलं लभेत् ॥42॥
4.29.m: Having partaken of cow's urine, she should sleep with a peaceful mind. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of a continuous sacrificial session.

4.29.s:
māsi cāśvayuje bhaktyā devīṃ nārāyaṇīṃ yajet ..
sopavāsā khaṇḍapūpānnaivedyaṃ parikalpayet .. .. 43 ..
4.29.d:
मासि चाश्वयुजे भक्त्या देवीं नारायणीं यजेत् ॥
सोपवासा खण्डपूपान्नैवेद्यं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ ॥ 43 ॥
4.29.m: And in the month of Āśvayuja, she should worship the goddess Nārāyaṇī with devotion. / Fasting, she should prepare sweet pastries for the food offering.

4.29.s:
prāśayeccaṃdanaṃ raktaṃ svapyācca gatamatsarā ..
prabhāte bhojyaṃ dāṃpatyamagnihotraphalaṃ labhet .. 44 ..
4.29.d:
प्राशयेच्चंदनं रक्तं स्वप्याच्च गतमत्सरा ॥
प्रभाते भोज्यं दांपत्यमग्निहोत्रफलं लभेत् ॥ 44 ॥
4.29.m: She should partake of red sandalwood and sleep, free from malice. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of an Agnihotra sacrifice.

4.29.s:
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ svasti nāma prapūja yet ..
śālyodanaṃ guḍopetaṃ naivedyaṃ nirvapettataḥ .. 45 ..
4.29.d:
तथा कृष्णतृतीयायां स्वस्ति नाम प्रपूज येत् ॥
शाल्योदनं गुडोपेतं नैवेद्यं निर्वपेत्ततः ॥ 45 ॥
4.29.m: Likewise, on the dark third [tithi], she should worship [the Goddess] named Svasti. / Then she should present an offering of śāli rice mixed with jaggery.

4.29.s:
kusuṃbhabījānsaṃprāśya tyaktvā kāmaṃ svapenniśi ..
saṃbhojya mithunaṃ prātargavāhnikaphalaṃ labhet .. 46 ..
4.29.d:
कुसुंभबीजान्संप्राश्य त्यक्त्वा कामं स्वपेन्निशि ॥
संभोज्य मिथुनं प्रातर्गवाह्निकफलं लभेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.29.m: Having partaken of safflower seeds, she should sleep at night, renouncing passion. / Having fed a married couple in the morning, she obtains the reward of feeding cows daily.

4.29.s:
kārtikasya tṛtīyāyāṃ svāhānāmnīṃ prapūjayet ..
kṣīraṃ khaṇḍaghṛtopetaṃ naivedyaṃ dāpayecca tām .. 47 ..
4.29.d:
कार्तिकस्य तृतीयायां स्वाहानाम्नीं प्रपूजयेत् ॥
क्षीरं खण्डघृतोपेतं नैवेद्यं दापयेच्च ताम् ॥ 47 ॥
4.29.m: On the third [tithi] of Kārttika, she should worship [the Goddess] named Svāhā, / and she should present to her a food offering of milk with candied sugar and clarified butter.

4.29.s:
svapyādrātrau jitakrodhā prāśya kuṃkumakeśarān ..
prabhāte mithunaṃ bhojyamekabhaktaphalaṃ labhet ..48 ..
4.29.d:
स्वप्याद्रात्रौ जितक्रोधा प्राश्य कुंकुमकेशरान् ॥
प्रभाते मिथुनं भोज्यमेकभक्तफलं लभेत् ॥48 ॥
4.29.m: She should sleep at night with anger subdued, having partaken of saffron filaments. / In the morning, a married couple should be fed; she obtains the reward of the single-meal observance.

4.29.s:
tathā kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ svadhānāmnīṃ prapūjayet ..
mudgaudanaṃ nivedyātha ghṛtaṃ prāśya svapenniśi ..49..
4.29.d:
तथा कृष्णतृतीयायां स्वधानाम्नीं प्रपूजयेत् ॥
मुद्गौदनं निवेद्याथ घृतं प्राश्य स्वपेन्निशि ॥49॥
4.29.m: Likewise, on the dark third [tithi], she should worship [the Goddess] named Svadhā. / Having offered rice with kidney beans and partaken of clarified butter, she should sleep at night.

4.29.s:
prātaḥ saṃbhojya mithunaṃ naktavrataphalaṃ labhet ..
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ kṛtvā muktapāpā śucirbhavet ..4.29.50..
4.29.d:
प्रातः संभोज्य मिथुनं नक्तव्रतफलं लभेत् ॥
एवं संवत्सरं कृत्वा मुक्तपापा शुचिर्भवेत् ॥4.29.50॥
4.29.m: Having fed a married couple in the morning, she obtains the reward of the nocturnal meal observance. / Having performed [this rite] for a full year, she becomes free from sin and pure.

4.29.s:
śuklapakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ sopavāsā nirāmayā ..
vijñāya ca drutaṃ bhaktyā umāṃ śāstrārthabodhakaiḥ .. 51 ..
4.29.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तृतीयायां सोपवासा निरामया ॥
विज्ञाय च द्रुतं भक्त्या उमां शास्त्रार्थबोधकैः ॥ 51 ॥
4.29.m: On the third [tithi] of the bright fortnight, fasting, free from affliction, / and having quickly comprehended Umā through devotion, with those who explain the meaning of the scriptures,

4.29.s:
maṃḍalaṃ ca tato likhya navanābhaṃ varapradam ..
sauvarṇaṃ kārayeddevamumayā sahitaṃ prabhum .. 52 ..
4.29.d:
मंडलं च ततो लिख्य नवनाभं वरप्रदम् ॥
सौवर्णं कारयेद्देवमुमया सहितं प्रभुम् ॥ 52 ॥
4.29.m: she should then draw a nine-naved maṇḍala that grants boons. / She should have a golden [image of the] Lord made, together with Umā.

4.29.s:
tābhyāṃ netreṣu dātavyaṃ mauktikaṃ nīlameva ca ..
pravālamoṣṭhayordadyātkarṇayo ratnakuṇḍale .. 53 ..
4.29.d:
ताभ्यां नेत्रेषु दातव्यं मौक्तिकं नीलमेव च ॥
प्रवालमोष्ठयोर्दद्यात्कर्णयो रत्नकुण्डले ॥ 53 ॥
4.29.m: A pearl and a sapphire should be placed in their eyes; / one should place coral on their lips, and jewelled earrings on their ears.

4.29.s:
upavītaṃ tu devasya devyā hāraṃ tatho rasi ..
raktavastradharāṃ devīṃ sitavastraṃ maheśvaram .. 54 ..
4.29.d:
उपवीतं तु देवस्य देव्या हारं तथो रसि ॥
रक्तवस्त्रधरां देवीं सितवस्त्रं महेश्वरम् ॥ 54 ॥
4.29.m: A sacred thread should be on the Lord's chest, and a necklace on the Goddess's; / the Goddess should wear red garments, and Maheśvara white garments.

4.29.s:
catuḥsamena vālabhya puṣpairdhūpairathārccayet ..
maṃḍale pūjayitvā ca homaṃ kuryāttato'guroḥ ..55..
4.29.d:
चतुःसमेन वालभ्य पुष्पैर्धूपैरथार्च्चयेत् ॥
मंडले पूजयित्वा च होमं कुर्यात्ततोऽगुरोः ॥55॥
4.29.m: Having anointed [them] with the fourfold perfume, she should then worship [them] with flowers and incense. / And having worshipped [them] on the maṇḍala, she should then perform a fire offering of agallochum.

4.29.s:
tato'parājitāṃ nāma devīṃ tatraiva pujayet ..
mṛtsnāṃ saṃprāśayitvā ca rātrau kuryātprajāgaram .. 56 ..
4.29.d:
ततोऽपराजितां नाम देवीं तत्रैव पुजयेत् ॥
मृत्स्नां संप्राशयित्वा च रात्रौ कुर्यात्प्रजागरम् ॥ 56 ॥
4.29.m: Then she should worship right there the goddess named Aparājitā; / and having partaken of earth, she should keep vigil through the night.

4.29.s:
gītavādyotsavairhṛdyairvīṇāmaṃgalapāṭhakaiḥ ..
rātrimeva japedbhaktyā yāvadudgacchate raviḥ .. 57 ..
4.29.d:
गीतवाद्योत्सवैर्हृद्यैर्वीणामंगलपाठकैः ॥
रात्रिमेव जपेद्भक्त्या यावदुद्गच्छते रविः ॥ 57 ॥
4.29.m: With delightful festivals of song and instrumental music, with vīṇās and auspicious reciters, / one should recite [mantras] with devotion throughout the night until the sun rises.

4.29.s:
tūlīgaṃḍakasaṃyukte paryaṃketyaṃtaśobhite ..
uddhṛtya maṇḍalāddevaṃ paryaṃkopari vinyaset .. 58 ..
4.29.d:
तूलीगंडकसंयुक्ते पर्यंकेत्यंतशोभिते ॥
उद्धृत्य मण्डलाद्देवं पर्यंकोपरि विन्यसेत् ॥ 58 ॥
4.29.m: Upon a bedstead exceedingly adorned, furnished with a cotton mattress and pillows, / having lifted the god from the maṇḍala, one should place him upon the bedstead,

4.29.s:
vitānadhvajamālālikiṃkiṇīdarppaṇānvitam ..
puṣpamaṇḍapikācchannaṃ dhūpagugguluvāsitam .. 59 ..
4.29.d:
वितानध्वजमालालिकिंकिणीदर्प्पणान्वितम् ॥
पुष्पमण्डपिकाच्छन्नं धूपगुग्गुलुवासितम् ॥ 59 ॥
4.29.m: provided with canopies, rows of banners, garlands, tiny bells, and mirrors, / covered by a floral pavilion, and perfumed with incense and guggulu.

4.29.s:
tasyāgre bhojayedbhaktyā svaśaktyā mithunāni ca ..
prīṇayedbhakṣyabhojyaiśca pakvānnairmadhuraiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 4.29.60 ..
4.29.d:
तस्याग्रे भोजयेद्भक्त्या स्वशक्त्या मिथुनानि च ॥
प्रीणयेद्भक्ष्यभोज्यैश्च पक्वान्नैर्मधुरैः शुभैः ॥ 4.29.60 ॥
4.29.m: Before him one should with devotion feed couples according to one's capacity, / and satisfy them with hard foods, soft foods, and sweet, auspicious cooked delicacies.

4.29.s:
tato dattvā'kṣatānhaste tāṃbūlaṃ vinivedayet ..
prīyatāṃ me umākāṃtaḥ pārvatyā sahitaḥ śivaḥ .. 61 ..
4.29.d:
ततो दत्त्वाऽक्षतान्हस्ते तांबूलं विनिवेदयेत् ॥
प्रीयतां मे उमाकांतः पार्वत्या सहितः शिवः ॥ 61 ॥
4.29.m: Then, having placed unbroken grains of rice in their hands, one should offer betel, [praying:] / 'May Umā's beloved, Śiva together with Pārvatī, be pleased with me.'

4.29.s:
ucchiṣṭaṃ śodhayitvā tu punaḥ prokṣya samantataḥ ..
raktavarṇāṃ suśīlāṃ ca surūpāṃ supayasvinīm .. 62 ..
4.29.d:
उच्छिष्टं शोधयित्वा तु पुनः प्रोक्ष्य समन्ततः ॥
रक्तवर्णां सुशीलां च सुरूपां सुपयस्विनीम् ॥ 62 ॥
4.29.m: Having cleaned away the leftovers and sprinkled water all around, / [one should present] a red-coloured, well-mannered, handsome cow yielding plentiful milk,

4.29.s:
śṛṃgābhyāṃ dattakanakāṃ rājatakhurasaṃyutām ..
kāṃsyadohanakopetāṃ raktavastrāvaguṃṭhitām .. 63 ..
4.29.d:
शृंगाभ्यां दत्तकनकां राजतखुरसंयुताम् ॥
कांस्यदोहनकोपेतां रक्तवस्त्रावगुंठिताम् ॥ 63 ॥
4.29.m: whose two horns are gilded with gold, equipped with silver hooves, / provided with a bronze milking pail, and draped with red cloth,

4.29.s:
ghaṇṭābharaṇaśobhāḍhyāṃ devadevyagrasaṃsthitām ..
pādukopānahacchatrabhojyabhājanasaṃyutām ..
tridhā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya guroḥ sarvaṃ nivedayet .. 64 ..
4.29.d:
घण्टाभरणशोभाढ्यां देवदेव्यग्रसंस्थिताम् ॥
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रभोज्यभाजनसंयुताम् ॥
त्रिधा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य गुरोः सर्वं निवेदयेत् ॥ 64 ॥
4.29.m: rich in the splendour of bell ornaments, positioned before the God of gods, / accompanied by sandals, shoes, a royal parasol, food, and dishes; / having circumambulated her three times, one should present everything to the guru,

4.29.s:
umāmaheśvaraṃ devamaviyogaṃ surārcitam ..
avyavacchedabhūtaṃ ca suprītaṃ tadihāstu me .. 65 ..
4.29.d:
उमामहेश्वरं देवमवियोगं सुरार्चितम् ॥
अव्यवच्छेदभूतं च सुप्रीतं तदिहास्तु मे ॥ 65 ॥
4.29.m: [reciting:] 'May the god Umāmaheśvara, without separation, worshipped by the gods, / and unbroken in being, be well-pleased with me here.'

4.29.s:
praṇamya śirasā bhūmau kṣamasveti guruṃ vadet ..
evaṃ samāpyate devyāṃ ānaṃtaryavratodyamam ..
yaḥ prakuryātpumānstrī vā tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu .. 66 ..
4.29.d:
प्रणम्य शिरसा भूमौ क्षमस्वेति गुरुं वदेत् ॥
एवं समाप्यते देव्यां आनंतर्यव्रतोद्यमम् ॥
यः प्रकुर्यात्पुमान्स्त्री वा तस्य पुण्यफलं शृणु ॥ 66 ॥
4.29.m: Bowing to the ground with one's head, one should say to the guru: 'Pardon me.' / In this manner the undertaking of the Ānantarya-vrata for the Goddess is completed. / Hear the meritorious fruit of one who performs it, whether man or woman:

4.29.s:
gandharvayakṣalokāṃśca vidyādharamahoragān ..
ṛṣisiddhāmaraṃ brāhmaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam ..67..
4.29.d:
गन्धर्वयक्षलोकांश्च विद्याधरमहोरगान् ॥
ऋषिसिद्धामरं ब्राह्मं विष्णुलोकं सनातनम् ॥67॥
4.29.m: The worlds of the gandharvas and yakṣas, the vidyādharas and great serpents, / the realms of the ṛṣis, the siddhas, the immortals, of Brahmā, and the eternal world of Viṣṇu—

4.29.s:
bhuktvā bhogānaśeṣāṃśca ekaviṃśatkulānvitaḥ ..
ratnayāne samārūḍho guhyāpsarasasaṃvṛtaḥ .. 68 ...
4.29.d:
भुक्त्वा भोगानशेषांश्च एकविंशत्कुलान्वितः ॥
रत्नयाने समारूढो गुह्याप्सरससंवृतः ॥ 68 ॥।
4.29.m: having enjoyed all these pleasures along with twenty-one generations of his family, / mounted upon a chariot of jewels, surrounded by guhyakas and apsarases,

4.29.s:
devavidyādharairyakṣairvṛto yāti śivālayam..
tatra bhuktvā mahābhogānsa bhuṃkte śivavadbahūn .. 69 ..
4.29.d:
देवविद्याधरैर्यक्षैर्वृतो याति शिवालयम्॥
तत्र भुक्त्वा महाभोगान्स भुंक्ते शिववद्बहून् ॥ 69 ॥
4.29.m: accompanied by gods, vidyādharas, and yakṣas, he goes to the abode of Śiva. / Having enjoyed great pleasures there, he enjoys many things like Śiva himself.

4.29.s:
bhuktvā bhogānyadā bhūtaḥ kadācittapasaḥ kṣayāta ..
pṛthivyāṃ tu samāgamya bhavetsakalabhūmipaḥ .. 4.29.70 ..
4.29.d:
भुक्त्वा भोगान्यदा भूतः कदाचित्तपसः क्षयात ॥
पृथिव्यां तु समागम्य भवेत्सकलभूमिपः ॥ 4.29.70 ॥
4.29.m: When at some time, having enjoyed those pleasures, he falls due to the exhaustion of his austerity, / he comes to the earth and becomes ruler over the entire world.

4.29.s:
strī vā samācaredyā tu mahādevī tu jāyate ..
ānaṃtaryavyavacchinnānbhogāndevī umā yathā ..
trailokyapatirudreṇasā bhuṃkte sahitā tathā..71..
4.29.d:
स्त्री वा समाचरेद्या तु महादेवी तु जायते ॥
आनंतर्यव्यवच्छिन्नान्भोगान्देवी उमा यथा ॥
त्रैलोक्यपतिरुद्रेणसा भुंक्ते सहिता तथा॥71॥
4.29.m: Or if a woman performs it, she becomes a great queen. / Just as the goddess Umā enjoys pleasures uninterrupted by any interval / together with Rudra, the lord of the three worlds,

4.29.s:
manurddevyā yathāmahyā śacyā śakro yathāsukham ..
nairaṃtaryaṃ yathā saukhyaṃ sā bhuṃkte patinā saha .. 72 ..
4.29.d:
मनुर्द्देव्या यथामह्या शच्या शक्रो यथासुखम् ॥
नैरंतर्यं यथा सौख्यं सा भुंक्ते पतिना सह ॥ 72 ॥
4.29.m: just as Manu with his queen, the Earth, or Śakra with Śacī at ease, / she enjoys uninterrupted happiness together with her husband.

4.29.s:
muneraruṃdhatī yadvadviṣṇorlakṣmīrhṛdi sthitā ..
tathā tayormahatsaukhyaṃ nairaṃtaryaṃ hi jāyate .. 13 ..
4.29.d:
मुनेररुंधती यद्वद्विष्णोर्लक्ष्मीर्हृदि स्थिता ॥
तथा तयोर्महत्सौख्यं नैरंतर्यं हि जायते ॥ 13 ॥
4.29.m: Just as Arundhatī is to the sage [Vasiṣṭha], or Lakṣmī residing in the heart of Viṣṇu, / even so great, uninterrupted happiness arises for the two of them.

4.29.s:
sāvitrī brahmaṇo yadvadgaṃgā toyanidheryathā ..
avyavacchinnayoḥ prītistathā janmanijanmani .. 74 ..
4.29.d:
सावित्री ब्रह्मणो यद्वद्गंगा तोयनिधेर्यथा ॥
अव्यवच्छिन्नयोः प्रीतिस्तथा जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ 74 ॥
4.29.m: Just as Sāvitrī is to Brahmā, or the Gaṅgā to the ocean, / even so is the unbroken love between them in birth after birth.

4.29.s:
atha janmanyahonyasminvratametatkṛtaṃ bhavet ..
tenaiva patinā sārddhaṃ na viyogamupaiti sā ..
yojanāyutasāhasre surūpā maṇḍale bhavet ..
arghāḍhyā subhagā sādhvī putrapautrairalaṃkṛtā .. 75 ..
4.29.d:
अथ जन्मन्यहोन्यस्मिन्व्रतमेतत्कृतं भवेत् ॥
तेनैव पतिना सार्द्धं न वियोगमुपैति सा ॥
योजनायुतसाहस्रे सुरूपा मण्डले भवेत् ॥
अर्घाढ्या सुभगा साध्वी पुत्रपौत्रैरलंकृता ॥ 75 ॥
4.29.m: If indeed this votive observance is performed on this day in another birth, / she does not suffer separation from that very same husband; / she becomes beautiful in an empire of tens of thousands of yojanas, / richly worshipped, fortunate, virtuous, and adorned with sons and grandsons.

4.29.s:
ettate nikhilaṃ proktamānaṃtaryavrataṃ mayā ..
bhaktāya suvinītāya kathitavyaṃ na cānyathā .. 76 ..
4.29.d:
एत्तते निखिलं प्रोक्तमानंतर्यव्रतं मया ॥
भक्ताय सुविनीताय कथितव्यं न चान्यथा ॥ 76 ॥
4.29.m: This entire Ānantarya-vrata has been related by me to you. / It should be told only to a devoted, well-disciplined person, and not otherwise.

4.29.s:
eṣā viśeṣavihitābhihitā tṛtīyā yānaṃtarītya vidhavābhirudīritoccaiḥ ..
etāmupoṣya vidhivatpratipakṣayogānnaivāṃtaraṃ sutasuhṛtsvajanairupaiti .. 77 ..
akṣayatṛtīyāvratavarṇanam
4.29.d:
एषा विशेषविहिताभिहिता तृतीया यानंतरीत्य विधवाभिरुदीरितोच्चैः ॥
एतामुपोष्य विधिवत्प्रतिपक्षयोगान्नैवांतरं सुतसुहृत्स्वजनैरुपैति ॥ 77 ॥
अक्षयतृतीयाव्रतवर्णनम्
4.29.m:
This tṛtīyā has been specifically enjoined and proclaimed, praised aloud by non-widows as the Ānantarī. / Having fasted on this day according to rule, because of the conjunction with the Pratipakṣa, one suffers no separation from sons, friends, or kinsmen.
Description of the Akṣayatṛtīyā-vrata

4.30.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bahunātra kimuktena kiṃ bahvakṣaramālayā ..
vaiśākhasya sitāmekāṃ tṛtīyāṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava .. 1 ..
4.30.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन किं बह्वक्षरमालया ॥
वैशाखस्य सितामेकां तृतीयां शृणु पाण्डव ॥ 1 ॥
4.30.m: The blessed Kṛṣṇa said: / What need is there of saying much here? What need for a garland of many syllables? / Hear, O Pāṇḍava, of the single bright tṛtīyā of Vaiśākha.

4.30.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam ..
yadasyāṃ kriyate kiñcitsarvaṃ syāttadihākṣa yam .. 2 ..
4.30.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः स्वाध्यायः पितृतर्पणम् ॥
यदस्यां क्रियते किञ्चित्सर्वं स्यात्तदिहाक्ष यम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.30.m: Bathing, giving, recitation of mantras, fire sacrifice, Vedic study, and libations to ancestors— / whatever little is done on this day, all of that becomes imperishable here.

4.30.s:
ādau kṛtayugasyeyaṃ yugādistena kathyate ..
sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvasaukhyapradāyinī .. 3 ..
4.30.d:
आदौ कृतयुगस्येयं युगादिस्तेन कथ्यते ॥
सर्वपापप्रशमनी सर्वसौख्यप्रदायिनी ॥ 3 ॥
4.30.m: This was at the beginning of the Kṛta age; therefore it is called Yugādi. / It pacifies all sins and bestows all happiness.

4.30.s:
śākale nagare kaściddharmanāmābhavadvaṇik ..
priyaṃvadaḥ satyarato devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ .. 4 ..
4.30.d:
शाकले नगरे कश्चिद्धर्मनामाभवद्वणिक् ॥
प्रियंवदः सत्यरतो देवब्राह्मणपूजकः ॥ 4 ॥
4.30.m: In the city of Śākala, there was a merchant named Dharma, / pleasant of speech, devoted to truth, and a worshipper of gods and brāhmaṇas.

4.30.s:
tena śrutaṃ vācyamānaṃ tṛtīyā rohiṇī purā ..
yadā syādbudhasaṃyuktā tadā sāca mahāphalā .. 5 ..
4.30.d:
तेन श्रुतं वाच्यमानं तृतीया रोहिणी पुरा ॥
यदा स्याद्बुधसंयुक्ता तदा साच महाफला ॥ 5 ॥
4.30.m: He formerly heard the proclamation: 'When the tṛtīyā is joined with Rohiṇī / and associated with Wednesday, then it yields great fruit;

4.30.s:
tasyāṃ yaddīyate kiṃñcittatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet ..
iti śrutvā sa gaṃgāyāṃ santarpya pitṛdevatāḥ .. 6 ..
4.30.d:
तस्यां यद्दीयते किंञ्चित्तत्सर्वं चाक्षयं भवेत् ॥
इति श्रुत्वा स गंगायां सन्तर्प्य पितृदेवताः ॥ 6 ॥
4.30.m: whatever little is given on that day, all of that becomes imperishable.' / Having heard this, he satisfied the ancestors and deities in the Gaṅgā,
and coming home, [he offered] small water-pots provided with grain and water / and large jars filled with water in his house, completely in due order.
Barley, wheat, chickpeas, roasted grain flour, curds, cooked rice, / products of sugarcane and milk, together with gold, according to his capacity,

4.30.s:
śuciḥ śuddhena manasā brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vaṇik ..
bhāryayā vāryamāṇopi kuṭuṃbāsaktaciṃtayā .. 9 ..
4.30.d:
शुचिः शुद्धेन मनसा ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ वणिक् ॥
भार्यया वार्यमाणोपि कुटुंबासक्तचिंतया ॥ 9 ॥
4.30.m: pure, with a clean mind, the merchant gave to brāhmaṇas, / even though restrained by his wife, who was anxious out of attachment to the family.

4.30.s:
tāvatsa ca sthitaḥ sattve matvā sarvaṃ vinaśvaram ..
dharmārthakāma śaktastu kālena bahunā tataḥ .. 4.30.10 ..
4.30.d:
तावत्स च स्थितः सत्त्वे मत्वा सर्वं विनश्वरम् ॥
धर्मार्थकाम शक्तस्तु कालेन बहुना ततः ॥ 4.30.10 ॥
4.30.m: Yet he remained fixed in goodness, considering everything perishable. / Capable in dharma, wealth, and pleasure, after a long time,

4.30.s:
jagāma pañcatvamasau vāsudevaṃ smaranmuhuḥ ..
tataḥ sa kṣatriyo jātaḥ kuśāvatyāṃ nareśvaraḥ .. 11 ..
4.30.d:
जगाम पञ्चत्वमसौ वासुदेवं स्मरन्मुहुः ॥
ततः स क्षत्रियो जातः कुशावत्यां नरेश्वरः ॥ 11 ॥
4.30.m: he passed away, repeatedly remembering Vāsudeva. / Then he was born as a kṣatriya, a king in Kuśāvatī,

4.30.s:
babhūva cā kṣayā tasya samṛddhirdharmanirjitā ..
iyāja sa mahāyajñaiḥ samāptavaradakṣiṇaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.30.d:
बभूव चा क्षया तस्य समृद्धिर्धर्मनिर्जिता ॥
इयाज स महायज्ञैः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.30.m: and his prosperity, acquired through dharma, became imperishable. / He performed great sacrifices concluded with excellent gifts [to priests],

4.30.s:
dadau gobhūhiraṇyādi dānānyasyāmaharniśam ..
bubhuje kāmato bhogāndīnārtāṃstarpayañjanān .. 13 ..
4.30.d:
ददौ गोभूहिरण्यादि दानान्यस्यामहर्निशम् ॥
बुभुजे कामतो भोगान्दीनार्तांस्तर्पयञ्जनान् ॥ 13 ॥
4.30.m: and gave gifts of cattle, land, gold, and so forth day and night on this [tithi]. / He enjoyed pleasures at will, satisfying people who were poor and afflicted.

4.30.s:
tathāpyakṣayamevāsya kṣayaṃ yāti na taddhanam ..
śraddhāpūrvaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ yaddattaṃ vibhavaṃ vinā .. 14 ..
4.30.d:
तथाप्यक्षयमेवास्य क्षयं याति न तद्धनम् ॥
श्रद्धापूर्वं तृतीयायां यद्दत्तं विभवं विना ॥ 14 ॥
4.30.m: Even so, his wealth remained ever imperishable and never suffered diminish, / because of what had been given with faith on the tṛtīyā without display of wealth.

4.30.s:
etadvrataṃ mayākhyātaṃ śrūyatāmatra yo vidhiḥ ..
udakuṃbhānsakarakātsnānasarvarasairyutān .. 15 ..
4.30.d:
एतद्व्रतं मयाख्यातं श्रूयतामत्र यो विधिः ॥
उदकुंभान्सकरकात्स्नानसर्वरसैर्युतान् ॥ 15 ॥
4.30.m: This votive observance has been proclaimed by me; let the procedure for it be heard: / Water-jars with small water-pots, furnished with water for bathing and all flavours;

4.30.s:
graiṣmikaṃ sarvamevātra sasyadānaṃ praśasyate ..
chatropānatpradānaṃ ca gobhūkāṃcanavāsasām .. 16 ..
4.30.d:
ग्रैष्मिकं सर्वमेवात्र सस्यदानं प्रशस्यते ॥
छत्रोपानत्प्रदानं च गोभूकांचनवाससाम् ॥ 16 ॥
4.30.m: the gift of all grains of the summer season is praised here, / as well as the giving of a royal parasol, shoes, cattle, land, gold, and garments.
And whatever else is most beloved, that should be given without hesitation. / All this has been declared to you; what else do you wish to hear?

4.30.s: anākhyeyaṃ na me kiñcidasti svastyastu te'nagha .. 18 ..
4.30.d: अनाख्येयं न मे किञ्चिदस्ति स्वस्त्यस्तु तेऽनघ ॥ 18 ॥
4.30.m: There is nothing that I may not tell you; may you be blessed, O sinless one.

4.30.s:
asyāṃ tithau kṣayamupaiti hutaṃ na dattaṃ tenākṣayā ca munibhiḥ kathitā tṛtīyā ..
uddiśya yatsurapitṝnkriyate manuṣyaistaccākṣayaṃ bhavati bhārata sarvameva .. 19 ..
aṅgārakacaturthīvratavarṇanam
4.30.d:
अस्यां तिथौ क्षयमुपैति हुतं न दत्तं तेनाक्षया च मुनिभिः कथिता तृतीया ॥
उद्दिश्य यत्सुरपितॄन्क्रियते मनुष्यैस्तच्चाक्षयं भवति भारत सर्वमेव ॥ 19 ॥
अङ्गारकचतुर्थीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.30.m:
On this lunar day, what is offered in the fire and what is given does not perish; therefore the tṛtīyā is declared by the sages to be 'Akṣayā'. / Whatever is done by men dedicating it to gods and ancestors, O descendant of Bharata, all of that becomes imperishable.
Description of the Aṅgārakacaturthī observance.

4.31.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
rūpasaubhāgyasukhadaṃ naranārījanapriyam ..
pāpāpahaṃ bahuphalaṃ sukaraṃ sūpavāsakam ..1..
4.31.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
रूपसौभाग्यसुखदं नरनारीजनप्रियम् ॥
पापापहं बहुफलं सुकरं सूपवासकम् ॥1॥
4.31.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
[Tell me of a rite] that grants beauty, good fortune, and happiness, dear to both men and women, / which destroys sins, yields abundant fruit, is easy to perform, and has an easy fast,

4.31.s:
ṛddhibuddhikaraṃ svargyaṃ yaśasyaṃ sarvakāmadam ..
tanme vada vrataṃ kiñcidyadi tuṣṭo'si mādhava ..2..
4.31.d:
ऋद्धिबुद्धिकरं स्वर्ग्यं यशस्यं सर्वकामदम् ॥
तन्मे वद व्रतं किञ्चिद्यदि तुष्टोऽसि माधव ॥2॥
4.31.m: which brings prosperity and intellect, leads to heaven, brings renown, and grants all desires. / Tell me of some such votive observance, O Mādhava, if you are pleased with me.

4.31.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
śṛṇu pārtha paraṃ guhyaṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ na ca ..
purā tava vanasthasya tadadya pravadāmyaham ..3..
4.31.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
शृणु पार्थ परं गुह्यं यन्मया कथितं न च ॥
पुरा तव वनस्थस्य तदद्य प्रवदाम्यहम् ॥3॥
4.31.m:
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Listen, O son of Pṛthā, to the supreme secret which I did not tell / to you formerly when you were residing in the forest; that I shall tell today.

4.31.s:
śivayoratisaṃharṣādraktabiṃduścyutaḥ kṣitau ..
medinyā sa prayatnena vidhṛto dhṛtiyuktayā .. 4 ..
4.31.d:
शिवयोरतिसंहर्षाद्रक्तबिंदुश्च्युतः क्षितौ ॥
मेदिन्या स प्रयत्नेन विधृतो धृतियुक्तया ॥ 4 ॥
4.31.m: From the intense joy of Śiva and his consort, a drop of blood fell upon the earth. / It was diligently received by the earth endowed with patience.

4.31.s:
tasmājjātaḥ kumāro'sau rakto raktasamudbhavaḥ ..
aṃgaṃ prasiddhamevehāṃgārako vega ucyate .. 5 ..
4.31.d:
तस्माज्जातः कुमारोऽसौ रक्तो रक्तसमुद्भवः ॥
अंगं प्रसिद्धमेवेहांगारको वेग उच्यते ॥ 5 ॥
4.31.m: From it was born that boy, red, originating from blood. / The limb is indeed well-known here, and Aṅgāraka is called swiftness.

4.31.s:
śivāṃgādrabhasā jāta stenāṃgāraka ucyate ..
agasthoṃ'gārakāṃtiśca aṃgapratyaṅgasaṃbhavaḥ .. 6 ..
4.31.d:
शिवांगाद्रभसा जात स्तेनांगारक उच्यते ॥
अगस्थोंऽगारकांतिश्च अंगप्रत्यङ्गसंभवः ॥ 6 ॥
4.31.m: Born with impetuosity from the limb of Śiva, he is therefore called Aṅgāraka. / Standing on the mountain, having the lustre of burning charcoal, born from every limb and minor part,

4.31.s:
saubhāgyārogyakṛdyasmāttasmādaṃgārakaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
bhaktyā caturthyāṃ naktena yastu śraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 7 ..
4.31.d:
सौभाग्यारोग्यकृद्यस्मात्तस्मादंगारकः स्मृतः ॥
भक्त्या चतुर्थ्यां नक्तेन यस्तु श्रद्धासमन्वितः ॥ 7 ॥
4.31.m: and because he grants good fortune and health, he is remembered as Aṅgāraka. / Whoever, endowed with faith, with devotion on the caturthī, with a nocturnal meal,

4.31.s:
taṃ pūjayati yatnena nārī vā'nanyamānasā ..
tasya tuṣṭaḥ prayacchetsa yattvayā samudāhṛtam ..
rūpaṃ saubhāgyasaṃpannaṃ naranārīmanoharam .. 8 ..
4.31.d:
तं पूजयति यत्नेन नारी वाऽनन्यमानसा ॥
तस्य तुष्टः प्रयच्छेत्स यत्त्वया समुदाहृतम् ॥
रूपं सौभाग्यसंपन्नं नरनारीमनोहरम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.31.m: or a woman with undivided mind worships him with diligence, / pleased with them, he will grant what was spoken of by you: / beauty endowed with good fortune, delightful to men and women.

4.31.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
etanme vada deveśa aṃgārakavidhiṃ śubham ..
sahomamaṃtrasaṃsthānaṃ sādhivāsavidhānataḥ .. 9 ..
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
pūrvaṃ tu kṛtasaṃkalpaḥ snānaṃ kṛtvā bahirjale ..
snānārthaṃ mṛttikāṃ maṃtrairgṛhṇīyādaṃbhasi sthitaḥ ..4.31.1 0..
tvaṃ mṛde vaṃditā pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇenoddharatā kila..
tena me daha pāpaughaṃ yanmayā pūrvasaṃcitam .. 1 1..
4.31.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
एतन्मे वद देवेश अंगारकविधिं शुभम् ॥
सहोममंत्रसंस्थानं साधिवासविधानतः ॥ 9 ॥
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
पूर्वं तु कृतसंकल्पः स्नानं कृत्वा बहिर्जले ॥
स्नानार्थं मृत्तिकां मंत्रैर्गृह्णीयादंभसि स्थितः ॥4.31.1 0॥
त्वं मृदे वंदिता पूर्वं कृष्णेनोद्धरता किल॥
तेन मे दह पापौघं यन्मया पूर्वसंचितम् ॥ 1 1॥
4.31.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
Tell me this auspicious procedure for Aṅgāraka, O Lord of gods, / along with the arrangement of mantras for the fire offering, according to the rule of preliminary consecration.
Śrī Kṛṣṇa said:
Having first made the solemn resolve and bathed outside in water, / standing in the water he should take up clay for bathing with the mantras:
"You, O clay, were formerly praised by Kṛṣṇa while lifting [you] up; / by that, burn away the mass of my sins that was accumulated formerly by me."

4.31.s:
imaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhanpārtha ādityāya pradarśayet ..
ādityaraśmisaṃtaptāṃ gaṃgājalakaṇokṣitām ..12..
4.31.d:
इमं मंत्रं पठन्पार्थ आदित्याय प्रदर्शयेत् ॥
आदित्यरश्मिसंतप्तां गंगाजलकणोक्षिताम् ॥12॥
4.31.m: Reciting this mantra, O son of Pṛthā, he should show it to the sun, / heated by the rays of the sun and sprinkled with drops of Gaṅgā water.

4.31.s:
tāṃ mṛdaṃ śirasi prārthya pūrvaṃ dattvāṃgasaṃdhiṣu ..
tataḥ snānaṃ prakurvīta maṃtreṇāntarjale punaḥ .. 13 ..
4.31.d:
तां मृदं शिरसि प्रार्थ्य पूर्वं दत्त्वांगसंधिषु ॥
ततः स्नानं प्रकुर्वीत मंत्रेणान्तर्जले पुनः ॥ 13 ॥
4.31.m: Having prayed to that clay at the head, having first applied it to the joints of the body, / he should then bathe again with the mantra while submerged in the water:

4.31.s:
tvamāpo yoniḥ sarveṣāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām ..
svedajodbhijjayonīnāṃ rasānāṃ pataye namaḥ ..14..
4.31.d:
त्वमापो योनिः सर्वेषां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् ॥
स्वेदजोद्भिज्जयोनीनां रसानां पतये नमः ॥14॥
4.31.m: "You waters are the source of all Daityas, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas, / the source of sweat-born and sprout-born beings; homage to the lord of fluids.

4.31.s:
snāto'haṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvaprasravaṇeṣu ca ..
nadīṣu devakhāteṣu snānaṃ teṣu ca me bhavet..15..
4.31.d:
स्नातोऽहं सर्वतीर्थेषु सर्वप्रस्रवणेषु च ॥
नदीषु देवखातेषु स्नानं तेषु च मे भवेत्॥15॥
4.31.m: I am bathed in all holy places and in all waterfalls; / in the rivers and divine pools, in them may my bath take place."

4.31.s:
dhyāyandhvanimimaṃ maṃtraṃ tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret ..
tataḥ snātvā śucirbhūtvā gṛhamāgatya na spṛśet ..
na jalpecca na vīkṣeta kvacitpāpiṣṭhameva hi .. 16 ..
4.31.d:
ध्यायन्ध्वनिमिमं मंत्रं ततः स्नानं समाचरेत् ॥
ततः स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा गृहमागत्य न स्पृशेत् ॥
न जल्पेच्च न वीक्षेत क्वचित्पापिष्ठमेव हि ॥ 16 ॥
4.31.m: Meditating on this spoken mantra, he should then perform his bath. / Then, having bathed and become pure, having come home, he must not touch, / nor converse with, nor indeed look at the most sinful person anywhere.

4.31.s:
dūrvāśvatthau śamīṃ spṛṣṭvā māṃ ca maṃtreṇa maṃtravit ..
dūrvāmapyasya maṃtreṇa yutena samupasthitām ..17..
4.31.d:
दूर्वाश्वत्थौ शमीं स्पृष्ट्वा मां च मंत्रेण मंत्रवित् ॥
दूर्वामप्यस्य मंत्रेण युतेन समुपस्थिताम् ॥17॥
4.31.m: Having touched dūrvā grass, aśvattha, and śamī, the knower of mantras [should touch] me with the mantra, / and also the dūrvā grass brought near with this mantra:

4.31.s:
