tvaṃ dūrve'mṛtajanmāsi sarvadevaiśca vaṃditā ..
vaṃditā daha tatsarvaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam ..18.. ( iti dūrvāmaṃtraḥ ..)
4.31.d:
त्वं दूर्वेऽमृतजन्मासि सर्वदेवैश्च वंदिता ॥
वंदिता दह तत्सर्वं यन्मया दुष्कृतं कृतम् ॥18॥ ( इति दूर्वामंत्रः ॥)
4.31.m: "O dūrvā, you have your birth from nectar and are praised by all the gods; / being praised, burn away all that evil deed done by me." (This is the dūrvā mantra.)

4.31.s:
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ tvaṃ kāśyapī paṭhyase śrutau..
śamī śamaya tatpāpaṃ yanmayā duranuṣṭhi tam .. 19 .. ( iti śamīmaṃtraḥ)
4.31.d:
पवित्राणां पवित्रं त्वं काश्यपी पठ्यसे श्रुतौ॥
शमी शमय तत्पापं यन्मया दुरनुष्ठि तम् ॥ 19 ॥ ( इति शमीमंत्रः)
4.31.m: "You are the purifier of purifiers, born of Kaśyapa, recited in the Veda; / O śamī, pacify that sin that was wrongly committed by me." (This is the śamī mantra.)

4.31.s:
aśvatthamaṃgaṃ labhate maṃtrametaṃ nibodha me ..
akṣispaṃdaṃ bhujaspaṃdaṃ duḥsvapnaṃ durviciṃtitam ..
śatrūṇāṃ ca samutthānamaśvattha śamayasva me .. 4.31.20 .. ( ityaśvatthamaṃtraḥ)
4.31.d:
अश्वत्थमंगं लभते मंत्रमेतं निबोध मे ॥
अक्षिस्पंदं भुजस्पंदं दुःस्वप्नं दुर्विचिंतितम् ॥
शत्रूणां च समुत्थानमश्वत्थ शमयस्व मे ॥ 4.31.20 ॥ ( इत्यश्वत्थमंत्रः)
4.31.m: He touches the aśvattha tree; learn this mantra from me: / "Twitching of the eye, twitching of the arm, bad dreams, evil thoughts, / and the rising of enemies—O aśvattha, pacify them for me." (This is the aśvattha mantra.)

4.31.s:
gāṃ dadyāttu tato devīṃ savatsāṃ sapradakṣiṇām ..
samālabhya tu maṃtreṇa maṃtrametamudīrayet .. 21 ..
4.31.d:
गां दद्यात्तु ततो देवीं सवत्सां सप्रदक्षिणाम् ॥
समालभ्य तु मंत्रेण मंत्रमेतमुदीरयेत् ॥ 21 ॥
4.31.m: Then he should give a divine cow, along with her calf, performing circumambulation; / having touched her with the mantra, he should utter this mantra:

4.31.s:
sarvadevamaye devi daivataistvaṃ supūjitā ..
tasmātspṛśāmi vaṃdāmi vaṃditā pāpahā bhava ..22.. ( iti gomaṃtraḥ)
4.31.d:
सर्वदेवमये देवि दैवतैस्त्वं सुपूजिता ॥
तस्मात्स्पृशामि वंदामि वंदिता पापहा भव ॥22॥ ( इति गोमंत्रः)
4.31.m: "O goddess embodying all the gods, you are well-worshipped by the deities; / therefore I touch and praise you; being praised, become the destroyer of sins." (This is the cow mantra.)

4.31.s:
evaṃ maṃtraṃ paṭhanpārtha bhaktibhāvena bhāvitaḥ ..
pradakṣiṇāṃ yaḥ kurute gāṃ dṛṣṭvā varavarṇinīm .. 23 ..
4.31.d:
एवं मंत्रं पठन्पार्थ भक्तिभावेन भावितः ॥
प्रदक्षिणां यः कुरुते गां दृष्ट्वा वरवर्णिनीम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.31.m: Reciting the mantra in this way, O son of Pṛthā, inspired by devotion, / whoever, having seen the cow of excellent complexion, circumambulates her,

4.31.s:
pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena pṛthivī nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
evaṃ maunena cāgatya vaṃdyānvaṃdya gṛhaṃ vrajet .. 24 ..
4.31.d:
प्रदक्षिणीकृता तेन पृथिवी नात्र संशयः ॥
एवं मौनेन चागत्य वंद्यान्वंद्य गृहं व्रजेत् ॥ 24 ॥
4.31.m: by him the earth has been circumambulated, of this there is no doubt. / Having thus come in silence and having saluted those worthy of salutation, he should go home.

4.31.s:
prakṣālya ca mṛdā pādau āhitā'gnigṛhaṃ viśet ..
homaṃ tatra prakurvīta ebhirmaṃtraiḥ padairvaraiḥ .. 25 ..
4.31.d:
प्रक्षाल्य च मृदा पादौ आहिताऽग्निगृहं विशेत् ॥
होमं तत्र प्रकुर्वीत एभिर्मंत्रैः पदैर्वरैः ॥ 25 ॥
4.31.m: Having washed his feet with clay, he should enter the house of the consecrated fire; / he should perform the fire offering there with these mantras and excellent words:

4.31.s:
śarvāya śarvaputrāya pārvatyā goḥ sutāya ca ..
kujāya lohitāṃgāya graheśāṃgārakāya ca ..
bhūyobhūyoyamāhutyā hutvāhutvā juhoti vai .. 26 ..
4.31.d:
शर्वाय शर्वपुत्राय पार्वत्या गोः सुताय च ॥
कुजाय लोहितांगाय ग्रहेशांगारकाय च ॥
भूयोभूयोयमाहुत्या हुत्वाहुत्वा जुहोति वै ॥ 26 ॥
4.31.m: To Śarva, to the son of Śarva, to the son of Pārvatī and the cow (the Earth), / to Kuja, to the red-limbed one, and to Aṅgāraka the lord of planets— / having repeatedly offered oblation after oblation, he indeed offers

4.31.s:
oṃkārapūrvakairmaṃtraiḥ svāhākārāṃtayojitaiḥ ..
aṣṭottara śataṃ pārtha arddhamardhārdhameva ca ..27..
4.31.d:
ओंकारपूर्वकैर्मंत्रैः स्वाहाकारांतयोजितैः ॥
अष्टोत्तर शतं पार्थ अर्द्धमर्धार्धमेव च ॥27॥
4.31.m: with mantras preceded by the syllable Om and ending with the word svāhā, / one hundred and eight times, O son of Pṛthā, or half of that, or half of that half,

4.31.s:
ebhimaṃtrapadairbhaktyā śaktyā vā kāmameva vā ..
samidbhiḥ khādirībhiśca ghṛtadugdhaistilairyavaiḥ ..28..
4.31.d:
एभिमंत्रपदैर्भक्त्या शक्त्या वा काममेव वा ॥
समिद्भिः खादिरीभिश्च घृतदुग्धैस्तिलैर्यवैः ॥28॥
4.31.m: with these mantra-phrases, with devotion, or according to his ability, or at will, / with firewood of the khadira tree, with ghee, milk, sesamum seeds, and barley,

4.31.s:
bhakṣyairnānāvidhairanyaiḥ śaktyā vā maṃtravidvaśī ..
hutvāhutīstataḥ pārtha devaṃ saṃsthāpayetkṣitau .. 29 ..
4.31.d:
भक्ष्यैर्नानाविधैरन्यैः शक्त्या वा मंत्रविद्वशी ॥
हुत्वाहुतीस्ततः पार्थ देवं संस्थापयेत्क्षितौ ॥ 29 ॥
4.31.m: with various other kinds of foods according to his means, the self-controlled knower of mantras, / having offered the oblations, O son of Pṛthā, should then establish the deity on the earth.

4.31.s:
snapanaṃ kecidicchaṃti saguḍe tāmrabhājane ..
sauvarṇaṃ raktavarṇaṃ ca śaktyā dārumayaṃ tathā .. 4.31.30 ..
4.31.d:
स्नपनं केचिदिच्छंति सगुडे ताम्रभाजने ॥
सौवर्णं रक्तवर्णं च शक्त्या दारुमयं तथा ॥ 4.31.30 ॥
4.31.m: Some desire the bathing [of an icon] in a copper vessel with jaggery; / [an icon] made of gold, red in colour, or according to means made of wood,

4.31.s:
kṛṣṇāgarumayaṃ caiva śrīkhaṇḍaghaṭitaṃ punaḥ ..
sauvarṇapātre raupye vā arcyaṃ kuṃkumakesaraiḥ .. 31 ..
4.31.d:
कृष्णागरुमयं चैव श्रीखण्डघटितं पुनः ॥
सौवर्णपात्रे रौप्ये वा अर्च्यं कुंकुमकेसरैः ॥ 31 ॥
4.31.m: or made of black agallochum, or fashioned from sandalwood; / in a golden vessel or a silver one, he should be worshipped with saffron filaments,

4.31.s:
anyairālohitaiḥ pārtha puṣpairvastraiḥ phalaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
rājanratnaiśca vividhairarthavānbhaktito'rcayet .. 32 ..
4.31.d:
अन्यैरालोहितैः पार्थ पुष्पैर्वस्त्रैः फलैः शुभैः ॥
राजन्रत्नैश्च विविधैरर्थवान्भक्तितोऽर्चयेत् ॥ 32 ॥
4.31.m: with other reddish flowers, O son of Pṛthā, with garments, and with auspicious fruits. / O king, if wealthy, he should worship him with devotion with various jewels.

4.31.s:
yāvaddhi śakyate cittaṃ vittavānbhaktibhāvitaḥ ..
tāvaddhi vardhate puṇyaṃ dātuḥ śatasahasrikam .. 33 ..
4.31.d:
यावद्धि शक्यते चित्तं वित्तवान्भक्तिभावितः ॥
तावद्धि वर्धते पुण्यं दातुः शतसहस्रिकम् ॥ 33 ॥
4.31.m: As far as the wealthy person is able with mind imbued with devotion, / to that extent the giver's merit increases a hundred-thousandfold.

4.31.s:
kiñcittāmramaye pātre vaṃśaje mṛnmayepi vā ..
pūjayaṃti narā raktaiḥ puṣpaiḥ kuṃkumakeśaraiḥ .. 34 ..
4.31.d:
किञ्चित्ताम्रमये पात्रे वंशजे मृन्मयेपि वा ॥
पूजयंति नरा रक्तैः पुष्पैः कुंकुमकेशरैः ॥ 34 ॥
4.31.m: Even in a small copper vessel, in one made of bamboo, or in an earthen one, / men worship him with red flowers and saffron filaments.

4.31.s:
( oṃ aṃgārakāya namaḥ śirasi ..
oṃkujāya namaḥ vadane ..
oṃ bhaumāya namaḥ skaṃdhayoḥ ..
oṃ maṃgalāya namaḥ bāhvoḥ ..
oṃ raktāya namaḥ urasi ..
oṃ lohitāṃgāya namaḥ kaṭyām ..
oṃ ārāya namaḥ jaṃghayoḥ ..
oṃ mahīdharāya namaḥ pādayoḥ ..
eṣāṣṭapuṣpikā ..
puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtaḥ pātre kujaṃ maṃtraiḥ samarcayet ..
guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyuktaṃ kṛṣṇāgarusamanvitam ..
dhūpaṃ sadravyajaṃ vāpi dadyāttatra samādhinā .. 35 ..
4.31.d:
( ओं अंगारकाय नमः शिरसि ॥
ओंकुजाय नमः वदने ॥
ओं भौमाय नमः स्कंधयोः ॥
ओं मंगलाय नमः बाह्वोः ॥
ओं रक्ताय नमः उरसि ॥
ओं लोहितांगाय नमः कट्याम् ॥
ओं आराय नमः जंघयोः ॥
ओं महीधराय नमः पादयोः ॥
एषाष्टपुष्पिका ॥
पुरुषाकृतिं कृतः पात्रे कुजं मंत्रैः समर्चयेत् ॥
गुग्गुलं घृतसंयुक्तं कृष्णागरुसमन्वितम् ॥
धूपं सद्रव्यजं वापि दद्यात्तत्र समाधिना ॥ 35 ॥
4.31.m: ("Om, homage to Aṅgāraka on the head; / Om, homage to Kuja on the face; / Om, homage to Bhauma on the two shoulders; / Om, homage to Maṅgala on the two arms; / Om, homage to the Red One on the chest; / Om, homage to the Red-limbed One on the waist; / Om, homage to Āra on the two shanks; / Om, homage to the Earth-supporter on the two feet." / This is the offering of eight flowers.) / Having made Kuja in human form in a vessel, he should worship him with the mantras; / incense of guggulu mixed with ghee, together with black agallochum, / or produced from aromatics, he should offer there with concentrated mind.

4.31.s:
homaṃ kurvīta pūrvoktairmaṃtrairmaṃgalasaṃ jñitaiḥ ..
evaṃ praṇamya deveśaṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..36..
4.31.d:
होमं कुर्वीत पूर्वोक्तैर्मंत्रैर्मंगलसं ज्ञितैः ॥
एवं प्रणम्य देवेशं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥36॥
4.31.m: He should perform the fire offering with the previously mentioned mantras known as Maṅgala. / Having thus bowed down to the Lord of gods, he should present it to a brāhmaṇa.

4.31.s:
niṣpāvakaṃ bhojanaṃ vā dadyācchaktyā sadakṣiṇam ..
vittaśāṭhyaṃ hi kurvāṇo na mukhyaphalabhāgbhavet .. 37 ..
4.31.d:
निष्पावकं भोजनं वा दद्याच्छक्त्या सदक्षिणम् ॥
वित्तशाठ्यं हि कुर्वाणो न मुख्यफलभाग्भवेत् ॥ 37 ॥
4.31.m: Or he should provide food prepared without beans according to his means, along with a priestly gift; / for one who practices deceit regarding wealth does not obtain the primary fruit.

4.31.s:
paścādbhuñjīta maunena bhūmiṃ kṛtvā tu bhājanam ..
mantreṇānena cālabhya tannibodha mayoditam .. 38 ..
4.31.d:
पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत मौनेन भूमिं कृत्वा तु भाजनम् ॥
मन्त्रेणानेन चालभ्य तन्निबोध मयोदितम् ॥ 38 ॥
4.31.m: Afterwards he should eat in silence, using the ground as his vessel, / and having touched it with this mantra; listen to that which is spoken by me:

4.31.s:
sarvauṣadhirasāvāse sarvadā sarva dāyini ..
tvattale bhoktukāmo'haṃ tadbhuktamamṛtaṃ bhavet .. 39 ..
4.31.d:
सर्वौषधिरसावासे सर्वदा सर्व दायिनि ॥
त्वत्तले भोक्तुकामोऽहं तद्भुक्तममृतं भवेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.31.m: "O abode of the essence of all herbs! O giver of all things at all times! / I desire to eat on your surface; may what is eaten become nectar!"

4.31.s:
yudhiṣṭhira uvāca ..
aṃgārakeṇa saṃyuktā caturthī naktabhojanaiḥ ..
upoṣyā katimātrā sā kimekā vada yādava .. 4.31.40 .. ..
4.31.d:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥
अंगारकेण संयुक्ता चतुर्थी नक्तभोजनैः ॥
उपोष्या कतिमात्रा सा किमेका वद यादव ॥ 4.31.40 ॥ ॥
4.31.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / The fourth lunar day joined with Tuesday, kept with nocturnal meals— / how many of them should be observed in fast, or is it just one? Tell me, O Yādava!

4.31.s:
śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca ..
caturthī ca caturthī ca yadāṃgārakasaṃyutā ..
upoṣyā tatratatraiva pradeyo vidhinā kujaḥ ..
vittahīnāḥ pratīkṣaṃte yāvadvittopalaṃbhanam ..41..
4.31.d:
श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥
चतुर्थी च चतुर्थी च यदांगारकसंयुता ॥
उपोष्या तत्रतत्रैव प्रदेयो विधिना कुजः ॥
वित्तहीनाः प्रतीक्षंते यावद्वित्तोपलंभनम् ॥41॥
4.31.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Every fourth lunar day that is joined with Tuesday / is to be fasted; on each of those occasions Kuja is to be gifted according to rule. / Those devoid of wealth wait until wealth is obtained.

4.31.s:
caturthyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca vidhānaṃ śṛṇu pāṇḍava ..
sauvarṇapātre kṛtvā tu aṃgārakamakṛtrimam ..
daśa sauvarṇikaṃ mukhyaṃ daśārddhārddhamathāpi vā ..42..
4.31.d:
चतुर्थ्यां च चतुर्थ्यां च विधानं शृणु पाण्डव ॥
सौवर्णपात्रे कृत्वा तु अंगारकमकृत्रिमम् ॥
दश सौवर्णिकं मुख्यं दशार्द्धार्द्धमथापि वा ॥42॥
4.31.m: Hear the procedure for each fourth lunar day, O Pāṇḍava: / Having placed in a golden vessel an unalloyed [image of] Aṅgāraka, / ten suvarṇas is the best weight, or even two and a half suvarṇas;

4.31.s:
viṃśatpalāni pātrāṇi viṃśatyarddhapalāni ca ..
viṃśatkarṣāṇi vā pārtha ato nyūnaṃ na kārayet ..43..
4.31.d:
विंशत्पलानि पात्राणि विंशत्यर्द्धपलानि च ॥
विंशत्कर्षाणि वा पार्थ अतो न्यूनं न कारयेत् ॥43॥
4.31.m: twenty palas [for] the vessels, or ten palas, / or twenty karṣas, O son of Pṛthā; one should not make it less than this.

4.31.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya kujaṃ maṃtrairvastraiḥ saṃpariveṣṭitam ..
puṣpamaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā divyāṃ saddhūpadhūpitām ..44..
4.31.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य कुजं मंत्रैर्वस्त्रैः संपरिवेष्टितम् ॥
पुष्पमंडपिकां कृत्वा दिव्यां सद्धूपधूपिताम् ॥44॥
4.31.m: Having installed Kuja with mantras, wrapped in clothes, / having erected a celestial little flower-pavilion perfumed with excellent incense,

4.31.s:
tatra saṃpūjayeddevaṃ pūrvamaṃtrairvidhānataḥ ..
bhaktyā bhojyairanekaiśca phalairatnaiśca sāgaraiḥ .. 45 ..
4.31.d:
तत्र संपूजयेद्देवं पूर्वमंत्रैर्विधानतः ॥
भक्त्या भोज्यैरनेकैश्च फलैरत्नैश्च सागरैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.31.m: there he should worship the god according to rule with the previously stated mantras, / with devotion, and with numerous eatables, fruits, and sea gems;

4.31.s:
vastraiḥ prāvaraṇairyānaiḥ śayyopānadvarāsanaiḥ ..
chatraiḥ puṣpairgandhavaraiḥ śaktyā vittānusārataḥ .. 46 ..
4.31.d:
वस्त्रैः प्रावरणैर्यानैः शय्योपानद्वरासनैः ॥
छत्रैः पुष्पैर्गन्धवरैः शक्त्या वित्तानुसारतः ॥ 46 ॥
4.31.m: with clothes, coverings, vehicles, beds, footwear, and excellent seats, / with royal parasols, flowers, and choice perfumes, according to ability and in proportion to his wealth.

4.31.s:
tato vipra parīkṣeta vrataśaucasamanvitam ..
vedādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ śāstrajñaṃ nirahaṃkṛtim.. 47 ..
4.31.d:
ततो विप्र परीक्षेत व्रतशौचसमन्वितम् ॥
वेदाध्ययनसंपन्नं शास्त्रज्ञं निरहंकृतिम्॥ 47 ॥
4.31.m: Then he should examine a brāhmaṇa endowed with observances and purity, / accomplished in the study of the Vedas, knowing the scriptures, and free from pride,

4.31.s:
aṃgārakavidhiṃ yaśca samyagjānāti śāstrataḥ..
āhvānavidhi maṃtrāṃśca homārcanavisarjanam .. 48 ..
4.31.d:
अंगारकविधिं यश्च सम्यग्जानाति शास्त्रतः॥
आह्वानविधि मंत्रांश्च होमार्चनविसर्जनम् ॥ 48 ॥
4.31.m: and one who properly knows the procedure for Aṅgāraka from the scriptures— / the mantras for the invocation rite, the oblation, worship, and dismissal.

4.31.s:
saṃpūjya vastrābharaṇaistasmai deyaḥ kujottamaḥ ..
yathā śruto yathā jñātastathā bhaktyā hyupoṣitaḥ .. 49 ..
4.31.d:
संपूज्य वस्त्राभरणैस्तस्मै देयः कुजोत्तमः ॥
यथा श्रुतो यथा ज्ञातस्तथा भक्त्या ह्युपोषितः ॥ 49 ॥
4.31.m: Having honoured him with clothes and ornaments, the excellent Kuja is to be given to him, / just as heard and understood, observed in fasting with devotion.

4.31.s:
vittasāreṇa tuṣya tvaṃ mama bhauma bhavodbhava ..
paṭhannimaṃ maṃtravaraṃ brāhmaṇāya nivedayet ..
brāhmaṇaścāpyasau vidvānmaṃtrametamudāharet .. 4.31.50 ..
4.31.d:
वित्तसारेण तुष्य त्वं मम भौम भवोद्भव ॥
पठन्निमं मंत्रवरं ब्राह्मणाय निवेदयेत् ॥
ब्राह्मणश्चाप्यसौ विद्वान्मंत्रमेतमुदाहरेत् ॥ 4.31.50 ॥
4.31.m: "Be pleased according to the best of my wealth, O Bhauma, born of Bhava!" / Reciting this excellent mantra, he should offer it to the brāhmaṇa; / and that learned brāhmaṇa should utter this mantra:

4.31.s:
maṃgalaṃ prati gṛhṇāmi ubhayorastu maṃgalam ..
dātṛpratigrāhakayoḥ kṣemārogyaṃ bhavatviti .. 51 .. pratigrāhakamaṃtraḥ ..
4.31.d:
मंगलं प्रति गृह्णामि उभयोरस्तु मंगलम् ॥
दातृप्रतिग्राहकयोः क्षेमारोग्यं भवत्विति ॥ 51 ॥ प्रतिग्राहकमंत्रः ॥
4.31.m: "I receive the auspicious one; may there be auspiciousness for both, / for the giver and the receiver! May there be safety and health!"—This is the mantra for the recipient.

4.31.s:
evaṃ caturthe saṃprāpte dhanaprāptirna vidyate ..
tadā maṃtrārcanaparaḥ punaretāṃ samācaret .. 52 ..
4.31.d:
एवं चतुर्थे संप्राप्ते धनप्राप्तिर्न विद्यते ॥
तदा मंत्रार्चनपरः पुनरेतां समाचरेत् ॥ 52 ॥
4.31.m: If, when the fourth arrives in this manner, wealth is not obtained, / then, devoted to mantra and worship, he should perform it again,

4.31.s:
āśarīranipātādvā yathoktaphalabhāgbhavet ..
alpavitto yathā śaktyā sarvametatsamācaret .. .. 53 ..
4.31.d:
आशरीरनिपाताद्वा यथोक्तफलभाग्भवेत् ॥
अल्पवित्तो यथा शक्त्या सर्वमेतत्समाचरेत् ॥ ॥ 53 ॥
4.31.m: or until the fall of the body; he will share the stated fruit. / One with little wealth should perform all this according to ability.

4.31.s:
aṃgārakeṇa saṃyuktāṃ vāsrāṃ(vastrāṃ) tilaśarāvikām ..
anena vidhinā dattvā yathoktaphalabhāgbhavet .. 54 ..
4.31.d:
अंगारकेण संयुक्तां वास्रां(वस्त्रां) तिलशराविकाम् ॥
अनेन विधिना दत्त्वा यथोक्तफलभाग्भवेत् ॥ 54 ॥
4.31.m: Having offered a cloth-covered saucer of sesamum on [a fourth lunar day] joined with Tuesday / according to this rule, he will partake of the stated fruit.

4.31.s:
evaṃ caturthīṃ yo bhaktyā kujayuktā mupoṣayet..
tasya puṇyaphalaṃ yacca tannibodha yudhiṣṭhira .. 55 ..
4.31.d:
एवं चतुर्थीं यो भक्त्या कुजयुक्ता मुपोषयेत्॥
तस्य पुण्यफलं यच्च तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर ॥ 55 ॥
4.31.m: Whoever thus fasts with devotion on the fourth lunar day joined with Kuja, / listen to the fruit of his merit, O Yudhiṣṭhira:

4.31.s:
iha sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ putrapautraśriyā vṛtaḥ ..
dehāvasāne divyaujā divyagandhānu lepanaḥ .. 56 ..
4.31.d:
इह स्थित्वा चिरं कालं पुत्रपौत्रश्रिया वृतः ॥
देहावसाने दिव्यौजा दिव्यगन्धानु लेपनः ॥ 56 ॥
4.31.m: Having remained here for a long time, surrounded by the prosperity of sons and grandsons, / at the end of the body, possessed of divine splendour, anointed with divine perfume,

4.31.s:
divyanārīgaṇavṛto vimānavaramāsthitaḥ ..
yāti devapuraṃ hṛṣṭo devaiḥ sahābhinaṃditaḥ .. 57 ..
4.31.d:
दिव्यनारीगणवृतो विमानवरमास्थितः ॥
याति देवपुरं हृष्टो देवैः सहाभिनंदितः ॥ 57 ॥
4.31.m: surrounded by celestial women, mounted on an excellent celestial chariot, / he goes to the city of the gods, joyful and praised by the gods.

4.31.s:
sa tatra ramate kālaṃ devaiḥ saha sureśavat..
caturyugāni ṣaṭtriṃśattataḥ kālāṃtare punaḥ .. 58 ..
4.31.d:
स तत्र रमते कालं देवैः सह सुरेशवत्॥
चतुर्युगानि षट्त्रिंशत्ततः कालांतरे पुनः ॥ 58 ॥
4.31.m: He delights there for a time along with the gods, like the lord of the gods, / for thirty-six caturyugas; then, after a passage of time,

4.31.s:
iha cāgatya rājāsau kule mahati jāyate ..
rūpavāndhanavānvāgmī dānaśīlo dayāparaḥ.. .. 59 ..
4.31.d:
इह चागत्य राजासौ कुले महति जायते ॥
रूपवान्धनवान्वाग्मी दानशीलो दयापरः॥ ॥ 59 ॥
4.31.m: returning here, he is born as a king in a great family, / handsome, wealthy, eloquent, endowed with charity, and devoted to compassion.

4.31.s:
nārī ca rūpasaṃpannā subhagā jātisaṃyutā ..
putrapautraiḥ parivṛtā bhartrā saha ramecciram ..4.31.60..
4.31.d:
नारी च रूपसंपन्ना सुभगा जातिसंयुता ॥
पुत्रपौत्रैः परिवृता भर्त्रा सह रमेच्चिरम् ॥4.31.60॥
4.31.m: And a woman [becomes] endowed with beauty, fortunate, of noble birth, / surrounded by sons and grandsons, and sports long with her husband.

4.31.s:
ramitvā suciraṃ kālaṃ punaḥ svargagatiṃ labhet ..
eṣa te kathito rājansarahasyo vidhistathā ..
durllabho yo manuṣyāṇāṃ devānāṃ bhadramastu te .. 61 ..
4.31.d:
रमित्वा सुचिरं कालं पुनः स्वर्गगतिं लभेत् ॥
एष ते कथितो राजन्सरहस्यो विधिस्तथा ॥
दुर्ल्लभो यो मनुष्याणां देवानां भद्रमस्तु ते ॥ 61 ॥
4.31.m: Having delighted for a very long time, she again attains the path to heaven. / This procedure has been related to you, O king, along with its secret, / which is difficult to attain for men and for gods; may auspiciousness be yours!

4.31.s:
aṃgārakeṇa sahitā tu sitā caturthī śastā surārccanavidhau pitṛpiṇḍadāne ..
tasyāṃ kujaṃ kurukulodvaha ye'rcayaṃti bhūmau bhavaṃti bahumaṃgalabhājanāste .. 62 .. ..
vināyakasnapanacaturthīvratavarṇanam
4.31.d:
अंगारकेण सहिता तु सिता चतुर्थी शस्ता सुरार्च्चनविधौ पितृपिण्डदाने ॥
तस्यां कुजं कुरुकुलोद्वह येऽर्चयंति भूमौ भवंति बहुमंगलभाजनास्ते ॥ 62 ॥ ॥
विनायकस्नपनचतुर्थीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.31.m:
The bright fourth lunar day joined with Tuesday is praised in the rite of worshipping the gods and offering ancestral rice-balls; / those who worship Kuja on it, O upholder of the Kuru race, become the vessels of great auspiciousness on earth.
Description of the Vināyakasnāpanacaturthī Vrata

4.32.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
yanna siddhyanti karmāṇi prārabdhāni narottamaiḥ ..
tatkena kāraṇenaitatpṛṣṭo me brūhi mādhava .. 1 ..
4.32.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
यन्न सिद्ध्यन्ति कर्माणि प्रारब्धानि नरोत्तमैः ॥
तत्केन कारणेनैतत्पृष्टो मे ब्रूहि माधव ॥ 1 ॥
4.32.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / When undertakings begun by the best of men do not succeed, / for what reason is that? Being asked, tell me, O Mādhava!

4.32.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
vināyakorthasiddhyarthaṃ lokasya viniyojitaḥ ..
gaṇānāmādhipatye ca rudreṇa brahmaṇā tathā .. 2 ..
4.32.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
विनायकोर्थसिद्ध्यर्थं लोकस्य विनियोजितः ॥
गणानामाधिपत्ये च रुद्रेण ब्रह्मणा तथा ॥ 2 ॥
4.32.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Vināyaka was appointed by Rudra and Brahmā / for the success of goals of the world and to lordship over the gaṇas.

4.32.s:
tenopasṛṣṭo yastasya lakṣaṇāni nibodhata ..
svapne'vagāhate'tyarthaṃ jalaṃ muṇḍāṃśca paśyati .. 3 ..
4.32.d:
तेनोपसृष्टो यस्तस्य लक्षणानि निबोधत ॥
स्वप्नेऽवगाहतेऽत्यर्थं जलं मुण्डांश्च पश्यति ॥ 3 ॥
4.32.m: Listen to the symptoms of one who is afflicted by him: / in dream he plunges deeply into water and sees shaven-headed men,

4.32.s:
kāṣāyavāsasaścaiva kravyādāṃścādhirohati ..
aṃtyajairgardabhairuṣṭraiḥ sahaikatrāvatiṣṭhate .. 4 ..
4.32.d:
काषायवाससश्चैव क्रव्यादांश्चाधिरोहति ॥
अंत्यजैर्गर्दभैरुष्ट्रैः सहैकत्रावतिष्ठते ॥ 4 ॥
4.32.m: and those wearing ochre garments, and he mounts carnivorous beasts; / he stays in one place with outcastes, donkeys, and camels;

4.32.s:
vrajamānastathātmānaṃ manyate tu gataṃ paraiḥ ..
vimanā viphalāraṃbhaḥ sasīdatyanimittataḥ .. 5 ..
4.32.d:
व्रजमानस्तथात्मानं मन्यते तु गतं परैः ॥
विमना विफलारंभः ससीदत्यनिमित्ततः ॥ 5 ॥
4.32.m: while walking, he thinks himself pursued by others; / absent-minded, his undertakings fruitless, he sinks down without reason;

4.32.s:
pātakī vihīnacchāyo mlānatvahetulakṣaṇaḥ ..
karabhārūḍhamātmānaṃ mahiṣakharagaṃ tathā ..6..
4.32.d:
पातकी विहीनच्छायो म्लानत्वहेतुलक्षणः ॥
करभारूढमात्मानं महिषखरगं तथा ॥6॥
4.32.m: [he appears] sinful, deprived of radiance, characterized by the cause of dejection; / he sees himself mounted on a young camel, and also riding a buffalo or donkey,

4.32.s:
yātudhānāśritaṃ yānaṃ śmaśānasyāṃtikaṃ nṛpa ..
vīkṣeta kuruśārdūla svapnāṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
tailārdramātraṃ svaṃ dehaṃ karavīravibhūṣitam..7..
4.32.d:
यातुधानाश्रितं यानं श्मशानस्यांतिकं नृप ॥
वीक्षेत कुरुशार्दूल स्वप्नांते नात्र संशयः ॥
तैलार्द्रमात्रं स्वं देहं करवीरविभूषितम्॥7॥
4.32.m: or a chariot occupied by yātudhānas near a cremation ground, O king; / he sees this at the end of a dream, O tiger of the Kurus, of this there is no doubt; / and his own body wet only with oil, adorned with oleander flowers.

4.32.s:
tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanaṃdanaḥ ..
kumārī na ca bhartāramapatyaṃ garbhamaṃganā .. 8 ..
4.32.d:
तेनोपसृष्टो लभते न राज्यं राजनंदनः ॥
कुमारी न च भर्तारमपत्यं गर्भमंगना ॥ 8 ॥
4.32.m: Afflicted by him, a king's son does not obtain the kingdom; / a maiden does not find a husband, nor a pregnant woman offspring;

4.32.s:
ācāryatvaṃ śrotriyaśca na śiṣyo'dhyayanaṃ tathā..
vaṇiglābhaṃ na cāpnoti kṛṣiṃ caiva kṛṣīvalaḥ .. 9 ..
4.32.d:
आचार्यत्वं श्रोत्रियश्च न शिष्योऽध्ययनं तथा॥
वणिग्लाभं न चाप्नोति कृषिं चैव कृषीवलः ॥ 9 ॥
4.32.m: a learned brāhmaṇa does not obtain teachership, nor a pupil his study; / a merchant attains no profit, nor a ploughman farming.

4.32.s:
snapanaṃ tasya kartavyaṃ puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam ..
gaurasarṣapakalkena vastreṇācchāditasya tu .. 4.32.10 ..
4.32.d:
स्नपनं तस्य कर्तव्यं पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ॥
गौरसर्षपकल्केन वस्त्रेणाच्छादितस्य तु ॥ 4.32.10 ॥
4.32.m: An ablution should be performed for him on an auspicious day according to rule, / for him covered with a cloth, with a paste of yellow mustard,

4.32.s:
sarvauṣadhaiḥ sarvagandhairviliptaśirasastathā ..
śuklapakṣe caturthyāṃ tu vāre vā dhiṣaṇasya tu .. 11 ..
4.32.d:
सर्वौषधैः सर्वगन्धैर्विलिप्तशिरसस्तथा ॥
शुक्लपक्षे चतुर्थ्यां तु वारे वा धिषणस्य तु ॥ 11 ॥
4.32.m: with all medicinal herbs, with his head anointed with all perfumes, / on the fourth lunar day of the bright fortnight, or on Thursday,

4.32.s:
puṣye ca vīranakṣatre tasyaiva purato nṛpa ..
bhadrāsanopaviṣṭasya svastirvācyā dvijaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 12 ..
4.32.d:
पुष्ये च वीरनक्षत्रे तस्यैव पुरतो नृप ॥
भद्रासनोपविष्टस्य स्वस्तिर्वाच्या द्विजैः शुभैः ॥ 12 ॥
4.32.m: and under Puṣya, the heroic lunar mansion, right before him, O king; / for him seated on a bhadrāsana, blessings should be recited by auspicious brāhmaṇas.

4.32.s:
catvāra ṛgyajuḥ sāmātharvaṇapravaṇāstataḥ ..
vyomakeśaṃ tu saṃpūjya pārvatīṃ bhūmijaṃ tathā .. .. 13 ..
4.32.d:
चत्वार ऋग्यजुः सामाथर्वणप्रवणास्ततः ॥
व्योमकेशं तु संपूज्य पार्वतीं भूमिजं तथा ॥ ॥ 13 ॥
4.32.m: Then four [priests] devoted to the Ṛg, Yajus, Sāma, and Atharva [Vedas], / having worshipped Vyomakeśa, Pārvatī, and the Son of Earth (Mars),

4.32.s:
kṛṣṇasya pitaraṃ cātha avatāraṃ sitaṃ tathā ..
dhiṣaṇaṃ kledaputraṃ ca koṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca bhārata ..
vidhuṃtudaṃ bāhuleyaṃ naṃdakasya ca dhāriṇam .. .. 14..
4.32.d:
कृष्णस्य पितरं चाथ अवतारं सितं तथा ॥
धिषणं क्लेदपुत्रं च कोणं लक्ष्मीं च भारत ॥
विधुंतुदं बाहुलेयं नंदकस्य च धारिणम् ॥ ॥ 14॥
4.32.m: and the father of Kṛṣṇa, the white descent (Venus), / Dhiṣaṇa (Jupiter), the son of Moisture (Mercury), Koṇa (Saturn), and Lakṣmī, O descendant of Bharata, / Vidhuṃtuda (Rāhu), Bāhuleya (Kārttikeya), and the wielder of the Nandaka sword (Viṣṇu),

4.32.s:
aśvasthānādgajasthānādvalmīkātsaṃgamādhradāt ..
mṛttikāṃ rocanāṃ ratnaṃ gugguluṃ cāpsu nikṣipet .. 15 ..
4.32.d:
अश्वस्थानाद्गजस्थानाद्वल्मीकात्संगमाध्रदात् ॥
मृत्तिकां रोचनां रत्नं गुग्गुलुं चाप्सु निक्षिपेत् ॥ 15 ॥
4.32.m: should throw into water earth from a horse-stable, an elephant-stable, / an anthill, a confluence, and a lake, as well as rocanā, jewels, and guggulu,

4.32.s:
yadāhṛtaṃ hyekavarṇaiścaturbhiḥ kalaśairhradāt ..
carmaṇyānaḍuhe rakte sthāpya bhadrāsanaṃ tathā .. 16 ..
4.32.d:
यदाहृतं ह्येकवर्णैश्चतुर्भिः कलशैर्ह्रदात् ॥
चर्मण्यानडुहे रक्ते स्थाप्य भद्रासनं तथा ॥ 16 ॥
4.32.m: which has been brought from a lake in four jars of a single colour. / Placing a seat of auspiciousness upon a red ox-hide,

4.32.s:
sahasrākṣaṃ śatadhāramṛṣibhiḥ pāvanaṃ kṛtam ..
tena tvāmabhiṣiṃcāmi pāva mānyaḥ punaṃtu me .. 17 ..
4.32.d:
सहस्राक्षं शतधारमृषिभिः पावनं कृतम् ॥
तेन त्वामभिषिंचामि पाव मान्यः पुनंतु मे ॥ 17 ॥
4.32.m: “The thousand-eyed, hundred-streamed [water] made purifying by the sages: / with that I consecrate you; may the purifying [waters] cleanse me.”

4.32.s:
oṃ bhagaṃ te varuṇo rājā bhagaṃ sūryo bṛhaspatiḥ ..
bhagamindraśca vāyuśca bhagaṃ saptarṣayo daduḥ .. 18 ..
4.32.d:
ओं भगं ते वरुणो राजा भगं सूर्यो बृहस्पतिः ॥
भगमिन्द्रश्च वायुश्च भगं सप्तर्षयो ददुः ॥ 18 ॥
4.32.m: “Oṃ, King Varuṇa gave you fortune; the Sun and Bṛhaspati gave fortune; / Indra and Vāyu gave fortune; the seven sages gave fortune.”

4.32.s:
yatte keśeṣu daurbhāgyaṃ sīmaṃte yacca mūrddhani ..
lalāṭe karṇayorakṣṇorāpastadghnaṃtu sarvadā .. 19 ..
4.32.d:
यत्ते केशेषु दौर्भाग्यं सीमंते यच्च मूर्द्धनि ॥
ललाटे कर्णयोरक्ष्णोरापस्तद्घ्नंतु सर्वदा ॥ 19 ॥
4.32.m: “Whatever misfortune is in your hair, in your parting, and on your head, / on your forehead, in your ears, or in your eyes, may the waters always destroy that.”

4.32.s:
snātasya sārṣapaṃ tailaṃ sruveṇauduṃbareṇa tu ..
juhuyānmūrdhni śakalānsavyena pratigṛhya ca .. 4.32.20 ..
4.32.d:
स्नातस्य सार्षपं तैलं स्रुवेणौदुंबरेण तु ॥
जुहुयान्मूर्ध्नि शकलान्सव्येन प्रतिगृह्य च ॥ 4.32.20 ॥
4.32.m: Over the one who has bathed, with an udumbara ladle, [the priest] should offer mustard oil / on the head, having taken fragments with his left hand.

4.32.s:
mitaśca sammitaścaiva tathā śālakaṭaṃkaṭo ..
kūṣmāṇḍo rājaputraścetyaṃte svāhāsamanvitaiḥ .. 21 ..
4.32.d:
मितश्च सम्मितश्चैव तथा शालकटंकटो ॥
कूष्माण्डो राजपुत्रश्चेत्यंते स्वाहासमन्वितैः ॥ 21 ॥
4.32.m: “To Mita, to Sammita, and likewise to Śālakaṭaṅkaṭa, / to Kūṣmāṇḍa-Rājaputra”—with [these names] ending with svāhā,

4.32.s:
nāmabhirbalimantraiśca namaskārasamanvitaiḥ ..
dadyāccatuṣpathe śūrpe kuśānāstīrya sarvataḥ .. 22 ..
4.32.d:
नामभिर्बलिमन्त्रैश्च नमस्कारसमन्वितैः ॥
दद्याच्चतुष्पथे शूर्पे कुशानास्तीर्य सर्वतः ॥ 22 ॥
4.32.m: and with offering-mantras accompanied by acts of homage, / he should present [the offering] at a crossroads in a winnowing basket, having strewn kuśa grass all around,

4.32.s:
kṛtākṛtāṃstaṃḍulāṃśca pala laudanameva ca ..
matsyānhyapakvāṃśca tathā māṃsametāvadeva tu .. 23 ..
4.32.d:
कृताकृतांस्तंडुलांश्च पल लौदनमेव च ॥
मत्स्यान्ह्यपक्वांश्च तथा मांसमेतावदेव तु ॥ 23 ॥
4.32.m: consisting of huskless and unhusked rice, rice mixed with sesamum, / raw fish, and meat—only this much,

4.32.s:
puṣpānvitaṃ sugandhaṃ ca surāṃ ca trividhāmapi ..
mūlakaṃ pūrikā pūpāṃstathaivoṃḍerakasrajaḥ .. 24 ..
4.32.d:
पुष्पान्वितं सुगन्धं च सुरां च त्रिविधामपि ॥
मूलकं पूरिका पूपांस्तथैवोंडेरकस्रजः ॥ 24 ॥
4.32.m: along with flowers, fragrant scent, the three kinds of spirituous liquor, / radish, pūrikās, cakes, and garlands of oṇḍerakas,

4.32.s:
dadhyannaṃ pāyasaṃ caiva guḍaveṣṭitamodakam ..
vināyakasya jananīmupatiṣṭhettatoṃbikām ..
dūrvāsarṣapa puṣpāṇāṃ dattvārghyaṃ pūrṇamañjalim .. 25 ..
4.32.d:
दध्यन्नं पायसं चैव गुडवेष्टितमोदकम् ॥
विनायकस्य जननीमुपतिष्ठेत्ततोंबिकाम् ॥
दूर्वासर्षप पुष्पाणां दत्त्वार्घ्यं पूर्णमञ्जलिम् ॥ 25 ॥
4.32.m: curd-rice, pāyasa, and modakas wrapped in jaggery. / Then he should approach Ambikā, the mother of Vināyaka, / having offered a full double-handful of dūrvā grass, mustard seeds, and flowers as an arghya:

4.32.s:
rūpaṃdehi jayaṃ dehi bhagaṃ bhavati dehi me ..
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi sarvānkāmāṃśca dehi me .. .. 26 ..
4.32.d:
रूपंदेहि जयं देहि भगं भवति देहि मे ॥
पुत्रान्देहि धनं देहि सर्वान्कामांश्च देहि मे ॥ ॥ 26 ॥
4.32.m: “Give me beauty, give me victory, O goddess, give me fortune; / give me sons, give me wealth, and grant all my desires.

4.32.s:
prabalaṃ kuru me devi balavikhyātisambhavam ..
śuklamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śuklagandhānulepanaḥ ..
bhojayedbrāhmaṇāndadyādvastrayugmaṃ gurorapi .. 27 ..
4.32.d:
प्रबलं कुरु मे देवि बलविख्यातिसम्भवम् ॥
शुक्लमाल्यांबरधरः शुक्लगन्धानुलेपनः ॥
भोजयेद्ब्राह्मणान्दद्याद्वस्त्रयुग्मं गुरोरपि ॥ 27 ॥
4.32.m: Make me mighty, O goddess, arising from strength and renown.” / Wearing white garlands and white clothes, anointed with white sandalwood paste, / he should feed the brāhmaṇas and also give a pair of garments to his guru.

4.32.s:
evaṃ vināyakaṃ pūjya grahāṃścaiva vidhānataḥ ..
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti śriyaṃ prāpnotyanuttamām .. 28 ..
4.32.d:
एवं विनायकं पूज्य ग्रहांश्चैव विधानतः ॥
कर्मणां फलमाप्नोति श्रियं प्राप्नोत्यनुत्तमाम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.32.m: Having thus worshipped Vināyaka and the planets according to rule, / he obtains the fruit of his rites and attains unsurpassable prosperity.

4.32.s:
ādityasya sadā pūjāṃ tilakaṃ svāminastathā ..
mahāgaṇapateścaiva kurvansiddhimavāpnuyāt .. 29 ..
4.32.d:
आदित्यस्य सदा पूजां तिलकं स्वामिनस्तथा ॥
महागणपतेश्चैव कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् ॥ 29 ॥
4.32.m: Always performing worship of the Sun, the mark of the Master, / and Mahāgaṇapati, he would attain perfection.

4.32.s:
vaināyakaṃ vinayasattvavatāṃ narāṇāṃ snānaṃ praśastamiha vighnavināśakāri ..
kurvaṃti ye vidhivadatra bhavaṃti teṣāṃ kāryāṇyabhīṣṭaphaladāni na saṃśayo'tra .. 4.32.30 ..
vināyakacaturthīvratavarṇanam
4.32.d:
वैनायकं विनयसत्त्ववतां नराणां स्नानं प्रशस्तमिह विघ्नविनाशकारि ॥
कुर्वंति ये विधिवदत्र भवंति तेषां कार्याण्यभीष्टफलदानि न संशयोऽत्र ॥ 4.32.30 ॥
विनायकचतुर्थीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.32.m:
The Vināyaka bath of men endowed with modesty and virtue is praised here as destroying obstacles; / for those who perform it according to rule here, their undertakings yield the desired fruit—there is no doubt of this.
Description of the Vināyakacaturthī Votive Observance

4.33.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
athāvighnakaraṃ rājankathayāmi vrataṃ tava ..
yena samyakṛteneha na vighnamupajāyate .. 1 ..
4.33.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
अथाविघ्नकरं राजन्कथयामि व्रतं तव ॥
येन सम्यकृतेनेह न विघ्नमुपजायते ॥ 1 ॥
4.33.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “Now, O king, I shall tell you the obstacle-removing votive observance, / by the proper performance of which here no obstacle arises.

4.33.s:
caturthyāṃ phālgune māsi gṛhītavyaṃ vrataṃ tvidam ..
naktāhāreṇa rājendra tilānnaṃ pāraṇaṃ smṛtam .. 2 ..
4.33.d:
चतुर्थ्यां फाल्गुने मासि गृहीतव्यं व्रतं त्विदम् ॥
नक्ताहारेण राजेन्द्र तिलान्नं पारणं स्मृतम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.33.m: This votive observance is to be undertaken on the fourth lunar day in the month of Phālguna. / With a nocturnal meal, O king of kings, sesamum-rice is prescribed as the concluding meal.

4.33.s: tadeva vahnau hotavyaṃ brāhmaṇāya ca tadbhavet .. 3 ..
4.33.d: तदेव वह्नौ होतव्यं ब्राह्मणाय च तद्भवेत् ॥ 3 ॥
4.33.m: That very [food] is to be offered into the fire, and that should be given to a brāhmaṇa.

4.33.s:
śūrāya vīrāya gajānanāya laṃbodarāyaikaradāya caiva ..
evaṃ tu saṃpūjya punaśca homaṃ kuryādvratī vighnavināśahetoḥ .. 4 ..
4.33.d:
शूराय वीराय गजाननाय लंबोदरायैकरदाय चैव ॥
एवं तु संपूज्य पुनश्च होमं कुर्याद्व्रती विघ्नविनाशहेतोः ॥ 4 ॥
4.33.m: ‘To the brave, to the hero, to the Elephant-faced, to the Pot-bellied, and to the Single-tusked’— / having thus worshipped, the observer of the votive observance should further perform a fire sacrifice for the destruction of obstacles.

4.33.s:
cāturmāsyāṃ vrataṃ caiva kṛtvetthaṃ pañcame tathā ..
sauvarṇaṃ gajavaktraṃ tu kṛtvā viprāya dāpayet .. 5 ..
4.33.d:
चातुर्मास्यां व्रतं चैव कृत्वेत्थं पञ्चमे तथा ॥
सौवर्णं गजवक्त्रं तु कृत्वा विप्राय दापयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.33.m: Having performed the votive observance thus during the four months, on the fifth / he should fashion a golden elephant-faced [image] and give it to a vipra,

4.33.s:
tāmrapātraiḥ pāyasabhṛtaiścaturbhiḥ sahitaṃ nṛpa ..
pañcamena tilaiḥ sārddhaṃ gaṇeśādhiṣṭhitena ca .. 6 ..
4.33.d:
ताम्रपात्रैः पायसभृतैश्चतुर्भिः सहितं नृप ॥
पञ्चमेन तिलैः सार्द्धं गणेशाधिष्ठितेन च ॥ 6 ॥
4.33.m: accompanied by four copper vessels filled with pāyasa, O king, / along with a fifth filled with sesamum seeds and surmounted by Gaṇeśa.

4.33.s:
mṛnmayānyapi pātrāṇi vittahīnastu kārayet ..
heraṃbaṃ rājataṃ tadvadvidhinānena dāpayet ..
itthaṃ vratamidaṃ kṛtvā sarvavipraiḥ pramucyate .. 7 ..
4.33.d:
मृन्मयान्यपि पात्राणि वित्तहीनस्तु कारयेत् ॥
हेरंबं राजतं तद्वद्विधिनानेन दापयेत् ॥
इत्थं व्रतमिदं कृत्वा सर्वविप्रैः प्रमुच्यते ॥ 7 ॥
4.33.m: One who is lacking in wealth may use vessels made of clay, / and likewise he should donate a silver Heramba according to this rule. / Having performed this votive observance in this manner, he is freed from all troubles.

4.33.s:
hayamedhasya vighne tu saṃjāte sagaraḥ purā ..
etadeva vrataṃ cīrtvā punaraśvaṃ pralabdhavān .. 8 ..
4.33.d:
हयमेधस्य विघ्ने तु संजाते सगरः पुरा ॥
एतदेव व्रतं चीर्त्वा पुनरश्वं प्रलब्धवान् ॥ 8 ॥
4.33.m: Anciently, when an obstacle arose to his horse sacrifice, Sagara, / having performed this very votive observance, recovered his horse.

4.33.s:
tathā rudreṇa devena tripuraṃ nighnatā purā ..
etadeva kṛtaṃ yasmāttripurastena ghātitaḥ .. 9 ..
4.33.d:
तथा रुद्रेण देवेन त्रिपुरं निघ्नता पुरा ॥
एतदेव कृतं यस्मात्त्रिपुरस्तेन घातितः ॥ 9 ॥
4.33.m: Likewise, when the divine Rudra was slaying Tripura in ancient times, / he performed this very [votive observance], and therefore Tripura was slain by him.

4.33.s:
mayā samudraṃ viśatāṃ etadeva vrataṃ kṛtam ..
tenādridrumasaṃyuktā pṛthivī punaruddhṛtā .. 4.33.10 ..
4.33.d:
मया समुद्रं विशतां एतदेव व्रतं कृतम् ॥
तेनाद्रिद्रुमसंयुक्ता पृथिवी पुनरुद्धृता ॥ 4.33.10 ॥
4.33.m: By me, entering the ocean, this very votive observance was performed; / through it the earth, joined with mountains and trees, was raised up again.

4.33.s:
anyairapi mahīpālairetadeva kṛtaṃ purā ..
tapo'rthibhiryajña siddhyai nirvighnaṃ syātparaṃtapa .. 11 ..
4.33.d:
अन्यैरपि महीपालैरेतदेव कृतं पुरा ॥
तपोऽर्थिभिर्यज्ञ सिद्ध्यै निर्विघ्नं स्यात्परंतप ॥ 11 ॥
4.33.m: By other rulers of the earth too this very [votive observance] was performed in ancient times, / and by those desirous of austerities for the success of their sacrifices, so that there would be freedom from obstacles, O scorcher of foes.

4.33.s:
anena kṛtamātreṇa sarvavipraiḥ pramucyate ..
mṛto rudrapuraṃ yāti varāhavacanaṃ yathā .. 12 ..
4.33.d:
अनेन कृतमात्रेण सर्वविप्रैः प्रमुच्यते ॥
मृतो रुद्रपुरं याति वराहवचनं यथा ॥ 12 ॥
4.33.m: Merely by performing this, one is freed from all troubles; / when he dies, he goes to the city of Rudra, as is the word of the Boar.

4.33.s:
vighnāni tasya na bhavaṃti gṛhe kadāciddharmārthakāmasukhasiddhivighātakāni ..
yaḥ saptamīnduśakalākṛtikāṃ tadaṃtaṃ vighneśamarcayati naktakṛtī caturthyām .. 13 ..
śāntivratavarṇanam
4.33.d:
विघ्नानि तस्य न भवंति गृहे कदाचिद्धर्मार्थकामसुखसिद्धिविघातकानि ॥
यः सप्तमीन्दुशकलाकृतिकां तदंतं विघ्नेशमर्चयति नक्तकृती चतुर्थ्याम् ॥ 13 ॥
शान्तिव्रतवर्णनम्
4.33.m:
No obstacles, which ruin the achievement of righteousness, wealth, desire, and happiness, ever arise in the home of him / who, having performed the nocturnal rite on the fourth lunar day, worships the Lord of Obstacles, whose shape is that of the crescent of the seventh lunar day's moon.”
Description of the Śāntivrata

4.34.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
śāṃtivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvekamanādhunā ..
yena cīrṇena śāṃtiḥ syātsarvadā gṛhamedhinām .. 1 ..
4.34.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शांतिव्रतं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वेकमनाधुना ॥
येन चीर्णेन शांतिः स्यात्सर्वदा गृहमेधिनाम् ॥ 1 ॥
4.34.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / “I shall declare the Śāntivrata; listen now with one-pointed mind, / by the practice of which there will always be peace for householders.

4.34.s:
pañcamyāṃ śuklapakṣasya kārtike māsi pārthiva ..
ārabhya varṣamekaṃ tu hyaśnīyādamlavarjitam .. 2 ..
4.34.d:
पञ्चम्यां शुक्लपक्षस्य कार्तिके मासि पार्थिव ॥
आरभ्य वर्षमेकं तु ह्यश्नीयादम्लवर्जितम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.34.m: Starting on the fifth lunar day of the bright fortnight in the month of Kārttika, O king, / for one full year he should eat food free from sour things.

4.34.s:
naktaṃ devaṃ ca saṃpūjya hariṃ śeṣoparisthitam ..
anaṃtāyeti pādau tu dhṛtarāṣṭrāya vai kaṭim .. 3 ..
4.34.d:
नक्तं देवं च संपूज्य हरिं शेषोपरिस्थितम् ॥
अनंतायेति पादौ तु धृतराष्ट्राय वै कटिम् ॥ 3 ॥
4.34.m: Having worshipped the god Hari standing upon Śeṣa at night: / ‘To Ananta’—the feet; ‘to Dhṛtarāṣṭra’—the waist;

4.34.s:
udaraṃ takṣakāyeti uraḥ karkoṭakāya ca ..
padmāya karṇau saṃpūjya mahāpadmāya doryugam .. 4 ..
4.34.d:
उदरं तक्षकायेति उरः कर्कोटकाय च ॥
पद्माय कर्णौ संपूज्य महापद्माय दोर्युगम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.34.m: ‘to Takṣaka’—the belly; and ‘to Karkoṭaka’—the chest; / having worshipped the ears with ‘to Padma’, and the two arms with ‘to Mahāpadma’,

4.34.s:
śaṃkhapālāya vakṣastu kulikāyeti vai śiraḥ ..
evaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarvagataṃ pṛthageva prapūjayet .. 5 ..
4.34.d:
शंखपालाय वक्षस्तु कुलिकायेति वै शिरः ॥
एवं विष्णुं सर्वगतं पृथगेव प्रपूजयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
4.34.m: the chest with ‘to Śaṅkhapāla’, and the head with ‘to Kulika’; / thus he should worship all-pervading Viṣṇu distinctly.

4.34.s:
kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ kuryāddharimuddiśya vāgyataḥ ..
tadagre homayetkṣīraṃ tilaiḥ saha vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 6 ..
4.34.d:
क्षीरेण स्नपनं कुर्याद्धरिमुद्दिश्य वाग्यतः ॥
तदग्रे होमयेत्क्षीरं तिलैः सह विचक्षणः ॥ 6 ॥
4.34.m: With speech restrained, he should bathe Hari with milk; / in front of him, the wise man should offer milk into the fire along with sesamum seeds.”

4.34.s:
evaṃ saṃvatsarasyāṃte kuryādbrāhmaṇabhojanam ..
acyutaṃ kāṃcanaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇaṃ tu vicakṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
4.34.d:
एवं संवत्सरस्यांते कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥
अच्युतं कांचनं कृत्वा सुवर्णं तु विचक्षणः ॥ 7 ॥
4.34.m: In this manner, at the end of the year, one should feed brāhmaṇas. / The discerning man should fashion an image of Acyuta out of gold, weighing a suvarṇa,

4.34.s:
gāṃ savatsāṃ vastrayugaṃ kāṃsyapātraṃ sapāyasam ..
hiraṇyaṃ ca yathāśakti brāhmaṇāyopapādayet .. 8 ..
4.34.d:
गां सवत्सां वस्त्रयुगं कांस्यपात्रं सपायसम् ॥
हिरण्यं च यथाशक्ति ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् ॥ 8 ॥
4.34.m: and give to a brāhmaṇa, according to his means, a cow with its calf, / a pair of garments, a bronze vessel filled with milk-rice, and gold.

4.34.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā vratametannarādhipa ..
tasya śāṃtirbhavennityaṃ nāgānāmabhayaṃ tathā .. 9 ..
4.34.d:
एवं यः कुरुते भक्त्या व्रतमेतन्नराधिप ॥
तस्य शांतिर्भवेन्नित्यं नागानामभयं तथा ॥ 9 ॥
4.34.m: Whoever performs this votive observance with devotion in this manner, O ruler of men, / to him peace will always belong, and likewise freedom from the fear of snakes.

4.34.s:
śeṣāhibhogaśayanasthamayogasūtiṃ saṃpūjya yajñapuruṣaṃ patageṃdranātham..
ye pūjayaṃti madhuraiḥ sitapañcamīṣu teṣāṃ na nāgajanitaṃ bhayamabhyupaiti .. 4.34.10 ..
sārasvatavratavarṇanam
4.34.d:
शेषाहिभोगशयनस्थमयोगसूतिं संपूज्य यज्ञपुरुषं पतगेंद्रनाथम्॥
ये पूजयंति मधुरैः सितपञ्चमीषु तेषां न नागजनितं भयमभ्युपैति ॥ 4.34.10 ॥
सारस्वतव्रतवर्णनम्
4.34.m:
Those who worship the lord of the sacrifice, resting on the bed of Śeṣa the serpent's coils, who is the source beyond yoga, the lord of the king of birds, / and worship with sweet offerings on the bright fifth lunar days, no fear born of snakes approaches them.
Description of the Sārasvata Votive Observance

4.35.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
madhurā bhāratī kena vratena madhusūdana ..
tathaiva janasaubhāgyamatividyāsu kauśalam ..1..
4.35.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
मधुरा भारती केन व्रतेन मधुसूदन ॥
तथैव जनसौभाग्यमतिविद्यासु कौशलम् ॥1॥
4.35.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / By which votive observance, O Madhusūdana, does sweet speech arise, / as well as popularity among people and great skill in the branches of knowledge?

4.35.s:
abhedaścāpi daṃpatyostathā baṃdhujanena ca ..
āyuśca vipulaṃ puṃsāṃ jāyate kena keśava .. 2 ..
4.35.d:
अभेदश्चापि दंपत्योस्तथा बंधुजनेन च ॥
आयुश्च विपुलं पुंसां जायते केन केशव ॥ 2 ॥
4.35.m: And by what, O Keśava, does non-discord arise between husband and wife / and with kinsmen, as well as a long lifespan for men?

4.35.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
samyakpṛṣṭastvayā rājañchṛṇu sārasvataṃ vratam ..
yasya saṃkīrtanādeva tuṣyatīha sarasvatī .. 3 ..
4.35.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
सम्यक्पृष्टस्त्वया राजञ्छृणु सारस्वतं व्रतम् ॥
यस्य संकीर्तनादेव तुष्यतीह सरस्वती ॥ 3 ॥
4.35.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / You have asked well, O king. Hear the Sārasvata votive observance, / merely by the recitation of which Sarasvatī is pleased in this world.

4.35.s:
yo'yaṃ bhaktaḥ pumānkuryādetadvratamanuttamam ..
tadvatsarādau saṃpūjya vipreṇa taṃ samācaret .. 4 ..
4.35.d:
योऽयं भक्तः पुमान्कुर्यादेतद्व्रतमनुत्तमम् ॥
तद्वत्सरादौ संपूज्य विप्रेण तं समाचरेत् ॥ 4 ॥
4.35.m: Whatever devoted man would perform this supreme votive observance / should carry it out with the help of a brāhmaṇa, having worshipped at the beginning of that year.

4.35.s:
atha cādityavāreṇa grahatārābalena ca ..
pāyasaṃ bhojayitvā ca kuryādbrāhmaṇavācanam .. 5 ..
4.35.d:
अथ चादित्यवारेण ग्रहताराबलेन च ॥
पायसं भोजयित्वा च कुर्याद्ब्राह्मणवाचनम् ॥ 5 ॥
4.35.m: Then, on a Sunday, when the planets and stars are strong, / having fed [brāhmaṇas] milk-rice, one should perform the brāhmaṇa-recitation of auspicious blessings.

4.35.s:
śuklavastrāṇi dadyācca sahiraṇyāni śaktitaḥ ..
gāyatrīṃ pūjayedbhaktyā śuklamālyānulepanaiḥ ..
ebhirmaṃtrapadaiḥ paścātpūrvaṃ kṛtvā kṛtāñjaliḥ .. 6 ..
4.35.d:
शुक्लवस्त्राणि दद्याच्च सहिरण्यानि शक्तितः ॥
गायत्रीं पूजयेद्भक्त्या शुक्लमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥
एभिर्मंत्रपदैः पश्चात्पूर्वं कृत्वा कृताञ्जलिः ॥ 6 ॥
4.35.m: And one should give white garments along with gold, according to one's means. / With devotion one should worship Gāyatrī with white garlands and ointments, / having first folded one's hands in reverence, with these mantra words thereafter:

4.35.s:
yathā tu devi bhagavānbrahmā lokapitā mahaḥ..
tvāṃ parityajya no tiṣṭhettathā bhava varapradā .. 7 ..
4.35.d:
यथा तु देवि भगवान्ब्रह्मा लोकपिता महः॥
त्वां परित्यज्य नो तिष्ठेत्तथा भव वरप्रदा ॥ 7 ॥
4.35.m: "Just as the venerable Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, O goddess, / does not abide abandoning you, so become a giver of boons [to me]!

4.35.s:
vedaśāstrāṇi sarvāṇi nṛtyagītādikaṃ ca yat ..
vāhitaṃ yattvayā devi tathā me saṃtu siddhayaḥ .. 8 ..
4.35.d:
वेदशास्त्राणि सर्वाणि नृत्यगीतादिकं च यत् ॥
वाहितं यत्त्वया देवि तथा मे संतु सिद्धयः ॥ 8 ॥
4.35.m: Whatever Vedas and scriptures, and whatever dance, song, and the like, / have been borne forth by you, O goddess, so let these accomplishments be mine!

4.35.s:
lakṣmīrmedhā varāriṣṭirgorī tuṣṭiḥ prabhā matiḥ ..
etābhiḥ pāhi tanubhiraṣṭābhirmāṃ sarasvati .. 9 ..
4.35.d:
लक्ष्मीर्मेधा वरारिष्टिर्गोरी तुष्टिः प्रभा मतिः ॥
एताभिः पाहि तनुभिरष्टाभिर्मां सरस्वति ॥ 9 ॥
4.35.m: Lakṣmī, Medhā, the excellent Ariṣṭi, Gaurī, Tuṣṭi, Prabhā, and Mati— / with these eight bodies, O Sarasvatī, protect me!"

4.35.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjya gāyatrīṃ vīṇākṣamaṇidhāriṇīm ..
śuklapakṣe'kṣatairbhaktyā sakamaṃḍalupustakām .. 4.35.10 ..
4.35.d:
एवं संपूज्य गायत्रीं वीणाक्षमणिधारिणीम् ॥
शुक्लपक्षेऽक्षतैर्भक्त्या सकमंडलुपुस्तकाम् ॥ 4.35.10 ॥
4.35.m: Having thus worshipped Gāyatrī with devotion using unbroken grains during the bright fortnight, / holding a vīṇā and a rosary, together with a water pot and a book,

4.35.s:
maunavratena bhuñjīta sāyaṃ prātaśca dharmavit ..
pañcamyāṃ pratipakṣe ca pūjayitvā suvāsinīḥ .. 11 ..
4.35.d:
मौनव्रतेन भुञ्जीत सायं प्रातश्च धर्मवित् ॥
पञ्चम्यां प्रतिपक्षे च पूजयित्वा सुवासिनीः ॥ 11 ॥
4.35.m: the knower of righteousness should eat in the evening and in the morning under a vow of silence, / having worshipped auspicious married women on the fifth lunar day of each fortnight.

4.35.s:
tilaiśca taṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
kṣīraṃ tathā hiraṇyaṃ ca gāyatrī prīyatāmiti .. 12 ..
4.35.d:
तिलैश्च तंडुलप्रस्थं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥
क्षीरं तथा हिरण्यं च गायत्री प्रीयतामिति ॥ 12 ॥
4.35.m: And [one should offer] a prastha of husked rice along with sesame seeds, accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter, / milk, and gold, saying: "May Gāyatrī be pleased."

4.35.s:
saṃdhyāyāṃ ca tato maunaṃ tadvrata tu samācaret ..
nāṃtarā bhojanaṃ kuryādyāvanmāsāstrayodaśa .. 13 ..
4.35.d:
संध्यायां च ततो मौनं तद्व्रत तु समाचरेत् ॥
नांतरा भोजनं कुर्याद्यावन्मासास्त्रयोदश ॥ 13 ॥
4.35.m: And at twilight one should maintain silence; one should perform that votive observance in this way. / One must not eat in between [meals] for as long as thirteen months.

4.35.s:
samāpte tu vrate dadyādbhojanaṃ śuklataṃḍulaiḥ ..
pūrṇaṃ suvastrayugmaṃ ca gāṃ ca viprāya bhojanam .. 14 ..
4.35.d:
समाप्ते तु व्रते दद्याद्भोजनं शुक्लतंडुलैः ॥
पूर्णं सुवस्त्रयुग्मं च गां च विप्राय भोजनम् ॥ 14 ॥
4.35.m: When the votive observance is completed, one should give a meal of white rice; / [one should give] a pair of fine garments filled [with grains], a cow, and food to a brāhmaṇa.

4.35.s:
devyai vitānaṃ ghaṃṭāṃ ca sitanetraṃ paṭānvitam ..
candanaṃ vastrayugmaṃ ca dadhyannaṃ śikharairyutam .. 15 ..
4.35.d:
देव्यै वितानं घंटां च सितनेत्रं पटान्वितम् ॥
चन्दनं वस्त्रयुग्मं च दध्यन्नं शिखरैर्युतम् ॥ 15 ॥
4.35.m: To the goddess, [one should offer] a canopy, a bell, white silk accompanied by cloth, / sandalwood, a pair of garments, and curd-rice accompanied by condiments.

4.35.s:
tathopadeṣṭāramapi bhaktyā saṃpūjayedgurum ..
vittaśāṭhyena rahito vastramālyānulepanaiḥ .. 16 ..
4.35.d:
तथोपदेष्टारमपि भक्त्या संपूजयेद्गुरुम् ॥
वित्तशाठ्येन रहितो वस्त्रमाल्यानुलेपनैः ॥ 16 ॥
4.35.m: Likewise, one should worship with devotion the teacher who instructed oneself, / free from stinginess regarding wealth, with garments, garlands, and ointments.

4.35.s:
anena vidhinā yastu kuryātsārasvataṃ vratam ..
vidyāvānarthayuktaśca raktakaṃṭhaśca jāyate .. 17 ..
4.35.d:
अनेन विधिना यस्तु कुर्यात्सारस्वतं व्रतम् ॥
विद्यावानर्थयुक्तश्च रक्तकंठश्च जायते ॥ 17 ॥
4.35.m: He who performs the Sārasvata votive observance according to this rule / becomes knowledgeable, endowed with wealth, and sweet-voiced.

4.35.s:
sarasvatyāḥ prasādena vyāsavattu kavirbhavet ..
nārī vā kurute yā tu sāpi tatphalabhāginī ..
brahmaloke vasettāvadyāvatkalpāyutatrayam .. 18 ..
4.35.d:
सरस्वत्याः प्रसादेन व्यासवत्तु कविर्भवेत् ॥
नारी वा कुरुते या तु सापि तत्फलभागिनी ॥
ब्रह्मलोके वसेत्तावद्यावत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् ॥ 18 ॥
4.35.m: By the grace of Sarasvatī he becomes a poet like Vyāsa. / Or whichever woman performs it, she too shares in that fruit; / she dwells in the world of Brahmā as long as thirty thousand kalpas.

4.35.s:
sārasvataṃ vrataṃ yastu śṛṇuyādapi yaḥ paṭhet ..
vidyādharapure so'pi vasetkalpāyutatrayam .. 19 ..
4.35.d:
सारस्वतं व्रतं यस्तु शृणुयादपि यः पठेत् ॥
विद्याधरपुरे सोऽपि वसेत्कल्पायुतत्रयम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.35.m: Whoever hears or reads the Sārasvata votive observance / also dwells in the city of the Vidyādharas for thirty thousand kalpas.

4.35.s:
saṃvatsaraṃ vratavareṇa sarasvatīṃ ye saṃpūjayaṃti jagato jananīṃ janitrīm ..
madhurasvarāste rūpānvitā vahukalākuśalā bhavaṃti ..4.35.20..
nāgapañcamīvratavarṇanam
4.35.d:
संवत्सरं व्रतवरेण सरस्वतीं ये संपूजयंति जगतो जननीं जनित्रीम् ॥
मधुरस्वरास्ते रूपान्विता वहुकलाकुशला भवंति ॥4.35.20॥
नागपञ्चमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.35.m:
Those who for one year worship Sarasvatī, the progenitress and mother of the universe, by this best of votive observances, / become sweet-voiced, endowed with beauty, and skilled in many arts.
Description of the Nāgapañcamī Votive Observance

4.36.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
paṃcamī dayitā rājannāgānaṃdavivarddhanī ..
pañcamyāṃ kila nāgānāṃ bhavatītyutsavo mahān .. 1 ..
4.36.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
पंचमी दयिता राजन्नागानंदविवर्द्धनी ॥
पञ्चम्यां किल नागानां भवतीत्युत्सवो महान् ॥ 1 ॥
4.36.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / The fifth lunar day is beloved, O king, increasing the delight of the snakes. / On the fifth lunar day, indeed, a great festival of the snakes takes place.

4.36.s:
vāsukistakṣakaścaiva kāliko māṇibhadrakaḥ..
dhṛtarāṣṭro raivataśca karkoṭakadhanaṃjayau ..
ete prayacchaṃtyabhayaṃ prāṇināṃ prāṇajīvinām .. 2 ..
4.36.d:
वासुकिस्तक्षकश्चैव कालिको माणिभद्रकः॥
धृतराष्ट्रो रैवतश्च कर्कोटकधनंजयौ ॥
एते प्रयच्छंत्यभयं प्राणिनां प्राणजीविनाम् ॥ 2 ॥
4.36.m: Vāsuki, Takṣaka, Kāliya, Māṇibhadraka, / Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Raivata, Karkoṭaka, and Dhanañjaya— / these grant freedom from fear to living beings who live by breath.

4.36.s:
pañcamyāṃ snapayaṃtīha nāgānkṣī reṇa ye narāḥ ..
teṣāṃ kule prayacchaṃti abhayaṃ prāṇināṃ sadā .. 3 ..
4.36.d:
पञ्चम्यां स्नपयंतीह नागान्क्षी रेण ये नराः ॥
तेषां कुले प्रयच्छंति अभयं प्राणिनां सदा ॥ 3 ॥
4.36.m: Those men who bathe the snakes with milk on the fifth lunar day in this world, / [the snakes] always grant freedom from fear to the living beings in their lineage.

4.36.s:
śaptā nāgā yadā mātrā dahyamānā divāniśam ..
nirvāpitā gavāṃ kṣīraistataḥ prabhṛti vallabhāḥ .. 4 ..
4.36.d:
शप्ता नागा यदा मात्रा दह्यमाना दिवानिशम् ॥
निर्वापिता गवां क्षीरैस्ततः प्रभृति वल्लभाः ॥ 4 ॥
4.36.m: When the snakes were cursed by their mother and burning day and night, / they were cooled by cows' milk; since then, [such offerings] are beloved [to them].

4.36.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
mātrā śaptāḥ kathaṃ nāgāḥ kimuddiśya ca kāraṇam ..
kathaṃ vā tasya śāpasya vināśo' bhūjjanārdana .. 5 ..
4.36.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
मात्रा शप्ताः कथं नागाः किमुद्दिश्य च कारणम् ॥
कथं वा तस्य शापस्य विनाशो' भूज्जनार्दन ॥ 5 ॥
4.36.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / Why were the snakes cursed by their mother, and on account of what cause? / And how did the destruction of that curse come to pass, O Janārdana?

4.36.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
uccaiḥśravāśvarājaśca śvetavarṇo'mṛtodbhavaḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā cābravītkadrūrnāgānāṃ jananī svasām .. .. 6 ..
4.36.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
उच्चैःश्रवाश्वराजश्च श्वेतवर्णोऽमृतोद्भवः ॥
तं दृष्ट्वा चाब्रवीत्कद्रूर्नागानां जननी स्वसाम् ॥ ॥ 6 ॥
4.36.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / Uccaiḥśravas was the king of horses, white-coloured, born from the nectar of immortality. / Having seen him, Kadrū, the mother of the snakes, said to her sister:

4.36.s:
aśvaratnamidaṃ śvetaṃ paśyapaśyāmṛtodbhavam ..
kṛṣṇāṃśca vīkṣyase bālānsarvaśvetānutādya vai .. 7 ..
4.36.d:
अश्वरत्नमिदं श्वेतं पश्यपश्यामृतोद्भवम् ॥
कृष्णांश्च वीक्ष्यसे बालान्सर्वश्वेतानुताद्य वै ॥ 7 ॥
4.36.m: "Look, look at this jewel of a horse, white, born from the nectar of immortality! / And do you perceive its hairs to be black, or completely white, today?"

4.36.s:
.. vinatovāca .. ..
sarvaśveto hayavaro nāyaṃ kṛṣṇo na lohitaḥ ..
kathaṃ tvaṃ vīkṣase kṛṣṇaṃ vinatovāca tāṃ svasām .. 8 ..
4.36.d:
॥ विनतोवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वश्वेतो हयवरो नायं कृष्णो न लोहितः ॥
कथं त्वं वीक्षसे कृष्णं विनतोवाच तां स्वसाम् ॥ 8 ॥
4.36.m: Vinatā said: / "This excellent horse is completely white; it is neither black nor red. / How do you see it as black?" Vinatā said to that sister.

4.36.s:
.. kadrūruvāca .. .
vīkṣe'hamekanayanā kṛṣṇabāla samanvitam ..
dvinetrā ca tvaṃ vinate na paśyasi paṇaṃ kuru .. 9 ..
4.36.d:
॥ कद्रूरुवाच ॥ ।
वीक्षेऽहमेकनयना कृष्णबाल समन्वितम् ॥
द्विनेत्रा च त्वं विनते न पश्यसि पणं कुरु ॥ 9 ॥
4.36.m: Kadrū said: / "Though one-eyed, I see it endowed with black tail-hairs; / and you, having two eyes, Vinatā, do not see it! Make a wager!"

4.36.s:
.. vinatovāca .. ..
ahaṃ dāsī bhavitrī te kṛṣṇakeśe pradarśite ..
na ceddarśayase kadru mama dāsī bhaviṣyasi .. 4.36.10 ..
4.36.d:
॥ विनतोवाच ॥ ॥
अहं दासी भवित्री ते कृष्णकेशे प्रदर्शिते ॥
न चेद्दर्शयसे कद्रु मम दासी भविष्यसि ॥ 4.36.10 ॥
4.36.m: Vinatā said: / "I shall become your slave if a black hair is shown; / if you cannot show it, Kadrū, you shall become my slave."

4.36.s:
evaṃ te vipaṇaṃ kṛtvā gate krodhasamanvite ..
suṣupte prājyadoṣe tu kadrūrjihmamaciṃtayat .. 11 ..
4.36.d:
एवं ते विपणं कृत्वा गते क्रोधसमन्विते ॥
सुषुप्ते प्राज्यदोषे तु कद्रूर्जिह्ममचिंतयत् ॥ 11 ॥
4.36.m: Having thus made a wager, filled with anger, they departed. / While they slept, in the dead of night, Kadrū devised deceit.

4.36.s:
āhūya putrān provāca bālā bhūtvā hayottame ..
tiṣṭhadhvaṃ vipaṇau jeṣye vinatāṃ jayagṛddhinīm .. 12 ..
4.36.d:
आहूय पुत्रान् प्रोवाच बाला भूत्वा हयोत्तमे ॥
तिष्ठध्वं विपणौ जेष्ये विनतां जयगृद्धिनीम् ॥ 12 ॥
4.36.m: Summoning her sons, she said: "Becoming hairs on the excellent horse, / stay there in the wager, and I shall defeat Vinatā, who is greedy for victory!"

4.36.s:
procuste jihmabuddhiṃ tāṃ nāgāḥ kadrūṃ vigṛhya ca ..
adharma eṣa tu mahānkariṣyāmo na te vacaḥ ..
aśapadruṣitā kadrūḥ pāvako vaḥ pradhakṣyati .. 13 ..
4.36.d:
प्रोचुस्ते जिह्मबुद्धिं तां नागाः कद्रूं विगृह्य च ॥
अधर्म एष तु महान्करिष्यामो न ते वचः ॥
अशपद्रुषिता कद्रूः पावको वः प्रधक्ष्यति ॥ 13 ॥
4.36.m: Opposing her, the snakes said to Kadrū of deceitful intent: / "This is a great unrighteousness; we will not obey your word." / Angered, Kadrū cursed them: "Fire shall consume you all!"

4.36.s:
gate bahutithe kāle pāṃḍavo janamejayaḥ ..
sarpasatraṃ sa kartā vai bhūmāvanyaiḥ suduṣkaram ..14..
4.36.d:
गते बहुतिथे काले पांडवो जनमेजयः ॥
सर्पसत्रं स कर्ता वै भूमावन्यैः सुदुष्करम् ॥14॥
4.36.m: "When much time has passed, the Pāṇḍava Janamejaya / will perform a snake sacrifice on earth, most difficult for others to do.

4.36.s:
tasminsatre ca tigmāṃśuḥ pāvako bhakṣayiṣyati ..
evaṃ śaptvā tadā kadrūḥ pratyuvāca na kiṃcana ..15..
4.36.d:
तस्मिन्सत्रे च तिग्मांशुः पावको भक्षयिष्यति ॥
एवं शप्त्वा तदा कद्रूः प्रत्युवाच न किंचन ॥15॥
4.36.m: And in that sacrifice, the blazing-rayed fire will consume [you]." / Having cursed [them] thus, Kadrū then said nothing [further].

4.36.s:
mātrā śaptastadā nāgaḥ kartavyaṃ nānvapadyata ..
vāsukirduḥkhasaṃtaptaḥ papāta bhuvi mūrcchitaḥ .. 16 ..
4.36.d:
मात्रा शप्तस्तदा नागः कर्तव्यं नान्वपद्यत ॥
वासुकिर्दुःखसंतप्तः पपात भुवि मूर्च्छितः ॥ 16 ॥
4.36.m: Cursed then by his mother, the serpent did not follow what was to be done. / Tormented by grief, Vāsuki fell senseless to the ground.

4.36.s:
vāsukiṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā provāca sāṃtvayan..
mā śuco vāsuke'tyarthaṃ śṛṇu madvacanaṃ param.. 17..
4.36.d:
वासुकिं दुःखितं दृष्ट्वा ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच सांत्वयन्॥
मा शुचो वासुकेऽत्यर्थं शृणु मद्वचनं परम्॥ 17॥
4.36.m: Seeing Vāsuki grieved, Brahmā consoled him, saying: / "Do not grieve excessively, O Vāsuki; hear my supreme word.

4.36.s:
yāyāvarakule jāto jaratkāruriti dvijaḥ..
bhaviṣyati mahātejāstasminkāle taponidhiḥ ..18..
4.36.d:
यायावरकुले जातो जरत्कारुरिति द्विजः॥
भविष्यति महातेजास्तस्मिन्काले तपोनिधिः ॥18॥
4.36.m: Born in the Yāyāvara lineage, a brāhmaṇa named Jaratkāru, / possessed of great splendour and a storehouse of asceticism, will arise at that time.

4.36.s:
bhaginīṃ ca jaratkāruṃ tasya tvaṃ pratidāsyasi ..
bhavitā tasya putro'sāvastīka iti viśrutaḥ .. 19 ..
4.36.d:
भगिनीं च जरत्कारुं तस्य त्वं प्रतिदास्यसि ॥
भविता तस्य पुत्रोऽसावस्तीक इति विश्रुतः ॥ 19 ॥
4.36.m: And you shall give [your] sister Jaratkāru to him in marriage. / A son will be born to him, celebrated as Āstīka.

4.36.s:
sa tatsatraṃ pravṛddhaṃ vai nāgānāṃ bhayadaṃ mahat ..
niṣedhayiṣyati munirvāgbhiḥ saṃpūjya pārthivam .. 4.36.20 ..
4.36.d:
स तत्सत्रं प्रवृद्धं वै नागानां भयदं महत् ॥
निषेधयिष्यति मुनिर्वाग्भिः संपूज्य पार्थिवम् ॥ 4.36.20 ॥
4.36.m: That sage will halt that grand, ongoing sacrifice / that brings terror to the serpents, after honouring the king with his words.

4.36.s:
tadiyaṃ bhaginī nāga rūpaudāryaguṇānvitā ..
jaratkārurjaratkāroḥ pradeyā hyavi cārataḥ .. 21 ..
4.36.d:
तदियं भगिनी नाग रूपौदार्यगुणान्विता ॥
जरत्कारुर्जरत्कारोः प्रदेया ह्यवि चारतः ॥ 21 ॥
4.36.m: Therefore, O serpent, this sister Jaratkāru, endowed with beauty, generosity, and virtues, / must indeed be given without hesitation to Jaratkāru.

4.36.s:
yadāsau prārthyate'raṇye yatkiñcitpravadiṣyati ..
tatkartavyamaśeṣeṇa icchecchreyastathātmanaḥ .. 22 ..
4.36.d:
यदासौ प्रार्थ्यतेऽरण्ये यत्किञ्चित्प्रवदिष्यति ॥
तत्कर्तव्यमशेषेण इच्छेच्छ्रेयस्तथात्मनः ॥ 22 ॥
4.36.m: When he is requested in the wilderness, whatever he will declare, / all of that must be done entirely if one desires welfare for oneself."

4.36.s:
pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā vāsukiṃ praṇipatya ca ..
tathākarodyathā coktaṃ yatnaṃ paramamāsthitaḥ .. 23 ..
4.36.d:
पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा वासुकिं प्रणिपत्य च ॥
तथाकरोद्यथा चोक्तं यत्नं परममास्थितः ॥ 23 ॥
4.36.m: Hearing the Grandfather's word, and having bowed to Vāsuki, / he acted just as was told, exerting the utmost effort.

4.36.s:
tacchrutvā pannagāḥ sarve praharṣotphullalocanāḥ ..
punarjātamivātmānaṃ menire bhujagottamāḥ .. 24 ..
4.36.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पन्नगाः सर्वे प्रहर्षोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ॥
पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मेनिरे भुजगोत्तमाः ॥ 24 ॥
4.36.m: Hearing that, all the serpents, their eyes blossoming with immense joy, / those best of snakes, considered themselves as if born anew.

4.36.s:
aplave tu nimagnānāṃ ghore yajñāgnisāgare ..
āstīkastatra bhavitā plavabhūto'bhayapradaḥ .. 25 ..
4.36.d:
अप्लवे तु निमग्नानां घोरे यज्ञाग्निसागरे ॥
आस्तीकस्तत्र भविता प्लवभूतोऽभयप्रदः ॥ 25 ॥
4.36.m: To those submerged without a boat in the dreadful ocean of sacrificial fire, / Āstīka will be there as a boat, granting fearlessness.

4.36.s:
śrutvā sa cāgnirājānamṛtvijastadanaṃtaram ..
nivartayiṣyati yāgaṃ nāgānāṃ mohanaṃ param .. 26 ..
4.36.d:
श्रुत्वा स चाग्निराजानमृत्विजस्तदनंतरम् ॥
निवर्तयिष्यति यागं नागानां मोहनं परम् ॥ 26 ॥
4.36.m: And hearing that, the fire, the king, and subsequently the officiating priests, / will halt the sacrifice that was the utmost delusion of the serpents.

4.36.s:
pañcamyāṃ tacca bhavitā brahmā provāca lelihān ..
tasmādiyaṃ mahārāja pañcamī dayitā śubhā .. 27 ..
4.36.d:
पञ्चम्यां तच्च भविता ब्रह्मा प्रोवाच लेलिहान् ॥
तस्मादियं महाराज पञ्चमी दयिता शुभा ॥ 27 ॥
4.36.m: "And that will occur on the pañcamī," Brahmā told the serpents. / "Therefore, O great king, this auspicious pañcamī is beloved,

4.36.s:
nāgānāṃ harṣajananī dattā vai brahmaṇā purā ..
dattvā tu bhojanaṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kāmataḥ .. 28 ..
4.36.d:
नागानां हर्षजननी दत्ता वै ब्रह्मणा पुरा ॥
दत्त्वा तु भोजनं पूर्वं ब्राह्मणानां तु कामतः ॥ 28 ॥
4.36.m: bringing joy to the serpents, granted indeed by Brahmā of old. / But having first given food to the brāhmaṇas according to desire,

4.36.s:
visṛjya nāgāḥ prīyaṃtāṃ ye kecitpṛthivītale ..
himācale ye vasanti yeṃ'tarikṣe divisthitāḥ ..
ye nadīṣu mahānāgā ye saraḥsvabhigāminaḥ ..29..
4.36.d:
विसृज्य नागाः प्रीयंतां ये केचित्पृथिवीतले ॥
हिमाचले ये वसन्ति येंऽतरिक्षे दिविस्थिताः ॥
ये नदीषु महानागा ये सरःस्वभिगामिनः ॥29॥
4.36.m: having dismissed [them], [saying:] 'May the serpents be pleased, whichever ones are on the surface of the earth, / those who dwell on the Himālaya, those who reside in the atmosphere, in the sky, / those great serpents who are in rivers, those who frequent lakes,

4.36.s: ye vāpīṣu taḍāgeṣu teṣu sarveṣu vai namaḥ ..4.36.30..
4.36.d: ये वापीषु तडागेषु तेषु सर्वेषु वै नमः ॥4.36.30॥
4.36.m: those in stepwells and ponds—to all of them, indeed, homage!'

4.36.s:
nāgānviprāṃśca saṃpūjya visṛjya ca yathārthataḥ ..
tataḥ paścācca bhuñjīyātsaha bhṛtyairnnarādhipa ..31..
4.36.d:
नागान्विप्रांश्च संपूज्य विसृज्य च यथार्थतः ॥
ततः पश्चाच्च भुञ्जीयात्सह भृत्यैर्न्नराधिप ॥31॥
4.36.m: Having worshipped the serpents and the brāhmaṇas and dismissed them according to rule, / thereafter one should eat together with [one's] servants, O lord of men.

4.36.s:
pūrvaṃ madhuramaśnīyātsvecchayā tadanaṃta ram ..
evaṃ niyamayuktasya yatphalaṃ tannibodha me ..32..
4.36.d:
पूर्वं मधुरमश्नीयात्स्वेच्छया तदनंत रम् ॥
एवं नियमयुक्तस्य यत्फलं तन्निबोध मे ॥32॥
4.36.m: One should first eat sweet food, and thereafter according to one's wish. / Hear from me the reward of one who is engaged in such an observance:

4.36.s:
mṛto nāgapuraṃ yāti pūjyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ ..
vimānavaramārūḍho ramate kālamīpsitam ..33..
4.36.d:
मृतो नागपुरं याति पूज्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः ॥
विमानवरमारूढो रमते कालमीप्सितम् ॥33॥
4.36.m: When he dies, he goes to the city of serpents, honoured by hosts of apsarases; / mounted on a supreme celestial chariot, he enjoys himself for the desired time.

4.36.s:
iha cāgatya rājāsau sarvarājavaro bhavet ..
sarvaratnasamṛddhaśca vāhanāḍhyaśca jāyate .. 34 ..
4.36.d:
इह चागत्य राजासौ सर्वराजवरो भवेत् ॥
सर्वरत्नसमृद्धश्च वाहनाढ्यश्च जायते ॥ 34 ॥
4.36.m: And having returned here, he becomes a king, the best among all kings, / and he is born rich in all jewels and wealthy in mounts.

4.36.s:
pañcajanmanyasau rājā dvāparedvāpare bhavet ..
ādhivyādhivinirmuktaḥ patnīputrasahāyavān ..
tasmātpūjyāśca nāgāśca ghṛtakṣīrādinā sadā .. 35 ..
4.36.d:
पञ्चजन्मन्यसौ राजा द्वापरेद्वापरे भवेत् ॥
आधिव्याधिविनिर्मुक्तः पत्नीपुत्रसहायवान् ॥
तस्मात्पूज्याश्च नागाश्च घृतक्षीरादिना सदा ॥ 35 ॥
4.36.m: For five births, in every Dvāpara [age], he will be a king, / freed from mental anguish and disease, accompanied by wife and sons. / Therefore the serpents must always be worshipped with ghee, milk, and the like."

4.36.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
daśaṃti yaṃ naraṃ kṛṣṇa nāgāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ ..
bhavetkiṃ tasya daṣṭasya vistarādbrūhi māṃ hare .. 36 ..
4.36.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
दशंति यं नरं कृष्ण नागाः क्रोधसमन्विताः ॥
भवेत्किं तस्य दष्टस्य विस्तराद्ब्रूहि मां हरे ॥ 36 ॥
4.36.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "O Kṛṣṇa, whichsoever man the serpents bite when filled with wrath, / what becomes of that bitten [man]? Tell me in detail, O Hari."

4.36.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
nāgadaṣṭo naro rājanprāpya mṛtyuṃ vrajatyadhaḥ ..
adho gatvā bhavetsarpo nirviṣo nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 37 ..
4.36.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
नागदष्टो नरो राजन्प्राप्य मृत्युं व्रजत्यधः ॥
अधो गत्वा भवेत्सर्पो निर्विषो नात्र संशयः ॥ 37 ॥
4.36.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "A man bitten by a serpent, meeting death, goes downward, O king. / Having gone downward, he becomes a venomless snake; there is no doubt in this."

4.36.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
nāgadaṣṭaḥ pitā yasya bhrātā mātā suhṛtsutaḥ ..
svasā vā duhitā bhāryā kiṃ kartavyaṃ vadasva me .. 38 ..
4.36.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
नागदष्टः पिता यस्य भ्राता माता सुहृत्सुतः ॥
स्वसा वा दुहिता भार्या किं कर्तव्यं वदस्व मे ॥ 38 ॥
4.36.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "He whose father, brother, mother, friend, son, / sister, daughter, or wife has been bitten by a serpent—tell me what is to be done.

4.36.s:
mokṣāya tasya govinda dānaṃ vratamupoṣitam ..
brūhi me yaduśārdūla yena svargatimāpnuyāt.. .. 39 ..
4.36.d:
मोक्षाय तस्य गोविन्द दानं व्रतमुपोषितम् ॥
ब्रूहि मे यदुशार्दूल येन स्वर्गतिमाप्नुयात्॥ ॥ 39 ॥
4.36.m: For his liberation, O Govinda, tell me of a gift, a votive observance, or a fast, / O tiger of the Yadus, by which he may attain heaven."

4.36.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
upoṣyā pañcamī rājannāgānāṃ puṣṭivarddhinī ..
varṣamekaṃ tu rājendra vidhānaṃ śṛṇu yādṛśam .. 4.36.40 ..
4.36.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
उपोष्या पञ्चमी राजन्नागानां पुष्टिवर्द्धिनी ॥
वर्षमेकं तु राजेन्द्र विधानं शृणु यादृशम् ॥ 4.36.40 ॥
4.36.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "A pañcamī should be fasted on, O king, which increases the nourishment of the serpents, / for one year, O lord of kings; hear the manner of the procedure.

4.36.s:
māse bhādrapade yā tu śuklapakṣe mahīpate ..
sā ca puṇyatamā proktā grāhyā sadgatikāmyayā .. 41 ..
4.36.d:
मासे भाद्रपदे या तु शुक्लपक्षे महीपते ॥
सा च पुण्यतमा प्रोक्ता ग्राह्या सद्गतिकाम्यया ॥ 41 ॥
4.36.m: The one in the month of Bhādrapada, in the bright fortnight, O protector of the earth, / is declared to be most meritorious; it should be undertaken with the desire for a good realm.

4.36.s:
jñeyā dvādaśa varṣāṃte pañcamyo bharatarṣabha ..
caturthyāmekabhaktaṃ tu tasyāṃ naktaṃ prakīrtitam .. 42 ..
4.36.d:
ज्ञेया द्वादश वर्षांते पञ्चम्यो भरतर्षभ ॥
चतुर्थ्यामेकभक्तं तु तस्यां नक्तं प्रकीर्तितम् ॥ 42 ॥
4.36.m: Twelve pañcamīs are to be observed at the end of the year, O bull of the Bharatas. / On the caturthī, a single meal [is prescribed], and on that [pañcamī], a nocturnal meal is proclaimed.

4.36.s:
bhūricandramayaṃ nāgamathavā kaladhautajam ..
kṛtvā dārumayaṃ cāpi utāho mṛnmayaṃ nṛpa .. 43 ..
4.36.d:
भूरिचन्द्रमयं नागमथवा कलधौतजम् ॥
कृत्वा दारुमयं चापि उताहो मृन्मयं नृप ॥ 43 ॥
4.36.m: Having fashioned a serpent made of abundant silver, or born of gold, / or made of wood, or indeed of clay, O king,

4.36.s:
pañcamyāmarcayedbhaktyā nāgaṃ pañcaphaṇaṃ śṛṇu ..
karavīraistathā padmairjātīpuṣpaiḥ suśobhanaiḥ .. 44 ..
4.36.d:
पञ्चम्यामर्चयेद्भक्त्या नागं पञ्चफणं शृणु ॥
करवीरैस्तथा पद्मैर्जातीपुष्पैः सुशोभनैः ॥ 44 ॥
4.36.m: one should worship with devotion on the pañcamī a five-hooded serpent—hear [with what]: / with oleanders, as well as lotuses, and exceedingly beautiful jasmine flowers.

4.36.s:
gandhapuṣpaiḥ sanaivedyaiḥ pūjya pannagasattamam ..
brāhmaṇānbhojayetpaścād ghṛtapāyasamodakaiḥ .. 45 ..
4.36.d:
गन्धपुष्पैः सनैवेद्यैः पूज्य पन्नगसत्तमम् ॥
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्पश्चाद् घृतपायसमोदकैः ॥ 45 ॥
4.36.m: Having worshipped the best of serpents with fragrant flowers and with food offerings, / one should afterwards feed the brāhmaṇas with ghee, milk-rice, and sweetmeats.

4.36.s:
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryaḥ sarpadaṣṭasya dehinaḥ ..
dāne piṃḍapradāne ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpayet .. 46 ..
4.36.d:
नारायणबलिः कार्यः सर्पदष्टस्य देहिनः ॥
दाने पिंडप्रदाने च ब्राह्मणानां च तर्पयेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.36.m: A Nārāyaṇa-bali should be performed for an embodied soul bitten by a snake; / with gifts and the offering of piṇḍas, one should also gratify the brāhmaṇas.

4.36.s:
vṛṣotsargastu kartavyo gate saṃvatsare nṛpa ..
snānaṃ kṛtvodakaṃ dadyātkṛṣṇo'tra prīyatāmiti .. 47 ..
4.36.d:
वृषोत्सर्गस्तु कर्तव्यो गते संवत्सरे नृप ॥
स्नानं कृत्वोदकं दद्यात्कृष्णोऽत्र प्रीयतामिति ॥ 47 ॥
4.36.m: A setting-free of a bull is to be performed when a full year has passed, O king. / Having bathed, one should offer water, saying: 'May Kṛṣṇa be pleased here.'

4.36.s:
anaṃto vāsukiḥ śeṣaḥ padmaḥ kambala eva ca ..
tathā takṣaka nāgaśca nāgaścāśvataro nṛpa .. 48
4.36.d:
अनंतो वासुकिः शेषः पद्मः कम्बल एव च ॥
तथा तक्षक नागश्च नागश्चाश्वतरो नृप ॥ 48
4.36.m: Ananta, Vāsuki, Śeṣa, Padma, and Kambala, / and likewise the serpent Takṣaka, and the serpent Aśvatara, O king,

4.36.s:
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ śaṃkhapālaḥ kāliyastakṣakastathā ..
piṃgalaśca mahānāgo māsimāsi prakīrtitāḥ ..
vatsarāṃte pāraṇaṃ syānmahābrāhmaṇabhojanam .. 49 ..
4.36.d:
धृतराष्ट्रः शंखपालः कालियस्तक्षकस्तथा ॥
पिंगलश्च महानागो मासिमासि प्रकीर्तिताः ॥
वत्सरांते पारणं स्यान्महाब्राह्मणभोजनम् ॥ 49 ॥
4.36.m: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Śaṅkhapāla, Kāliya, and Takṣaka, / and Piṅgala, the great serpent, are proclaimed month by month. / At the end of the year, there should be the breaking of the fast with the feeding of great brāhmaṇas.

4.36.s:
itihāsavide nāgaḥ kāṃcanena kṛto nṛpa ..
tathārjunī pradātavyā savatsā kāṃsyadohanā .. 4.36.50 ..
4.36.d:
इतिहासविदे नागः कांचनेन कृतो नृप ॥
तथार्जुनी प्रदातव्या सवत्सा कांस्यदोहना ॥ 4.36.50 ॥
4.36.m: A serpent made of gold should be given to one who knows the traditional lore, O king, / as well as a red cow along with her calf, and a bronze milking vessel.

4.36.s:
eṣa pāraṇake pārtha vidhiḥ prokto vicakṣaṇaiḥ ..
kṛte vratavare tasminsadgatiṃ yāṃti bāndhavāḥ .. 51 ..
4.36.d:
एष पारणके पार्थ विधिः प्रोक्तो विचक्षणैः ॥
कृते व्रतवरे तस्मिन्सद्गतिं यांति बान्धवाः ॥ 51 ॥
4.36.m: This procedure for the breaking of the fast, O son of Pṛthā, has been declared by the wise. / When that best of votive observances has been performed, [one's] relatives go to a good realm.

4.36.s:
ye dandaśūkaradanairdaṣṭāḥ prāptā hyadhogatim ..
varṣamekaṃ cari ṣyaṃti bhaktyā ye vratamuttamam ..
dāṃṣṭrikaṃ mokṣyate teṣāṃ śubhaṃ sthānamavāpsyati .. 52 ..
4.36.d:
ये दन्दशूकरदनैर्दष्टाः प्राप्ता ह्यधोगतिम् ॥
वर्षमेकं चरि ष्यंति भक्त्या ये व्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
दांष्ट्रिकं मोक्ष्यते तेषां शुभं स्थानमवाप्स्यति ॥ 52 ॥
4.36.m: Those who, bitten by the teeth of snakes, have indeed reached a downward realm, / for them, if [relatives] perform this best of votive observances with devotion for one year, / the state caused by fangs will be released, and they will attain an auspicious place.

4.36.s:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedbhaktyā samanvitaḥ ..
na vai kuṭumbe nāgebhyo bhayaṃ bhavati kutracit .. 53 ..
4.36.d:
यश्चेदं शृणुयान्नित्यं पठेद्भक्त्या समन्वितः ॥
न वै कुटुम्बे नागेभ्यो भयं भवति कुत्रचित् ॥ 53 ॥
4.36.m: And whoever hears this constantly, or recites it filled with devotion, / there is indeed never any fear from serpents in their family."

4.36.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
tadvadbhādrapade māsi pañcamyāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
yastvālikhya naro nāgānkṛ ṣṇavarṇādivarṇakaiḥ ..
pūjayedgandhapuṣpaistu sarpirgguggulupāyasaiḥ .. 54 ..
4.36.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
तद्वद्भाद्रपदे मासि पञ्चम्यां श्रद्धयान्वितः ॥
यस्त्वालिख्य नरो नागान्कृ ष्णवर्णादिवर्णकैः ॥
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पैस्तु सर्पिर्ग्गुग्गुलुपायसैः ॥ 54 ॥
4.36.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / "Likewise, in the month of Bhādrapada, on the pañcamī, endowed with faith, / that man who draws serpents with black and other pigments / and worships them with fragrant flowers, ghee, bdellium, and milk-rice...

4.36.s:
tasya tuṣṭiṃ samāyāṃti pannagāstakṣakādayaḥ ..
āsaptamātkulāttasya na bhayaṃ nāgato bhavet .. 55 ..
4.36.d:
तस्य तुष्टिं समायांति पन्नगास्तक्षकादयः ॥
आसप्तमात्कुलात्तस्य न भयं नागतो भवेत् ॥ 55 ॥
4.36.m:
Takṣaka and the other serpents become pleased with him;
no fear of snakes shall arise for him unto the seventh generation.

4.36.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena nāgānsaṃpūjayedbudhaḥ ..
tathā cāśvayuje māsi pañcamyāṃ kurunaṃdana .. 56 ..
4.36.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन नागान्संपूजयेद्बुधः ॥
तथा चाश्वयुजे मासि पञ्चम्यां कुरुनंदन ॥ 56 ॥
4.36.m:
Therefore, a wise person should worship the serpents with every effort.
Likewise, O son of Kuru, on the fifth [tithi] in the month of Āśvina,

4.36.s:
kṛtvā kuśamayānnāgāniṃdrāṇyā saha pūjayet ..
ghṛtodakābhyāṃ payasā snapayitvā viśāṃpate .. 57 ..
4.36.d:
कृत्वा कुशमयान्नागानिंद्राण्या सह पूजयेत् ॥
घृतोदकाभ्यां पयसा स्नपयित्वा विशांपते ॥ 57 ॥
4.36.m:
having fashioned serpents out of kuśa grass, one should worship them together with Indrāṇī,
having bathed them in clarified butter, water, and milk, O lord of the people,

4.36.s:
godhūmaiḥ payasā svinnairbhakṣyaiśca vividhaistathā ..
yastvasyāṃ vividhānnāgāñchucirbhaktyā samanvitaḥ .. 58 ..
4.36.d:
गोधूमैः पयसा स्विन्नैर्भक्ष्यैश्च विविधैस्तथा ॥
यस्त्वस्यां विविधान्नागाञ्छुचिर्भक्त्या समन्वितः ॥ 58 ॥
4.36.m:
with wheat steamed in milk, and likewise with diverse eatables.
One who, purified and full of devotion, on this [day] [worships] the various serpents,

4.36.s:
pūjayetkuruśārdūla tasya śeṣādayo nṛpa ..
nāgāḥ prītā bhavantīha śāṃtiṃ prāpnoti śobhanām ..
sa śāṃtilokamāsādya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .. 59 ..
4.36.d:
पूजयेत्कुरुशार्दूल तस्य शेषादयो नृप ॥
नागाः प्रीता भवन्तीह शांतिं प्राप्नोति शोभनाम् ॥
स शांतिलोकमासाद्य मोदते शाश्वतीः समाः ॥ 59 ॥
4.36.m: worships them, O tiger of the Kurus, O king, with him Śeṣa and the other / serpents are pleased in this world, and he obtains splendid peace; / reaching the world of peace, he rejoices for eternal years.

4.36.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ vīra pañcamīvratamuttamam ..
tatrāyamucyate maṃtraḥ sarvadoṣaniṣedhakaḥ .. 4.36.60 ..
4.36.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं वीर पञ्चमीव्रतमुत्तमम् ॥
तत्रायमुच्यते मंत्रः सर्वदोषनिषेधकः ॥ 4.36.60 ॥
4.36.m:
Thus this supreme votive observance of the fifth [tithi] has been declared, O hero.
In that regard, this mantra which averts all defects is uttered:

4.36.s:
( oṃ kurukulle huṃ phaṭsvāhā )
bhaktena bhaktisahitāḥ śatapañcamīṣu ye pūjayaṃti bhujagānkusumopahāraiḥ..
teṣāṃ gṛheṣvabhayadā hi sadaiva sarpāḥ śaśvatpramodaparamā rucayo bhavaṃti .. 61 ..
śrīpañcamīvratavarṇanam
4.36.d:
( ओं कुरुकुल्ले हुं फट्स्वाहा )
भक्तेन भक्तिसहिताः शतपञ्चमीषु ये पूजयंति भुजगान्कुसुमोपहारैः॥
तेषां गृहेष्वभयदा हि सदैव सर्पाः शश्वत्प्रमोदपरमा रुचयो भवंति ॥ 61 ॥
श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.36.m:
“Oṃ kurukulle huṃ phaṭ svāhā.”
Those who with devotion offer worship with offerings of flowers to serpents accompanied by devotion on a hundred fifth [tithis],
for them serpents are verily ever the givers of fearlessness in their homes, and they become splendours of supreme and perpetual joy.
Description of the Śrīpañcamī Votive Observance

4.37.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathamāsādyate lakṣmīrdurllabhā bhuvanatraye ..
dānena tapasā vāpi vratena niyamena vā .. 1 ..
4.37.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कथमासाद्यते लक्ष्मीर्दुर्ल्लभा भुवनत्रये ॥
दानेन तपसा वापि व्रतेन नियमेन वा ॥ 1 ॥
4.37.m:
Yudhiṣṭhira said:
How is Lakṣmī, who is hard to obtain in the three worlds, acquired—
by gift, or by asceticism, or by votive observance, or by restriction,

4.37.s:
japahomanamaskāraiḥ saṃskārairvā pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
etadvada yaduśreṣṭha sarvavittvaṃ mato mama .. 2 ..
4.37.d:
जपहोमनमस्कारैः संस्कारैर्वा पृथग्विधैः ॥
एतद्वद यदुश्रेष्ठ सर्ववित्त्वं मतो मम ॥ 2 ॥
4.37.m:
by recitation of mantras, offerings into the fire, prostrations, or various consecrations?
Tell this, O best of the Yadus; you are considered by me omniscient.

4.37.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā pūrvaṃ śrīḥ śrūyate śubhā ..
vāsudevāya sā dattā muninā mānavṛddhaye .. 3 ..
4.37.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
भृगोः ख्यात्यां समुत्पन्ना पूर्वं श्रीः श्रूयते शुभा ॥
वासुदेवाय सा दत्ता मुनिना मानवृद्धये ॥ 3 ॥

4.37.s:
vāsudevo'pi tāṃ prāpya pīnonnatapayodharām ..
padmapatraviśālākṣīṃ pūrṇacandranibhāna nām .. 4 ..
4.37.d:
वासुदेवोऽपि तां प्राप्य पीनोन्नतपयोधराम् ॥
पद्मपत्रविशालाक्षीं पूर्णचन्द्रनिभान नाम् ॥ 4 ॥
4.37.m:
Vāsudeva too, having obtained her whose breasts were plump and high,
whose wide eyes were like lotus petals, whose face resembled the full moon,

4.37.s:
bhābhāsitadigābhogāṃ sākṣādbhānoḥ prabhāmiva ..
nitaṃbāḍaṃbaravatīṃ mattamātaṃgagāminīm ..
reme saha tayā rājanbibhramodbhrāṃtacittayā .. 5 ..
4.37.d:
भाभासितदिगाभोगां साक्षाद्भानोः प्रभामिव ॥
नितंबाडंबरवतीं मत्तमातंगगामिनीम् ॥
रेमे सह तया राजन्बिभ्रमोद्भ्रांतचित्तया ॥ 5 ॥
4.37.m:
who illuminated the expanse of the directions with her radiance, like the visible splendour of the sun,
possessed of majestic hips, striding like an elephant in rut—
he sported with her, O king, whose heart was stirred by graceful play.

4.37.s:
sā ca viṣṇuṃ jagajjiṣṇuṃ patiṃ trijagatāṃ patim ..
prāpya kṛtārthamātmānaṃ mene mānayaśodhanā .. 6 ..
4.37.d:
सा च विष्णुं जगज्जिष्णुं पतिं त्रिजगतां पतिम् ॥
प्राप्य कृतार्थमात्मानं मेने मानयशोधना ॥ 6 ॥
4.37.m:
And she, whose wealth was pride and renown, having obtained Viṣṇu,
the conqueror of the world, her husband and lord of the three worlds, thought herself fulfilled.

4.37.s:
hṛṣṭaṃ puṣṭaṃ jagatsarvamabhavadbhā vitaṃ tayā ..
lakṣmyā nirīkṣitaṃ caiva sānaṃdaṃ hi mahītalam .. 7 ..
4.37.d:
हृष्टं पुष्टं जगत्सर्वमभवद्भा वितं तया ॥
लक्ष्म्या निरीक्षितं चैव सानंदं हि महीतलम् ॥ 7 ॥
4.37.m:
The entire world became joyful and prosperous, animated by her,
and the surface of the earth was indeed full of bliss, looked upon by Lakṣmī.

4.37.s:
kṣemaṃ subhikṣamārogyamanākrandamanākulam ..
jagadāsīdanudbhrāntaṃ praśāṃtopadravaṃ tathā .. 8 ..
4.37.d:
क्षेमं सुभिक्षमारोग्यमनाक्रन्दमनाकुलम् ॥
जगदासीदनुद्भ्रान्तं प्रशांतोपद्रवं तथा ॥ 8 ॥
4.37.m:
Safety, abundance, health, freedom from lamentation, freedom from distress—
the world was unagitated and its calamities quelled.

4.37.s:
divi devā mumudire dānavā daityamāgatāḥ ..
visphāritaphaṇābhogā nāgāścaiva rasātale .. 9 ..
4.37.d:
दिवि देवा मुमुदिरे दानवा दैत्यमागताः ॥
विस्फारितफणाभोगा नागाश्चैव रसातले ॥ 9 ॥
4.37.m:
In heaven the gods rejoiced, and the Dānavas who had come among the Daityas;
and in the netherworld, the serpents whose hoods expanded widely.

4.37.s:
hṛdaye brāhmaṇairvahnau bhujyate tridivairhaviḥ ..
cāturvarṇyamasaṃkīrṇaṃ pālyate pārtha pārthivaiḥ ..4.37.1 0..
4.37.d:
हृदये ब्राह्मणैर्वह्नौ भुज्यते त्रिदिवैर्हविः ॥
चातुर्वर्ण्यमसंकीर्णं पाल्यते पार्थ पार्थिवैः ॥4.37.1 0॥
4.37.m:
The oblation is consumed in the heart by Brahmins and in the sacrificial fire by the denizens of heaven;
the four social classes, unmixed, are protected by kings, O son of Pṛthā.

4.37.s:
virocanaprabhṛtibhirdṛṣṭvaivaṃ daityasattamaiḥ ..
tapastaptumathārabdhamagnimāśritya saṃyataiḥ .. .. 11 ..
4.37.d:
विरोचनप्रभृतिभिर्दृष्ट्वैवं दैत्यसत्तमैः ॥
तपस्तप्तुमथारब्धमग्निमाश्रित्य संयतैः ॥ ॥ 11 ॥
4.37.m:
Having seen this, the best of the Daityas, led by Virocana,
then, self-controlled, began to perform asceticism, having recourse to the fire.

4.37.s:
somasaṃsthāhaviḥsaṃsthāpākasaṃkhyādibhirmakhaiḥ ..
sadācāraiḥ samārabdhamiṣṭaṃ sveṣṭābhilāṣibhiḥ .. 12 ..
4.37.d:
सोमसंस्थाहविःसंस्थापाकसंख्यादिभिर्मखैः ॥
सदाचारैः समारब्धमिष्टं स्वेष्टाभिलाषिभिः ॥ 12 ॥
4.37.m:
With sacrifices such as the Soma rites, oblation rites, and domestic offerings,
conducted with good conduct, they began that which was desired, aspiring for their own wishes.

4.37.s:
evaṃ dharmapradhānaistairvedavādaratātmabhi..
jagadāsītsamākrāṃtaṃ vikrameṇa krameṇa tu ..13..
4.37.d:
एवं धर्मप्रधानैस्तैर्वेदवादरतात्मभि॥
जगदासीत्समाक्रांतं विक्रमेण क्रमेण तु ॥13॥
4.37.m:
Thus by them, whose foremost principle was dharma, whose souls were devoted to the teachings of the Vedas,
the world was conquered by their valour by degrees.

4.37.s:
lakṣmīvilāsaprabhavo devānāmabhavanmadaḥ ..
madācchīlaṃ ca śaucaṃ ca satyaṃ sadyo vyanīnaśan .. .. 14 ..
4.37.d:
लक्ष्मीविलासप्रभवो देवानामभवन्मदः ॥
मदाच्छीलं च शौचं च सत्यं सद्यो व्यनीनशन् ॥ ॥ 14 ॥
4.37.m:
Arising from the delights of Lakṣmī, arrogance arose among the gods;
from arrogance, they immediately destroyed their good character, purity, and truth.

4.37.s:
satyaśaucavihīnāṃstāndevānsaṃtyajya cañcalān ..
jagāma dānavakulaṃ kuladevānurāgataḥ ..15..
4.37.d:
सत्यशौचविहीनांस्तान्देवान्संत्यज्य चञ्चलान् ॥
जगाम दानवकुलं कुलदेवानुरागतः ॥15॥
4.37.m:
Abandoning those gods who were devoid of truth and purity and unsteady,
she went to the race of the Dānavas out of affection for the gods of her race.

4.37.s:
lakṣmyā bhāvitadehaistaiḥ punaruddhatamānasaiḥ..
vyavahartuṃ samārabdhamanyāyena madoddhataiḥ .. 16 ..
4.37.d:
लक्ष्म्या भावितदेहैस्तैः पुनरुद्धतमानसैः॥
व्यवहर्तुं समारब्धमन्यायेन मदोद्धतैः ॥ 16 ॥
4.37.m:
With their bodies animated by Lakṣmī, again their minds becoming haughty,
puffed up with pride, they began to conduct themselves unlawfully:

4.37.s:
vayaṃ vedā vayaṃ yajñā vayaṃ vidyā vaya jagat ..
brahmaviṣṇuśaṃkarādyā vayaṃ sarve divaukasaḥ .. 17 ..
4.37.d:
वयं वेदा वयं यज्ञा वयं विद्या वय जगत् ॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुशंकराद्या वयं सर्वे दिवौकसः ॥ 17 ॥
4.37.m:
“We are the Vedas! We are the sacrifices! We are knowledge! We are the world!
Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śaṅkara, and the others—we are all the celestial beings!”

4.37.s:
ahaṃkāravimūḍhāṃstāñjñātvā dānavasattamān ..
sāgaraṃ sā viveśātha bhrāṃtacittā bhṛgoḥ sutā .. 18 ..
4.37.d:
अहंकारविमूढांस्ताञ्ज्ञात्वा दानवसत्तमान् ॥
सागरं सा विवेशाथ भ्रांतचित्ता भृगोः सुता ॥ 18 ॥
4.37.m:
Knowing those best of the Dānavas to be deluded by egotism,
then she, the daughter of Bhṛgu, her mind bewildered, entered the ocean.

4.37.s:
kṣīrābdhimadhyagatayā lakṣmyā kṣīṇārthasaṃcayam ..
nirānandagataśrīkamabhavadbhuvanatrayam .. 19 ..
4.37.d:
क्षीराब्धिमध्यगतया लक्ष्म्या क्षीणार्थसंचयम् ॥
निरानन्दगतश्रीकमभवद्भुवनत्रयम् ॥ 19 ॥
4.37.m:
When Lakṣmī had gone into the midst of the milk ocean, the store of wealth diminished;
the three worlds became devoid of joy and stripped of splendour.

4.37.s:
gataśrīkamathātmānaṃ matvā śaṃbarasūdanaḥ ..
papacchāṃgirasaṃ vipraṃ brūhi kiñcidvrataṃ mama .. 4.37.20 ..
4.37.d:
गतश्रीकमथात्मानं मत्वा शंबरसूदनः ॥
पपच्छांगिरसं विप्रं ब्रूहि किञ्चिद्व्रतं मम ॥ 4.37.20 ॥
4.37.m:
Then, considering himself stripped of splendour, the slayer of Śambara
asked the Brahmin descended from Aṅgiras: “Tell me some votive observance,

4.37.s:
yena saṃprāpyate lakṣmīrlabdhā na calate punaḥ ..
