niścalāpi suhṛnmitrairbhogyā bhavati sā mune .. 21 ..
4.37.d:
येन संप्राप्यते लक्ष्मीर्लब्धा न चलते पुनः ॥
निश्चलापि सुहृन्मित्रैर्भोग्या भवति सा मुने ॥ 21 ॥
4.37.m:
by which Lakṣmī is obtained, and, once obtained, does not depart again;
and even when immovable, she can be enjoyed by companions and friends, O sage.

4.37.s:
na sā śrītyabhimantavyā kanyā sā pālyate gṛhe ..
parārthaṃ yā suhṛnmitrabhṛtyairnaivopabhujyate .. 22 ..
4.37.d:
न सा श्रीत्यभिमन्तव्या कन्या सा पाल्यते गृहे ॥
परार्थं या सुहृन्मित्रभृत्यैर्नैवोपभुज्यते ॥ 22 ॥
4.37.m:
That which is not enjoyed by companions, friends, and servants for another’s benefit
is not to be regarded as fortune; she is [merely] a maiden guarded in the home.”

4.37.s:
śakrasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ..
kathayāmāsa saṃciṃtya śubhaṃ śrīpañcamīvratam .. 23 ..
4.37.d:
शक्रस्यैतद्वचः श्रुत्वा बृहस्पतिरुदारधीः ॥
कथयामास संचिंत्य शुभं श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतम् ॥ 23 ॥
4.37.m:
Hearing this speech of Śakra, Bṛhaspati of noble intellect,
having reflected, declared the auspicious Śrīpañcamī votive observance.

4.37.s:
yatpurā kasyacitproktaṃ vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ..
tadasmai kathayāmāsa sarahasyamaśeṣataḥ .. 24 ..
4.37.d:
यत्पुरा कस्यचित्प्रोक्तं व्रतानामुत्तमं व्रतम् ॥
तदस्मै कथयामास सरहस्यमशेषतः ॥ 24 ॥
4.37.m:
That which was anciently proclaimed to someone, the supreme votive observance among votive observances,
that he proclaimed to him together with its secret, completely without omission.

4.37.s:
tacchrutvā kartumārabdhaṃ sureśena suraistathā ..
daityadānavagaṃdharvairyakṣaiḥ prakṣīṇakalmaṣaiḥ .. 25 ..
4.37.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा कर्तुमारब्धं सुरेशेन सुरैस्तथा ॥
दैत्यदानवगंधर्वैर्यक्षैः प्रक्षीणकल्मषैः ॥ 25 ॥
4.37.m:
Hearing that, the lord of the gods and the gods began to perform it,
as did the Daityas, Dānavas, Gandharvas, and Yakṣas, whose sins were destroyed,

4.37.s:
siddhaiḥ prasiddhacaritairviṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
brāhmaṇairbrahmatattvajñaiḥ samarthaiḥ pārthivaiḥ saha .. 26 ..
4.37.d:
सिद्धैः प्रसिद्धचरितैर्विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ॥
ब्राह्मणैर्ब्रह्मतत्त्वज्ञैः समर्थैः पार्थिवैः सह ॥ 26 ॥
4.37.m:
along with the Siddhas of renowned deeds, Viṣṇu the supreme lord,
Brahmins who know the truth of Brahman, and capable kings.

4.37.s:
kaiścitsāttvikabhāvena rājasenāparairapi ..
tāmasena tathā kaiścitkṛtaṃ vratamidaṃ tathā .. 27 ..
4.37.d:
कैश्चित्सात्त्विकभावेन राजसेनापरैरपि ॥
तामसेन तथा कैश्चित्कृतं व्रतमिदं तथा ॥ 27 ॥
4.37.m:
By some with a pure disposition, by others with an active disposition,
and likewise by some with a dark disposition, this votive observance was performed in that manner.

4.37.s:
vrate samāpte bhūyiṣṭhe niṣṭhayā parayā prabho ..
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yuddhamāsīdathoddhatam .. 28 ..
4.37.d:
व्रते समाप्ते भूयिष्ठे निष्ठया परया प्रभो ॥
देवानां दानवानां च युद्धमासीदथोद्धतम् ॥ 28 ॥
4.37.m:
When the votive observance was almost completed with supreme fidelity, O lord,
there arose a fierce battle between the gods and the Dānavas.

4.37.s:
nirmathya bhujavīryeṇa sāgaraṃ saritāṃ patim..
samāharāmo hyamṛtaṃ hitāya tridivaukasām .. 29 ..
4.37.d:
निर्मथ्य भुजवीर्येण सागरं सरितां पतिम्॥
समाहरामो ह्यमृतं हिताय त्रिदिवौकसाम् ॥ 29 ॥
4.37.m:
“Having churned the ocean, the lord of rivers, with the strength of our arms,
we shall bring forth the nectar of immortality for the benefit of the heaven-dwellers.”

4.37.s:
ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā mamaṃthurvaruṇālayam ..
maṃthānaṃ maṃdaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu vāsukim .. 4.37.30 ..
4.37.d:
इत्येवं समयं कृत्वा ममंथुर्वरुणालयम् ॥
मंथानं मंदरं कृत्वा नेत्रं कृत्वा तु वासुकिम् ॥ 4.37.30 ॥
4.37.m:
Having made an agreement thus, they churned the abode of Varuṇa,
making Mandara the churning stick, and making Vāsuki the churning rope.

4.37.s:
mathyamānajalājjātaścandraḥ śītāṃśurujjvalaḥ ..
anaṃtaraṃ samutpannā lakṣmīḥ kṣīrābdhimadhyataḥ .. 31 ..
4.37.d:
मथ्यमानजलाज्जातश्चन्द्रः शीतांशुरुज्ज्वलः ॥
अनंतरं समुत्पन्ना लक्ष्मीः क्षीराब्धिमध्यतः ॥ 31 ॥
4.37.m:
From the waters being churned was born the bright, cool-rayed moon;
immediately thereafter, Lakṣmī arose from the midst of the milk ocean.

4.37.s:
tayā vilokitāḥ sarve daityadānavasattamāḥ ..
ālokya sā jagāmāśu viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalaṃ śubham .. 32 ..
4.37.d:
तया विलोकिताः सर्वे दैत्यदानवसत्तमाः ॥
आलोक्य सा जगामाशु विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थलं शुभम् ॥ 32 ॥
4.37.m:
All the best of the Daityas and Dānavas were looked upon by her;
having looked, she went swiftly to the auspicious chest of Viṣṇu.

4.37.s:
vidhinā viṣṇunā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tenābdhisaṃbhavā ..
śarīrasthā babhūvāsya vibhramodbhrāṃtalocanā .. 33 ..
4.37.d:
विधिना विष्णुना चीर्णं व्रतं तेनाब्धिसंभवा ॥
शरीरस्था बभूवास्य विभ्रमोद्भ्रांतलोचना ॥ 33 ॥
4.37.m:
The votive observance had been performed by Viṣṇu according to rule; therefore, born of the ocean,
her eyes rolling with coquetry, she took her place upon his body.

4.37.s:
kiṃ ca rājasabhāvena śakreṇaitatkṛtaṃ yataḥ ..
tatastribhuvanaiśvaryaṃ prāptaṃ tena maharddhikam .. 34 ..
4.37.d:
किं च राजसभावेन शक्रेणैतत्कृतं यतः ॥
ततस्त्रिभुवनैश्वर्यं प्राप्तं तेन महर्द्धिकम् ॥ 34 ॥
4.37.m: Moreover, because this was performed by Indra with a passionate nature (rajas), / therefore sovereign rule over the three worlds, endowed with great prosperity, was obtained by him.

4.37.s:
tamasāvṛtacittaistu saṃcīrṇaṃ daityadānavaiḥ ..
tena teṣāmathaiśvaryaṃ dṛṣṭanaṣṭamabhūtkila ..35..
4.37.d:
तमसावृतचित्तैस्तु संचीर्णं दैत्यदानवैः ॥
तेन तेषामथैश्वर्यं दृष्टनष्टमभूत्किल ॥35॥
4.37.m: However, it was observed by the Daityas and Dānavas with minds enveloped in darkness (tamas); / by that, their sovereignty became visible only to perish.

4.37.s:
evaṃ saśrīkamabhavatsadevāsuramānuṣam ..
jaracca jagatāṃ śreṣṭha vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 36 ..
4.37.d:
एवं सश्रीकमभवत्सदेवासुरमानुषम् ॥
जरच्च जगतां श्रेष्ठ व्रतस्यास्य प्रभावतः ॥ 36 ॥
4.37.m: Thus, along with gods, asuras, and humans, / and old [or young], O best of worlds, it became endowed with fortune (Śrī) through the power of this votive observance.

4.37.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
kathametadvrataṃ kṛṣṇa kriyate manujaiḥ kadā ..
prārabhyate pāryate ca sarvaṃ vada yadūttama .. 37 ..
4.37.d:
॥ युधिष्ठिर उवाच ॥ ॥
कथमेतद्व्रतं कृष्ण क्रियते मनुजैः कदा ॥
प्रारभ्यते पार्यते च सर्वं वद यदूत्तम ॥ 37 ॥
4.37.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / How is this votive observance performed by men, and when, O Kṛṣṇa? / How is it begun and completed? Tell everything, O best of the Yadus.

4.37.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
mārgaśīrṣe site pakṣe paṃcamyāṃ patagodaye ..
upavāsasya niyamaṃ kuryādāśu suhṛddhṛdi .. 38 ..
4.37.d:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
मार्गशीर्षे सिते पक्षे पंचम्यां पतगोदये ॥
उपवासस्य नियमं कुर्यादाशु सुहृद्धृदि ॥ 38 ॥
4.37.m: Śrī Kṛṣṇa said: / In the bright fortnight of Mārgaśīrṣa, on the fifth [tithi] at sunrise, / one should promptly undertake the vow of fasting in a friendly heart.

4.37.s:
svarṇaraupyārakūṭotthā tāmramṛtkāṣṭhajātha vā ..
citrapaṭṭagatāṃ devīṃ lakṣmīṃ kṣmāpāla kārayet .. 39 ..
4.37.d:
स्वर्णरौप्यारकूटोत्था ताम्रमृत्काष्ठजाथ वा ॥
चित्रपट्टगतां देवीं लक्ष्मीं क्ष्मापाल कारयेत् ॥ 39 ॥
4.37.m: Made of gold, silver, brass, copper, clay, or wood, / or depicted upon a painted cloth, O protector of the earth, one should have [the image of] goddess Lakṣmī fashioned:

4.37.s:
padmahastāṃ padmavarṇāṃ padmāṃ padmadalekṣaṇām ..
diggajendraiḥ snāpyamānāṃ kāṃcanaiḥ kalaśottamaiḥ .. 4.37.40 ..
4.37.d:
पद्महस्तां पद्मवर्णां पद्मां पद्मदलेक्षणाम् ॥
दिग्गजेन्द्रैः स्नाप्यमानां कांचनैः कलशोत्तमैः ॥ 4.37.40 ॥
4.37.m: Holding a lotus in her hand, lotus-coloured, lotus-like, with eyes resembling lotus petals, / being bathed by the royal elephants of the quarters with supreme golden water-pots.

4.37.s:
tato yāmatraye jāte nimnagāyāṃ gṛhe'tha vā ..
snānaṃ kuryādasaṃbhrātaṃ śakravadupacārataḥ .. 41 ..
4.37.d:
ततो यामत्रये जाते निम्नगायां गृहेऽथ वा ॥
स्नानं कुर्यादसंभ्रातं शक्रवदुपचारतः ॥ 41 ॥
4.37.m: Then, when three watches have passed, in a river or at home, / one should take a bath unperturbed, with rites resembling Indra's.

4.37.s:
devānpitṝṃśca saṃtarpya tato devagṛhaṃ vrajet ..
tatrasthāṃ pūjayeddevīṃ puṣpai statkālasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 42 ..
4.37.d:
देवान्पितॄंश्च संतर्प्य ततो देवगृहं व्रजेत् ॥
तत्रस्थां पूजयेद्देवीं पुष्पै स्तत्कालसंभवैः ॥ 42 ॥
4.37.m: Having satiated the gods and ancestors, one should then go to the temple of the deity; / there one should worship the goddess residing [there] with flowers available at that season:

4.37.s:
capalāyai namaḥ pādau caṃcalāyai ca jānunī ..
kaṭiṃ kamalavāsinyai nābhiṃ khyātyai namonamaḥ .. 43 ..
4.37.d:
चपलायै नमः पादौ चंचलायै च जानुनी ॥
कटिं कमलवासिन्यै नाभिं ख्यात्यै नमोनमः ॥ 43 ॥
4.37.m: “Homage to Capalā” [worshipping] the feet, “and to Cañcalā” the knees, / the hips to Kamalavāsinī, “Homage, homage to Khyāti” the navel;

4.37.s:
stanau manmathavāsinyai lalitāyai bhujadvayam ..
utkaṃṭhitāyai kaṇṭhaṃ ca mādhavyai mukhamaṇḍalam .. 44 ..
4.37.d:
स्तनौ मन्मथवासिन्यै ललितायै भुजद्वयम् ॥
उत्कंठितायै कण्ठं च माधव्यै मुखमण्डलम् ॥ 44 ॥
4.37.m: the breasts to Manmathavāsinī, the two arms to Lalitā, / the neck to Utkaṇṭhitā, and the circle of the face to Mādhavī;

4.37.s:
namaḥ śriyai śiraḥ pūjya dadyānnaivedyamādarāt ..
phalāni ca yathālābhaṃ virūḍhāndhānyasaṃcayān .. 45 ..
4.37.d:
नमः श्रियै शिरः पूज्य दद्यान्नैवेद्यमादरात् ॥
फलानि च यथालाभं विरूढान्धान्यसंचयान् ॥ 45 ॥
4.37.m: having worshipped the head with “Homage to Śrī,” one should respectfully offer food offering, / and fruits as available, and heaps of sprouted grains.

4.37.s:
tataḥ suvāsinī pūjyā kusumaiḥ kuṃkumena ca ..
bhojayenmadhurānnena praṇipatya visarjayet .. 46 ..
4.37.d:
ततः सुवासिनी पूज्या कुसुमैः कुंकुमेन च ॥
भोजयेन्मधुरान्नेन प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥ 46 ॥
4.37.m: Then a married woman whose husband is alive should be worshipped with flowers and saffron; / one should feed her with sweet food and dismiss her after bowing down.

4.37.s:
tatastu taṃḍulaprasthaṃ ghṛtapātreṇa saṃyutam ..
brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śrīśaḥ saṃprīyatāmiti .. 47 ..
4.37.d:
ततस्तु तंडुलप्रस्थं घृतपात्रेण संयुतम् ॥
ब्राह्मणाय प्रदातव्यं श्रीशः संप्रीयतामिति ॥ 47 ॥
4.37.m: Then a prastha of rice accompanied by a vessel of clarified butter / should be given to a brāhmaṇa, saying, “May the Lord of Śrī be pleased.”

4.37.s:
nirvartya tadaśeṣeṇa tato bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ ..
māsānumāsaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhinānena bhārata .. 48 ..
4.37.d:
निर्वर्त्य तदशेषेण ततो भुञ्जीत वाग्यतः ॥
मासानुमासं कर्तव्यं विधिनानेन भारत ॥ 48 ॥
4.37.m: Having completed that in its entirety, one should then eat while restraining speech; / this should be done month after month according to this rite, O Bhārata.

4.37.s:
śrīrlakṣmīḥ kamalā saṃpadumā nārāyaṇī tadā ..
padmā dhṛtiḥ sthitiḥ puṣṭirṛddhiḥ siddhiryathākramam ..
māsānumāsa rājendra prīyatāmiti kīrtayet .. 49 ..
4.37.d:
श्रीर्लक्ष्मीः कमला संपदुमा नारायणी तदा ॥
पद्मा धृतिः स्थितिः पुष्टिरृद्धिः सिद्धिर्यथाक्रमम् ॥
मासानुमास राजेन्द्र प्रीयतामिति कीर्तयेत् ॥ 49 ॥
4.37.m: “Śrī, Lakṣmī, Kamalā, Saṃpad, Umā, Nārāyaṇī then, / Padmā, Dhṛti, Sthiti, Puṣṭi, Ṛddhi, Siddhi” in order, / month after month, O king of kings, one should recite: “May she be pleased.”

4.37.s:
tataśca dvādaśe māsi saṃprāpte paṃcame dine ..
vastramaṃḍapikāṃ kṛtvā puṣpagandhādhivāsitām .. .. 4.37.50 ..
4.37.d:
ततश्च द्वादशे मासि संप्राप्ते पंचमे दिने ॥
वस्त्रमंडपिकां कृत्वा पुष्पगन्धाधिवासिताम् ॥ ॥ 4.37.50 ॥
4.37.m: And then, when the twelfth month has arrived, on the fifth day, / having erected a cloth pavilion perfumed with flowers and fragrant substances,

4.37.s:
śayyāyāṃ sthāpayellakṣmīṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutām ..
mauktikāṣṭakasaṃyuktāṃ netrapaṭṭāvṛtastanīm .. 51 ..
4.37.d:
शय्यायां स्थापयेल्लक्ष्मीं सर्वोपस्करसंयुताम् ॥
मौक्तिकाष्टकसंयुक्तां नेत्रपट्टावृतस्तनीम् ॥ 51 ॥
4.37.m: one should place Lakṣmī upon a bed, equipped with all furnishings, / furnished with eight pearls, her breasts covered with fine silk cloth,

4.37.s:
saptadhānyasamopetāṃ rasadhātusamanvitām..
pādukopānahacchatrabhājanāsanasatkṛtām..52..
4.37.d:
सप्तधान्यसमोपेतां रसधातुसमन्विताम्॥
पादुकोपानहच्छत्रभाजनासनसत्कृताम्॥52॥
4.37.m: endowed with the seven grains, accompanied by the elixir and mineral ores, / honoured with wooden shoes, sandals, a royal parasol, vessels, and a seat.

4.37.s:
dadyātsaṃpūjya vidhivadbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine..
vyāsāya vedaviduṣe yasya vā rocate svayam..
sopaskarāṃ savatsāṃ ca dhenuṃ dattvā kṣamāpayet..53..
4.37.d:
दद्यात्संपूज्य विधिवद्ब्राह्मणाय कुटुम्बिने॥
व्यासाय वेदविदुषे यस्य वा रोचते स्वयम्॥
सोपस्करां सवत्सां च धेनुं दत्त्वा क्षमापयेत्॥53॥
4.37.m: Having worshipped her according to the rules, one should give [her] to a brāhmaṇa householder, / an expounder (Vyāsa) learned in the Veda, or to whomever one pleases; / having given a milch cow along with her calf and furnishings, one should ask for forgiveness:

4.37.s:
kṣīrābdhimathanodbhūte viṣṇorvakṣaḥsthalālaye ..
sarvakāmaprade devi ṛddhiṃ yaccha namo'stu te ..54..
4.37.d:
क्षीराब्धिमथनोद्भूते विष्णोर्वक्षःस्थलालये ॥
सर्वकामप्रदे देवि ऋद्धिं यच्छ नमोऽस्तु ते ॥54॥
4.37.m: “O goddess born from the churning of the milk ocean, whose abode is the chest of Viṣṇu, / granter of all desires, bestow prosperity! Homage be to you.”

4.37.s:
tataḥ suvāsinīḥ pūjya vastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
bhojayitvā svayaṃ paścādbhuñjīta saha bandhubhiḥ .. 55 ..
4.37.d:
ततः सुवासिनीः पूज्य वस्त्रैराभरणैः शुभैः ॥
भोजयित्वा स्वयं पश्चाद्भुञ्जीत सह बन्धुभिः ॥ 55 ॥
4.37.m: Then, having worshipped married women whose husbands are alive with auspicious garments and ornaments, / and having fed them, one should eat afterwards oneself along with one's kinsmen.

4.37.s:
evaṃ yaḥ kurute pārtha bhaktyā śrīpañcamīvratam..
tasya śrīrbhavane bhāti kulānāmekaviṃśatiḥ .. 56 ..
4.37.d:
एवं यः कुरुते पार्थ भक्त्या श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतम्॥
तस्य श्रीर्भवने भाति कुलानामेकविंशतिः ॥ 56 ॥
4.37.m: The one who thus performs with devotion the Śrīpañcamī votive observance, O son of Pṛthā— / for twenty-one generations fortune (Śrī) shines in his home.

4.37.s:
nārī vā kurute yā tu prāpyānujñāṃ svabhartṛtaḥ ..
subhagā darśanīyā ca bahuputrā ca jāyate ..57..
4.37.d:
नारी वा कुरुते या तु प्राप्यानुज्ञां स्वभर्तृतः ॥
सुभगा दर्शनीया च बहुपुत्रा च जायते ॥57॥
4.37.m: Or a woman who performs it having obtained permission from her husband / becomes fortunate, handsome to look upon, and having many sons.

4.37.s:
śrīpañcamīvratamidaṃ dayitaṃ murārerbhaktyā samācarati pūjyabhṛgostanūjām ..
rājyaṃ nijaṃ sa bhuvi bhavyajanopabhogānbhuktvā prayāti bhuvanaṃ madhusūdanasya..58..
viśokaṣaṣṭhīvratavarṇanam
4.37.d:
श्रीपञ्चमीव्रतमिदं दयितं मुरारेर्भक्त्या समाचरति पूज्यभृगोस्तनूजाम् ॥
राज्यं निजं स भुवि भव्यजनोपभोगान्भुक्त्वा प्रयाति भुवनं मधुसूदनस्य॥58॥
विशोकषष्ठीव्रतवर्णनम्
4.37.m:
Whoever performs with devotion this Śrīpañcamī votive observance dear to Murāri, worshipping the daughter of Bhṛgu, / after enjoying his own kingdom on earth and pleasures fit for distinguished people, goes to the abode of Madhusūdana.
Description of the Viśokaṣaṣṭhī votive observance
